content_sections.text: Step 1 – Registration & Personal Details: Register using your Aadhaar number (each Aadhaar can be used only once); use your own mobile number and email ID. Step 2 – Educational & Other Details: Fill in educational qualification, category/reservation claims, and other required details carefully. Step 3 – Upload Photo, Signature, Thumb Impression: Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (150W×200H px), signature (150W×100H px), and a clear left-hand thumb impression (150W×100H px) in JPG/JPEG format. Step 4 – Make Payment: Pay the application fee online via Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking/UPI only. No other payment mode is accepted. Step 5 – Print Application: Download and print/retain a copy of the final submitted application for your records. Important: Do not submit more than one online application for this post – all applications will be rejected if you do. The application is considered complete only when the fee is credited to the Commission’s account by the last date and the status column shows “Completed”. A one-time post-deadline correction window is available (26–27 October 2026), but name, parents’ names, date of birth and exam center cannot be changed.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: High School certificate, for proof of name, parents’ names and date of birth Intermediate (12th) or equivalent certificate and marksheet, with Science or Mathematics Aadhaar Card (both sides), for online verification Uttarakhand domicile/permanent residence certificate, OR Employment Exchange registration proof, OR proof of having passed High School/Intermediate from an institution in Uttarakhand (at least one, as applicable) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in the prescribed proforma (see the notification’s Annexures 2(a)/2(b)/2(c)/2(d)/2(f)/3/3(a)/3(b) for exact formats), where applicable Territorial Army service certificate or NCC ‘B’/‘C’ certificate, where claiming preferential qualification Divyang (PwBD) certificate, Ex-Servicemen discharge certificate, Freedom-Fighter-dependent certificate, Orphan certificate, State-Movement-Affected certificate, or Skilled-Sportsperson certificate, as applicable to the reservation/preference claimed Departmental No Objection Certificate, for candidates already employed with Central/State Government or a public institution Recent colour passport-size photograph, signature scan, and thumb impression scan, in the specified pixel dimensions

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Application fee: Rs. 300 for UR/OBC candidates; Rs. 150 for Uttarakhand SC/ST/EWS candidates; Rs. 150 for Uttarakhand Divyang candidates; no fee for Orphan candidates. Fee is non-refundable except in case of a technical payment failure, and must be paid online (Credit/Debit Card, Net Banking, or UPI only). A candidate may claim reservation in only one sub-category, whichever is more advantageous, and must produce a valid certificate for it. A male candidate with more than one living wife, or a woman who has married such a man while his first wife is living, is not eligible for appointment. The candidate must be of sound mental and physical health, free of any defect that would hinder efficient discharge of duties. Marks/character during the selection process must be suitable for government service; unsuitable conduct at any stage leads to rejection and appropriate action, including debarment and FIR for use of unfair means, as per the Uttarakhand Competitive Examinations (Measures for Prevention and Curb of Unfair Means in Recruitment) Act, 2023. Admit cards are issued only via download from the Commission’s website; they will not be sent by post. No calculators, mobile phones, pagers, cameras, scanner pens, or other electronic/communication devices are allowed inside the examination center. The Commission does not advise candidates on their eligibility; candidates must carefully verify their own eligibility against the notification’s terms before applying.

GSSSB Staff Nurse Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: GSSSB has announced 11 Staff Nurse, Class 3 vacancies under the Special Recruitment Drive for eligible Persons with Disabilities. The vacancies are distributed among the notified disability groups as follows. The notification specifies the following disability categories for the available vacancies. Group A: Low Vision (LV), with disability percentage of 40–70%. Group C: One Leg (OL), Cerebral Palsy (CP), Leprosy Cured (LC), Dwarfism (Dw), Acid Attack Victim (AAV), Both Arms (BA), Both Legs (BL), Spinal Deformity (SD) and Spinal Injury (SI), subject to the specified functional conditions. Group D & E: Specific Learning Disability (SLD), Mental Illness (MI) and Multiple Disabilities (MD) as specified in the notification. Special conditions: Candidates with Both Arms (BA) or Both Legs (BL) disabilities must satisfy the functional requirements prescribed by the relevant government resolution. Their suitability for the post may be determined through a Medical Board assessment. Only candidates with the notified eligible disability types may apply. The notification does not provide separate vacancy reservations for women or ex-servicemen under this special recruitment.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess either of the following qualifications: B.Sc. Nursing: A degree in B.Sc. Nursing from an eligible university or recognized institution, with recognition by the Gujarat Nursing Council or Indian Nursing Council. GNM Diploma: A Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery from an institution recognized by the Gujarat Nursing Council or Indian Nursing Council. In addition, candidates must possess basic computer application knowledge as prescribed under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967, and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. Candidates who are not already registered with the Gujarat Nursing Council at the time of application must obtain the required registration before appointment, in accordance with the recruitment rules. Therefore, applicants who satisfy the prescribed nursing qualification but do not yet have Gujarat Nursing Council registration details at the time of online application should carefully follow the notification's registration requirements. Candidates are required to possess basic computer knowledge under the applicable government rules. The notification permits candidates without the required computer knowledge certificate at the application stage to apply, provided they submit the prescribed proof before appointment.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is calculated as of 29 October 2026 . The notification provides eligible age relaxations of 10 years for general-category male PwD candidates, 15 years for general-category female PwD candidates, 15 years for reserved-category male PwD candidates and 20 years for reserved-category female PwD candidates, subject to the overall upper-age cap of 45 years. Age relaxation and reserved-category benefits are subject to the applicable government rules and valid supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will initially receive fixed monthly remuneration of Rs. 40,800 for five years. Following satisfactory service and subject to the relevant government resolutions and conditions, they may become eligible for regular appointment in Pay Level 5.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Important: The examination fee of Rs. 400 is non-refundable. According to the notification, even candidates who appear in the examination are not eligible for a fee refund. The examination fee is also not refundable if the application is rejected. Payment can be made through debit card, internet banking, UPI or supported wallets. Applicable transaction charges may be collected separately. Candidates must retain the electronic payment receipt. An application without successful fee payment will not be treated as valid.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a competitive multiple-choice examination, preparation of a merit list and verification of original documents. Competitive MCQ Written Examination Separate qualification in Nursing and Gujarati papers Merit List based on combined marks Document Verification Final Selection and Appointment, subject to eligibility and applicable rules

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The competitive examination consists of two papers carrying a total of 200 marks . Examination Instructions: All questions are multiple-choice questions. Each question carries one mark before any applicable pro-rata adjustment. Negative marking is one-fourth of the marks assigned to an incorrect answer. Candidates must secure at least 40% marks separately in Paper I and Paper II. The Nursing paper can be attempted in Gujarati or English. The Gujarati Language paper is conducted only in Gujarati. The notification specifies a duration of 2 hours for the Nursing paper. Merit is prepared using combined marks secured in both papers, subject to the qualifying standards.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Staff Nurse Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The Nursing examination covers the prescribed nursing syllabus, including core subjects and topics relevant to professional nursing practice. Candidates should refer to the detailed syllabus provided in the official notification, including the annexure. Candidates must qualify in both papers independently. Scoring well in only one paper does not satisfy the notified minimum qualifying requirement.

content_sections.text: GSSSB has advertised 1,663 posts. Category-wise counts are shown below; women, PwD and ex-servicemen figures are reservations within the overall vacancies and should not be added to the total. Of these posts, the notification identifies category-wise reservations for women (232 unreserved, 53 EWS, 146 SEBC, 38 SC, 80 ST), as well as 113 PwD and 166 ex-servicemen reserved vacancies. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have a Diploma in Civil Engineering issued by an eligible institution, or one of the explicitly recognized equivalent diploma qualifications. They must have basic knowledge of computer applications and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. Important: A Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering does not meet the stated eligibility requirement. The notification specifically excludes Civil Engineering degree holders. Recognized equivalent diploma qualifications include the following as listed by the department : Diploma in Civil (Construction) Diploma in Civil (Public Health and Environment) Engineering Diploma in Civil Engineering (Environment and Pollution Control) Diploma in Civil Engineering (Environmental and Pollution Control) Diploma in Construction Technology Diploma in Civil Engineering (Environmental Engineering) Diploma in Civil Engineering (Public Health Engineering) Diploma in Civil Engineering (Rural Engineering) Diploma in Civil Engineering Environment and Pollution Control Diploma in Civil Environmental Engineering Diploma in Civil Engineering (Construction Technology) Diploma in Construction Engineering Diploma in Civil Technology Diploma in Civil and Environmental Engineering Diploma in Civil and Rural Engineering Diploma in Civil Draftsman Diploma in Civil Engineering Diploma in Civil Engineering and Planning Diploma in Civil Engineering (Building Service Engineering) Diploma in Construction Technology and Management Diploma in Quantity Surveying and Construction Management Diploma in Survey Engineering Diploma in Transportation Engineering Computer certificate note: The notification permits candidates without the required basic computer knowledge certificate to apply, but they must submit the necessary proof before appointment. Eligibility is assessed with reference to 29 October 2026 . Minimum age is 18 years . Reservation benefits are subject to the applicable domicile, certificate and category requirements explained in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee and Refund Rules
content_sections.text: Pay online by 1 November 2026 at 11:59 PM through the OJAS portal. Permitted payment methods include debit card, internet banking, UPI and wallets; transaction charges may apply. Fee refund: Candidates who appear in the examination are eligible for a refund of the examination fee paid, as per the notification. Candidates who do not appear are not eligible for a refund. If the application is rejected, the fee is also not refundable. Keep the payment receipt safely.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process and Examination Pattern
content_sections.text: Selection involves a single-stage objective competitive examination using CBRT/OMR, followed by preparation of a merit list and certificate verification as per the notification. Negative marking: One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for an incorrect answer. Candidates must secure at least 40% separately in Part A and Part B ; the notification does not allow the minimum qualifying standard to fall below 40% for any category. Subjects include irrigation engineering, water resource management, surveying and advanced surveying, soil mechanics, concrete technology, estimation/costing/valuation, hydrology and advanced hydrology, hydraulics, engineering mechanics, structural mechanics, RCC design, and construction materials, advanced construction technology and quality control. Read the notification's final pages for the complete topic-wise syllabus.

basic_details.short_information: Electronics & Radar Development Establishment (DRDO LRDE) has announced vacancies for Consultant (Technical) under a 2026 recruitment drive. Eligible candidates can submit their applications by email or by post to the office on or before 4 November 2026, starting from 14 October 2026. Applicants for the Consultant (Technical) post require a qualification in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Instrument with 30+ years of experience in Quality and Reliability Assurance, with the pay specified as Level-13A. The selection process involves

qualification.details: General Eligibility: Officers/Officials who have retired from Central/State Government, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies, Universities, or Govt R&D Organizations possessing practical knowledge and experience as per the Terms of Reference (TOR). Persons with DRDO work experience are given preference. Effective oral and written communication skills are required. Post Code 2026/LRDE/356: Electrical Engineering / Electronics Engineering / Electronics and Communication Engineering / Instrument. Requires 30+ years of working experience in Quality and Reliability Assurance, including project QA of Airborne, Ground Based, and Naval Systems. Post Code 2026/LRDE/357: Project Management, System Integration, Inspection, System testing. Expertise in project management, industry partner management, communication, documentation, and system testing. Post Code 2026/LRDE/358: Electronics Engineer with experience in Electrical & Electronics. Expertise in testing, maintenance, RF and digital measuring instruments, and RF/digital subsystem integration at the Kolar test site. Post Code 2026/LRDE/359: Electronics Diploma / Electrical Diploma. Work experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control of Electrical and Electronic Sub-Systems for Radars (MIL STD 810, JSS 55555, CEMILAC Certification Process by IMTAR). Post Code 2026/LRDE/360: Knowledge of electrical interface design and interconnection generation for radar projects. Post Code 2026/LRDE/361: Previous experience in civil works and legal matters. Expertise in civil works, MES, EMU coordination, Land and WoDA legal matters.

selection_process: Applications are screened for eligibility and compliance with the Terms of Reference (TOR). Preference is given to candidates possessing experience of having worked with DRDO. Selected candidates are engaged on a short-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q1. What is DRDO LRDE Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Electronics & Radar Development Establishment (DRDO LRDE), Bengaluru, to engage retired government, PSU, and autonomous body officials as Consultants on a short-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies distributed across post codes 2026/LRDE/356 to 2026/LRDE/361, with 1 post per post code.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 4 November 2026, which is 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all categories of retired government employees applying for these consultant positions is 63 years as on the closing date of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the contract tenure for these consultant positions?
faq.answer: The tenure of contract is one year, which is extendable as per extant norms, with specific tasks estimated between 1 to 3 years depending on the post code.

faq.question: Q6. How is the remuneration determined for pensioners?

content_sections.text: Post Name: Field Assistant (FA) Number of Vacancies: 02 (Two)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in any Science discipline (B.Sc.) or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology from a recognized University/Institute/Board with a minimum of 55% marks. Candidates possessing a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech.) or a degree in Civil, Mechanical, Mining, or allied disciplines may be given preference based on their suitability for the project requirements and performance in the selection process. Experience in field data collection, or other research related field activities. Basic proficiency in data entry and data handling using MS Office and MS Excel. Willingness to undertake field visits and travel to project/study locations as required. Good communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in English and Hindi. Ability to interact effectively with research teams and industry personnel. Experience in maintaining field records, organizing collected data, and supporting research/project documentation is desirable. Interest or prior exposure to research projects will be an advantage. The upper age limit for applying is up to 50 years. The age limit is relaxed up to 5 years in the case of candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, PwWD, and Female applicants, whereas 3 years in the case of OBCs (Non-creamy layer candidates). The upper age limit shall be reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 27,000/- per month plus HRA as applicable per ANRF norms. The appointment will be for 1 year initially and the tenure will be extended based on satisfactory performance. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the ANRF-PAIR project (up to 13-October-2030) and does not confer any right or claim for regular appointment at NIT Rourkela.

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Field Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Field Assistant will be responsible for the following duties and key responsibilities: Support Junior Research Fellows (JRFs) and the Co-Principal Investigators with day-to-day operational logistics, experiment setups, and report drafting. Assist the Co-Principal Investigators' research team in field visits, surveys, sample/data collection from mines and nearby industries, laboratory and experimental activities, maintenance of field records, and other related work as assigned. Conduct and coordinate field visits, surveys, data/sample collection, and other project-related field activities. Assist in planning field schedules and managing on-site logistics for surveys and data-collection campaigns. Perform data entry, compilation, verification, and preliminary processing/cleaning of collected data. Maintain systematic and accurate field records, survey forms, databases, photographs, and other supporting documentation. Assist the research team in laboratory/field experiments, sample handling, measurements, or related technical activities, wherever applicable. Coordinate with industry and project personnel during field activities. Provide logistical support for project meetings, workshops, training programmes, awareness activities, and other project events. Submit regular field updates and collected information to energy and environmental project teams. Undertake travel to project locations as and when required.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and the need of the project. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for an Online Interview. The period of experience in a discipline or area of work, wherever prescribed, shall be counted after the date of acquiring the minimum prescribed educational qualifications for that position. Mere possession of minimum qualification does not guarantee invitation to the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gauhati High Court Stenographer-Grade-III
content_sections.text: Log on to the official website at https://kohimahighcourt.gov.in/ and click on 'Online Application for the posts of Stenographer-Grade-III in District Courts of Nagaland under Kohima Bench of the Gauhati High Court'. Register by providing primary credentials such as Username, Password, Email, Date of Birth, and Mobile Number to receive the Registration Code. Login using your registered email and password. Fill up the application form with personal, qualification, and additional information. Upload a recent passport-sized photograph and signature image (in .jpg format, file size between 5kb and 150kb). Upload required academic documents and caste certificates compiled in a single readable .pdf file (size between 40kb and 4MB). Pay the application fee of Rs. 300 by scanning the QR code, entering the Transaction ID, and uploading the payment receipt. Submit the online application before the deadline.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises three stages: Stage-I (Written Examination - 200 marks): Part 1 covers General English, Precise writing, Essay writing, Drafting translation, and English Grammar (100 marks). Part 2 covers General knowledge, Current affairs, and Mathematics (100 marks). Candidates equal to 5 times the number of vacancies (1:5) in order of merit will qualify for Stage-II. Stage-II (Practical / Speed test - 50 marks): Shorthand test, computer proficiency, and typing test. Candidates equal to 3 times the number of vacancies (1:3) in order of merit will qualify for Stage-III. Stage-III (Interview / Viva Voce - 50 marks): Document verification and viva voce. Candidates must secure at least 60% marks (30 out of 50) to qualify the interview.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Junior Engineer Mechanical Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy both the UPSSSC PET 2025 requirement and the educational qualifications prescribed for their selected post. The notification includes separate technical qualifications and equivalent diploma disciplines for different departments. Candidates must have participated in the Preliminary Eligibility Test (PET) 2025. A PET 2025 scorecard must have been issued by the Commission. Shortlisting for the main examination will be based on normalized PET 2025 scores. Candidates with zero or negative normalized scores will not be shortlisted. Candidates whose PET 2025 results are provisionally marked or under investigation may be considered subject to the Commission's stated conditions. The recruitment includes posts requiring relevant technical, engineering and diploma qualifications. The exact requirements depend on the department and post. The supporting departmental documents include several Mechanical Engineering and related diploma disciplines, such as: Mechanical Engineering Mechanical Engineering (Production) Mechanical Engineering (Maintenance) Mechanical Engineering (Automobile) Mechanical Engineering (Tool Engineering) Mechanical Engineering (CAD/CAM) Mechanical Engineering (Refrigeration and Air Conditioning) Production Engineering Manufacturing Engineering Tool and Die Engineering Mechatronics Robotics and Mechatronics Important: Inclusion of a discipline in an equivalence list does not mean it is accepted for every advertised post. The applicable department, post and relevant qualification order must be checked in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Is NATS Registration Mandatory for DRDO ITR Apprentice 2026?
content_sections.text: Yes. NATS registration is an eligibility requirement. Candidates with the listed degree or diploma qualifications must have registered their names on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal. The notification warns that non-registered candidates are likely to be rejected. NATS portal: https://nats.education.gov.in/ Applicants should enter their NATS enrollment number in the corresponding field of the DRDO ITR application form.

content_sections.heading: DRDO ITR Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: DRDO ITR will select candidates based on a Written Test, Personal Interview, or both , conducted for shortlisted candidates. ITR reserves the right to determine the shortlisting method. Meeting the minimum qualification does not automatically guarantee that an applicant will be shortlisted. Written test and interview updates, including call letters, will be provided through the official website or email. Candidates are responsible for downloading and printing their admit cards or call letters. Selected candidates must undergo document verification before the apprenticeship contract is created. They must also provide a Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: Is DRDO ITR Apprenticeship a Permanent Government Job?
content_sections.text: The official notification clearly states that ITR is not obligated to offer employment to apprentices after they complete their training. Candidates should consider this opportunity as a fixed-duration apprenticeship rather than a guaranteed permanent position.

content_sections.heading: Other Important Conditions Candidates Should Know
content_sections.text: All correspondence, including offer letters for selected candidates, will take place through email. ITR will not provide TA/DA to candidates called at any stage of the selection process. Government quarters, hostel accommodation and transport will not be provided during the written test/interview or training period. PwBD candidates are eligible only for designated trades under the applicable Apprenticeship Rules. Reservation will apply according to the relevant Apprentices Act and Rules. Incorrect information or attempts to influence the selection process may result in disqualification.

content_sections.heading: Who Should Consider Applying for DRDO ITR Apprentice 2026?
content_sections.text: This apprenticeship may be relevant to recent engineering and diploma graduates who want a 12-month training opportunity at a DRDO laboratory. It also provides openings for eligible BBA, B.Com and Library Science graduates. Before applying, candidates should check three points carefully: Academic eligibility: Is your exact course or branch listed, and did you pass between 2022 and 2026 as a regular candidate? Experience eligibility: Have you completed less than one year of job experience or training after obtaining the required qualification? Application readiness: Do you have NATS registration and sufficient time for your physical application to reach ITR before the deadline?

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process varies by post category and generally involves screening, trade tests, physical tests, personality assessment tests, and competitive written examinations. Technical Officer: Screening Committee recommendation followed by a qualifying Trade Test and a competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 Qs, 100 Marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 50 Qs, 150 Marks), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 100 Qs, 300 Marks). Final merit is based on Paper II and III. Security Officer: Screening followed by Physical Standards, Physical Test, and a Written Examination consisting of Paper-I (Mental Ability & Personality Assessment, 100 Qs, 100 Marks) and Paper-II (Subjective: Comprehension, Report Writing, Security Regulations & Firefighting, General Awareness, 100 Marks). Security Assistant: Screening, qualifying Skill / Physical and Personality Assessment Test (100 Qs, 100 Marks), followed by a subjective Competitive Written Examination (100 Marks). Technician (1): Trade Test followed by a competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability Test, 50 Qs, 100 Marks), Paper II (General Awareness & English Language, 50 Qs, 150 Marks), and Paper III (Concerned Subject, 50 Qs, 150 Marks). Multi-Tasking Staff: Competitive Written Examination consisting of General Intelligence (25 Qs, 75 Marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 Qs, 75 Marks), General Awareness (50 Qs, 150 Marks), and English Language (50 Qs, 150 Marks). Total 150 questions, 300 marks.

Upload scanned copies of your recent passport-size colour photograph, signature, fee e-receipt, and all mandatory educational, category, and experience certificates (max size 1MB each). age_limit.details: A candidate must have completed 18 years of age as on 01.01.2026. Because recruitment is being held in the year 2026, the age is calculated as on 01.01.2026. The maximum age limit is as follows. | Ex-servicemen: The total defence service period already rendered will be deducted from the candidate's age, but the resulting age must not be more than three years above the maximum age limit. "Ex-servicemen" means ex-servicemen of Madhya Pradesh as defined in Rule 2(c) of the Madhya Pradesh Ex-Servicemen (Reservation of Vacancies in Civil Services and Posts, Class III and Class IV) Rules, 1985. Contract employees of the High Court/District Courts: Employees of the MP High Court or MP District Courts who have been working (or have worked) for at least 5 years on a contract post equivalent to, or in a higher category/post than, the vacant post get age relaxation equal to their contract service period, provided their age is not more than 55 years.

selection_process: Syllabus No. of Questions Marks Medium
(1) G.K. + G.S., including G.K. of M.P. 20 20 Hindi and English
(2) Maths + Logical Reasoning 20 20 Hindi and English
(3) General Hindi 20 20 Hindi
(4) English knowledge 20 20 English
(5) Computer knowledge 20 20 English
Total 100 questions and 100 marks
S. No. Post Subject Marks Time
1 Stenographer Grade-II, Grade-III and Grade-III (Court Manager Staff) Hindi Stenography dictation of 400 words (approx.) + Transcription/Typing 100 5+30 = 35 Min.
2 Assistant Grade-III (English Knowing) English Stenography dictation of 400 words (approx.) + Transcription/Typing 100 5+30 = 35 Min.

The MPHC Stenographer selection process has two stages: an Online Preliminary Examination (100 marks) and a Hindi Stenography/English Stenography Skill Test (100 marks). English Stenography is held for candidates who choose the Assistant Grade-III (English Knowing) post.
The examination is common for all the posts and has multiple-choice (M.C.Q.) questions for a maximum of 100 marks
with 1 mark for each question. The duration is 120 minutes (2 hours). It may be held in one shift
or in more than one shift if required
at centres including Jabalpur
Bhopal
Indore
Gwalior
Sagar
Satna and Ujjain (all
or one or more as required). If it is held in more than one shift
the question papers will be different. The date(s)

time and centres will be published through a notice on the High Court website. The online preliminary exam date is "to be notified later". Admit cards will be available on the High Court website; the print-out facility is expected to be available about 7 days before the exam date. The candidate must enter the application number and password to download it.
Proposed model answers will be displayed on the High Court website after the preliminary examination. Objections must be submitted offline within 7 days of the notice
during office hours (10:00 AM to 05:00 PM)
to the Principal Registrar (Examination)
Administrative Building
High Court of Madhya Pradesh
Jabalpur
in the prescribed format with self-attested copies of source documents. Objections received by e-mail or any other mode are not considered. For Stenographer Grade-II
Stenographer Grade-III and Stenographer Grade-III (Court Manager Staff)
the result is prepared on the basis of marks in merit
and candidates up to a 1:5 ratio in each category (about 5 candidates per post
including all candidates with marks equal to the cut-off marks) are declared successful for the Hindi stenography skill test. For Assistant Grade-III (English Knowing)

candidates in the same 1:5 ratio are declared successful for the English stenography skill test. The preliminary examination is screening only; its marks will not be considered at the time of the final result.

Candidates who qualify must pay the ₹743.40 portal fee online to the service provider through a web link to be provided on the High Court website. Candidates who do not pay will be treated as unwilling for the skill test and their candidature will be cancelled. Candidates will be given a dictation of about 400 words in 5 minutes
followed by a separate 30 minutes for transcription. A mock dictation is given first
then the original dictation. Transcription is done on a computer; a keyboard is provided at the centre and candidates cannot bring their own computer

keyboard or chair. Hindi transcription must be done in Remington Gail. Extra time is given before the test to check the keyboard. A notebook is provided for noting down the dictation. If the dictation is written in long hand in the notebook
full marks will be deducted. In evaluation
1/2 (0.50) mark is deducted for each error (wrong words
spelling errors
omitted words
punctuation errors
extra spaces or missing spaces between words and other typing errors). If a candidate makes more than 120 errors

the answer sheet will not be evaluated further and zero (00) marks will be awarded. The date of the skill test will be published separately on the High Court website. Candidates who make noise or disturbance during dictation or transcription
or argue unnecessarily
can be removed from the examination hall and their candidature cancelled. No provision exists for re-checking marks or re-evaluation of typing
and re-examination is not allowed.
The final skill test result is prepared category-wise on merit
keeping in mind the post(s) chosen in the online form and the educational qualification. The Stenographer Grade-II result is prepared first from successful candidates
then Stenographer Grade-III
then Stenographer Grade-III (Court Manager Staff)
and then Assistant Grade-III (English Knowing)
from the remaining successful candidates. Minimum marks in the skill test for all posts: General and Other Backward Classes 55%
Scheduled Caste 45%
Scheduled Tribe and disabled candidates 40%
and EWS 49.5%. In the case of equal marks

the older candidate gets preference. The final selection list and waiting list will be published on the High Court website. The waiting list will be valid from the date of declaration of the final result as per the Madhya Pradesh General Administration Department circular No. F6-07/2012/One(1) dated 14 July 2016. Inclusion of a name in the list gives no right to appointment until the appointing authority is satisfied about the candidate's suitability after verification of documents and background. The High Court reserves the right to correct the result in the case of a computer error
clerical error or other significant error. After the final result

the Response Sheet and score card for both the preliminary examination and the skill test will be shown on the High Court website. The candidate must enter the application number as User I.D. and the password.
Bond: The selected candidate must execute a bond of ₹2
000 (two lakh rupees) in the prescribed format and commit to serve for at least three years after joining. If the candidate resigns or leaves earlier
or violates any condition of the bond
the bond becomes enforceable and the candidate must pay ₹2
000. The bond amount need not be paid if the candidate/employee resigns
with prior permission

to join service in the Government of Madhya Pradesh or the Central Government. Posting: The district is allotted through counselling on the basis of category-wise merit and category-wise availability of vacancies in districts. Candidates have no right to a particular district or post. The appointing authority for all these posts is the Principal District and Sessions Judge of the concerned district. Requests for change of district after counselling will not be considered. Travel allowance: No travel allowance of any kind is payable to candidates appearing in the online preliminary examination and skill test. Information under the Right to Information: The candidate's answer sheet/candidate response will be provided on payment of the prescribed fee for 3 months after the final selection list is issued; the response sheet data will then be destroyed. Application forms and other material used in the examination (except those of finally selected candidates) will be destroyed one year after the selection list/final result is declared.
how_to_apply: MPHC Stenographer apply online is open on the High Court of Madhya Pradesh website. Follow these steps as given in the advertisement:
Visit the High Court of Madhya Pradesh website, www.mphc.gov.in.

Click the "Recruitment/Result" button, then click "Click on-Online Application Forms/Admit Cards". Four links will be available for this recruitment: Advertisement, Registration, Application and Edit Application.
Click the Advertisement link and read the full instructions of the advertisement carefully.
Click the Registration link and enter the required information. A User-ID and Password will be sent to the mobile number and e-mail ID entered by the candidate.
Click the Application link, fill in the application form completely and upload the photo and signature.
Preview the form, click the Submit button and pay the prescribed fee through debit card or internet banking.
After successful payment, click the Print button to get a print-out of the application and keep it safe for the further steps of the examination.

Candidates must make sure that the information in the application is correct and true; a separate application for correction later will not be entertained. No provision exists for correcting entries made in the Registration form.

The Edit Application window is available from 30.10.2026 (12:00 noon) to 01.11.2026 (05:00 PM). It applies only to entries made while filling the application form. The advertisement also says that correctable errors can be corrected within 3 days after the last date of filling the online form, and that no correction can be made after this period.
For problems in filling the online form, the advertisement gives the service provider Help Desk telephone number as 919513253398 (as printed in the notification).

content_sections.heading: MPHC Stenographer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Reservation and age relaxation apply only to original residents (domiciles) of Madhya Pradesh. Candidates from outside Madhya Pradesh must fill their category as "Unreserved" and apply only against Unreserved vacancies. OBC, SC, ST and EWS candidates of any state other than Madhya Pradesh are treated as Unreserved candidates. Disabled candidates of any state other than Madhya Pradesh apply under the UR (PH) category. EWS: 10% vertical reservation in direct recruitment vacancies. Women: 35% horizontal and compartment-wise reservation (as per the Extraordinary Gazette Notification dated 03.10.2023). Ex-servicemen: 10% horizontal and compartment-wise reservation (as per the Extraordinary Gazette Notification dated 21.04.1999). PwD: 6% reservation (as per circular dated 01.06.2022), with 1.5% each for (i) blind and low vision, (ii) deaf and hard of hearing, (iii) locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy, and (iv) autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability, mental illness and multiple disabilities.

content_sections.heading: MPHC Stenographer Qualification
content_sections.text: As per Madhya Pradesh General Administration Department circular No. C3-07/2015/1/3 dated 18.08.2015, a one-year computer diploma course from any one of the following is mandatory: A diploma from any university recognized by the UGC. A diploma from any open university recognized by the UGC. A diploma-level examination from DOEACC/National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT). A Modern Office Management course from a Government Polytechnic College. A one-year "Computer Operator and Programming Assistant" (COPA) certificate from a Government ITI. In addition to the above computer diploma, the following qualifications are also accepted: B.E. (CSE/IT), M.C.A., B.C.A., M.Sc. (IT/CS), B.Sc. (IT/CS), M.Tech, M.E., etc. An AICTE-approved polytechnic diploma in Computer Science, Computer Application and Information Technology, etc. B.Sc./B.Com. degrees in which only one subject of computer is studied are not valid. As per General Administration Department letter No. C-3-7/2015/1/3 dated 29 May 2019, if a candidate has passed B.Sc. with IT/CS along with other subjects, and the IT/CS subject is confirmed/certified on the mark-sheet, that B.Sc. degree will also be treated as equal to a B.Sc. (I.T./C.S.) degree.

content_sections.heading: MPHC Stenographer Age Limit
content_sections.text: A candidate must have completed 18 years of age as on 01.01.2026. Because recruitment is being held in the year 2026, the age is calculated as on 01.01.2026. The maximum age limit is as follows. Ex-servicemen: The total defence service period already rendered will be deducted from the candidate's age, but the resulting age must not be more than three years above the maximum age limit. "Ex-servicemen" means ex-servicemen of Madhya Pradesh as defined in Rule 2(c) of the Madhya Pradesh Ex-Servicemen (Reservation of Vacancies in Civil Services and Posts, Class III and Class IV) Rules, 1985. Contract employees of the High Court/District Courts: Employees of the MP High Court or MP District Courts who have been working (or have worked) for at least 5 years on a contract post equivalent to, or in a higher category/post than, the vacant post get age relaxation equal to their contract service period, provided their age is not more than 55 years.

content_sections.heading: MPHC Stenographer Selection Process
content_sections.text: The MPHC Stenographer selection process has two stages: an Online Preliminary Examination (100 marks) and a Hindi Stenography/English Stenography Skill Test (100 marks). English Stenography is held for candidates who choose the Assistant Grade-III (English Knowing) post. The examination is common for all the posts and has multiple-choice (M.C.Q.) questions for a maximum of 100 marks, with 1 mark for each question. The duration is 120 minutes (2 hours). It may be held in one shift, or in more than one shift if required, at centres including Jabalpur, Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, Sagar, Satna and Ujjain (all, or one or more as required). If it is held in more than one shift, the question papers will be different. The date(s), time and centres will be published through a notice on the High Court website. The online preliminary exam date is "to be notified later". Admit cards will be available on the High Court website; the print-out facility is expected to be available about 7 days before the exam date. The candidate must enter the application number and password to download it. Proposed model answers will be displayed on the High Court website after the preliminary examination. Objections must be submitted offline within 7 days of the notice, during office hours (10:00 AM to 05:00 PM), to the Principal Registrar (Examination), Administrative Building, High Court of Madhya Pradesh, Jabalpur, in the prescribed format with self-attested copies of source documents. Objections received by e-mail or any other mode are not considered. For Stenographer Grade-II, Stenographer Grade-III and Stenographer Grade-III (Court Manager Staff), the result is prepared on the basis of marks in merit, and candidates up to a 1:5 ratio in each category (about 5 candidates per post, including all candidates with marks equal to the cut-off marks) are declared successful for the Hindi stenography skill test. For Assistant Grade-III (English Knowing), candidates in the same 1:5 ratio are declared successful for the English stenography skill test. The preliminary examination is screening only; its marks will not be considered at the time of the final result. Candidates who qualify must pay the ₹743.40 portal fee online to the service provider through a web link to be provided on the High Court website. Candidates who do not pay will be treated as unwilling for the skill test and their candidature will be cancelled. Candidates will be given a dictation of about 400 words in 5 minutes, followed by a separate 30 minutes for transcription. A mock dictation is given first, then the original dictation. Transcription is done on a computer; a keyboard is provided at the centre and candidates cannot bring their own computer, keyboard or chair. Hindi transcription must be done in Remington Gail. Extra time is given before the test to check the keyboard. A notebook is provided for noting down the dictation. If the dictation is written in long hand in the notebook, full marks will be deducted

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: 50* Graduate Apprentice 30* Technician (Diploma) Apprentice 115* Trade Apprentice (ITI) *Vacancies may vary. The official notification does not provide a trade-wise or discipline-wise split within each category, nor a category-wise (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD) reservation table – it only states that reservation will apply "as per provisions of the Apprentices Act 1961, Apprentice Rules 1992, and Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules 2019 & 2025."

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication (ECE), Instrumentation Engg., Electrical & Electronics (EEE), Computer Science (CSE), Mechanical, Chemical Engg., Metallurgical Engg., Safety Engg., Aeronautical Engg., Aerospace Engg., or Civil Engg.
Diploma in ECE, Instrumentation Engg., EEE, CSE, Mechanical, Chemical Engg., Metallurgical Engg., or Safety Engg.
ITI pass-out in Fitter, Welder, Turner, Machinist, Mechanic-Diesel, Electronic-Mechanic, Electrician, COPA (Computer Operator & Programming Assistant), Draughtsman (Mechanical), or Grinder

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Eligibility
content_sections.text: Educational qualification as per the category applied for (see vacancy table above), from an Indian Institution recognized by the appropriate statutory authority Only regular candidates who secured 70% marks or CGPA 7.5 and above in the qualifying examination (Graduate, Diploma, or ITI trade) for the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible to apply Candidates with a higher qualification than that prescribed for the category are not eligible to apply Candidates who have already undergone, or are currently undergoing, apprenticeship training under any organisation are not eligible Candidates with more than 1 year of work experience are not eligible Indian nationality required

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: Candidate should not be less than 18 years as on 01 September 2026 . Not specified in the official notification: any upper age limit.

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Stipend
content_sections.text: Stipend is paid as per Government norms (referenced to the Gazette Notification dated 03 September 2025 ) – the notification does not state the exact monthly stipend figures for each category. For Graduate and Technician (Diploma) Apprentices, it is mandatory to have an Aadhaar-seeded/linked bank account, as 50% of the stipend is paid by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) under the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) scheme.

content_sections.heading: RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on Academic Merit / Interview as required, subject to satisfactory document verification – there is no written test Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/EWS categories applies as per the Apprentices Act 1961, Apprentice Rules 1992, and the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules 2019 & 2025 Shortlisted candidates are informed only via the e-mail ID given in the application; candidates must keep it active throughout the selection process, as RCI is not responsible for non-receipt of communication due to a changed mobile number/e-mail Before commencement of training, selected candidates must execute a contract of apprenticeship on the respective portal (NATS/NAPS) Selected candidates must produce a valid Police Verification Certificate (from their place of last residence for at least 1 year, or permanent address) at the time of joining Not specified in the official notification: the exact academic-merit weightage formula, interview marks, or shortlisting ratio.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCI Apprentice Engagement 2027
content_sections.text: Important: Portal registration (NATS 2.0 or Apprenticeship India, as applicable to your category) is mandatory before applying. There is no separate offline or e-mail application route described for the main application itself.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (At Document Verification/Joining)
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form NATS/NAPS profile printout 10th class mark sheet and certificate Consolidated/final mark sheet of the qualifying examination Original/provisional certificate of the qualifying examination Caste certificate, if applicable PwD certificate, if applicable Valid EWS certificate, if applicable Any photo ID issued by Govt. of India (PAN Card/Voter ID/Driving Licence) Aadhaar Card (mandatory) Copy of Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook/statement (mandatory, Aadhaar-linked account required) Medical fitness certificate issued by a Government Civil Assistant Surgeon Two latest passport-size photographs All documents must be carried in original and self-attested copy .

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Document verification is done for shortlisted candidates only, prior to creation of the apprenticeship contract; any deviation from the desired qualification leads to rejection All qualifications must be from Indian Institutions recognized by the appropriate statutory authority Suppression of facts leads to disqualification at any stage of selection or during the apprenticeship period No TA/DA is paid to applicants called for any stage of the selection process Apprentices are not provided hostel accommodation, quarters, or transport by RCI, either during interview or during the apprenticeship period The engagement and training strictly follow the Apprentices Act 1961; there is no obligation for employment on completion of training Canvassing or personal follow-up for selection leads to immediate cancellation of candidature RCI reserves the right to terminate apprenticeship, or to amend/refix/cancel/suspend the selection process at any time, without assigning any reason; the Management's decision is final and binding, with no appeal entertained Selected candidates will not be allowed to withdraw from training except for reasons beyond their control, and must execute an apprenticeship contract on the respective portal before training begins Any legal dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of the Hon'ble High Court, Hyderabad, Telangana

Select the relevant Post Code and read the notification carefully before proceeding. Register and fill in personal, educational and category details in the online application form. Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (not earlier than three months) with clear front view, without cap, scarf or sunglasses. Upload all supporting documents/testimonials, duly self-attested, in a single PDF (maximum size 10 MB) at the appropriate row/column in the application. Pay the prescribed application fee online. Review and submit the application, then download and keep a printout of the confirmed application and fee receipt for reference. Important: Candidates must apply separately, with a separate application fee, for each post they wish to be considered for. Change of category is not allowed after submission of the online application. Application forms downloaded and submitted offline will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation/10th Standard or equivalent certificate indicating date of birth Higher Secondary/Class 12th (or equivalent) Board Certificate and Mark sheet UG/PG Degree/ITI/Diploma certificate (whichever applicable) along with mark sheets for all academic years Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) in the prescribed DoPT proforma, where applicable EWS certificate issued on or after 1 April 2025 (with family income and asset details as prescribed), where applicable Disability/Medical Certificate in the prescribed proforma, for PwBD applicants Discharge/Service Certificate, for Ex-Servicemen claiming age relaxation Experience certificate(s) from the Head(s) of Organization(s), if applicable Photo identity proof (Aadhaar Card/Voter ID Card/PAN Card/Driving Licence/Passport) Recent colour passport-size photograph and signature No Objection Certificate (NOC), for departmental candidates serving in Government/PSU/University employment

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: The number of posts advertised may increase or decrease as per Institute requirement; the Institute reserves the right to fill or not fill some or all advertised positions. Candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately, with a separate application fee, for each post; the Institute is not responsible for any clash in examination date, time or slot across posts. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the recruitment test or document verification. Original documents along with one set of self-attested copies must be produced at the time of document verification; candidature will be rejected outright at that stage if original certificates are not produced. Persons serving in State/Central Government/Semi-Govt./PSUs/Universities/Government Educational Institutions must bring a "No Objection Certificate" from their employer at the time of Document Verification, failing which they will not be allowed for Document Verification. Any vigilance/criminal/disciplinary case pending against a candidate working in Government/PSU/Autonomous body/University employment will result in the application not being considered. Selected candidates will be under probation for one year, subject to satisfactory completion as per NIT Statutes. Canvassing in any form, directly or on behalf of a candidate, will lead to disqualification. Malpractice, impersonation, use of unfair means, possession of mobile phones/electronic gadgets in the examination hall, or furnishing false/incomplete information can lead to summary cancellation of candidature or debarment, besides possible criminal/legal action. Legal disputes, if any, with NIT Agartala are to be dealt with in the jurisdiction of the Tripura High Court only. Regular staff of NIT Agartala who are otherwise eligible are allowed to participate in the selection process irrespective of age and percentage of marks, applicable to staff appointed before implementation of RRs including Model RRs (2012). Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) applying against Unreserved (UR) vacancies are not entitled to any relaxation in age, qualifying marks, or other concessions admissible to their category.

salary_details.pay_scale: As prescribed under the Apprentices Act/Rules and Corporation guidelines; amount not stated in the notification
salary_details.details: Stipend per month is payable as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, the Apprentices Rules 1992 (as amended) and the Corporation's guidelines. The exact amount is not stated in the notification. Other conditions in the notification: | Safety shoes (one pair) and a helmet are provided to apprentices under Codes 101, 103 and 107, wherever applicable, and are returnable on completion of training. No HRA or company accommodation is provided. Leave: General leave of 32 days (8 days per quarter, including medical grounds) and casual leave of 12 days per calendar year (pro-rata). Holidays observed by the establishment are available. Leave not availed lapses at the end of apprenticeship. Apprentices are covered under suitable accident insurance and the Certified Standing Orders applicable to workmen at the establishment. The training period may be extended under certain circumstances under Rule 7 of the Apprentices Rules 1992. IOCL has no obligation to offer employment after apprenticeship, and an apprentice cannot claim employment on that ground.

selection_process: There is no written test. Candidates registered on NAPS/NATS and applying against the notification are considered as follows.
Selection is on the percentage of marks
in descending order
in the prescribed qualification for the trade applied for (aggregate of all subjects of all years/semesters)
among candidates meeting the eligibility criteria. First-time apprenticeship applicants get preference. Tie-break: senior by date of birth first; if the date of birth is the same

higher Matriculation percentage. PwBD candidates who availed relaxation in qualification marks are considered against reserved seats irrespective of position in the select list (in order of merit within the category). Shortlisted candidates
subject to seats in each trade
are called for document verification and then pre-engagement medical examination. Filling of seats is at the management's discretion based on suitability
and no claim arises if seats remain unfilled. Finally shortlisted candidates whose documents and medical fitness certificate are in order are issued an offer of engagement.
how_to_apply: Both Step I and Step II must be completed. Applications with incomplete, incorrect or mismatching details, or with only one step done, are treated as invalid and summarily rejected.

Visit www.iocl.com from 28.09.2026. Go to 'What's New', then 'Engagement of Apprentices at Bongaigaon Refinery 2026-27 (II)', and click 'Detailed Advertisement of Bongaigaon Refinery' to read the advertisement.

Step I – NAPS/NATS: Have an active Apprentice Registration/Enrolment Number on the NAPS/NATS portal with a 100% correctly updated profile. For Codes 101 and 103, register on NAPS at https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in/, open 'Apprenticeship Opportunities', select the location as the IOCL Refinery Unit and the trade, and follow the portal steps. For Code 107, register on NATS/BOAT at https://nats.education.gov.in and apply to the IOCL Bongaigaon Refinery advertisement on your dashboard.
Apply using the Establishment ID of Bongaigaon Refinery: NATS – EASCHC000001; NAPS – E07191800001.
Check that your personal details, educational details, category and aggregate percentage appear correctly. Contact the NAPS/NATS office for corrections.

Step II – Microsoft Form: After applying, click 'Click here to submit additional information on Microsoft forms' on www.iocl.com and submit only one response. The form opens at 10:00 hours on 28.09.2026 and closes at 17:00 hours on 18.10.2026.

Apply for only one trade/discipline. Use the same email ID and mobile number as on NAPS/NATS; they must stay valid for the entire apprenticeship period (the notification also says at least the next one year). All communication is through the website, email and SMS alerts. Applications by any mode other than online are rejected.
important_instructions: Candidature is provisional and subject to verification. False or incorrect information leads to cancellation, possible criminal prosecution, and termination even after engagement. The apprenticeship agreement is registered online with the respective authorities. Canvassing in any form makes a candidate ineligible. Management's decision is final and binding on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and cancellation of the selection process. No correspondence is entertained. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the local Court at Chirang, for which the candidate has applied. Document verification calls and results are published on www.iocl.com and by email.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Bongaigaon Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The main eligibility conditions in the notification are listed below. The prescribed qualification must already be passed as on the date of reckoning (30.09.2026). Candidates whose result is awaited are not eligible. Only the Graduation/Diploma specified against the trade is eligible. Other branches or subjects are not considered, and no claim of an equivalent qualification is entertained. Candidates with part-time, correspondence or distance-mode qualifications are not eligible. Candidates with higher professional qualifications such as BE/B.Tech, MBA, CA, LLB, MCA or equivalent (or pursuing higher qualification and completing it on or before joining) are not eligible. A declaration is taken at engagement. Engineering Graduates, Diploma holders or Vocational Certificate holders with one year or more of job experience after the qualification are not eligible. Candidates who completed five years after acquiring the prescribed qualification as on 30.09.2026 are not eligible. A B.Sc candidate may apply for only one code (101 or 103). Applying for more than one trade/discipline leads to summary rejection. Preference is given to candidates applying for apprenticeship for the first time. Second-time candidates (different trade/discipline) are considered if first-time candidates are not available. Candidates whose earlier apprenticeship contract was terminated for failure on their part to carry out the contract terms are not eligible. Diploma holders under the lateral entry scheme (Class XII (Sc.)/ITI admitted in 2nd year of Diploma) are also eligible, subject to the prescribed percentage on the aggregate of all semesters. Minimum one year gap from completion of the previous apprenticeship, as on the date of reckoning. No gap needed if the previous contract was terminated due to failure on the part of the employer. Minimum three-month gap from termination if the candidate terminated the contract due to health or financial hardship, relocation, transportation, career change or language barrier. There is no waiting period for women. Such candidates must submit an Affidavit (Annexure–A) at document verification.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Bongaigaon Apprentice Qualification
content_sections.text: The qualification must be a regular full-time course from a recognised University/Institute in the relevant discipline, with minimum 50% aggregate marks (45% for SC/ST and PwBD candidates for seats reserved for them). Where CGPA/OGPA or letter grade is awarded, the equivalent aggregate percentage must be entered in the online application, and a conversion certificate from the University/Institute must be submitted at document verification. If the date of declaration of result is not on the mark sheet, a certificate from the Principal giving the result publication date is required.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Bongaigaon Apprentice Salary and Stipend
content_sections.text: Stipend per month is payable as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961/1973, the Apprentices Rules 1992 (as amended) and the Corporation's guidelines. The exact amount is not stated in the notification. Other conditions in the notification: Safety shoes (one pair) and a helmet are provided to apprentices under Codes 101, 103 and 107, wherever applicable, and are returnable on completion of training. No HRA or company accommodation is provided. Leave: General leave of 32 days (8 days per quarter, including medical grounds) and casual leave of 12 days per calendar year (pro-rata). Holidays observed by the establishment are available. Leave not availed lapses at the end of apprenticeship. Apprentices are covered under suitable accident insurance and the Certified Standing Orders applicable to workmen at the establishment. The training period may be extended under certain circumstances under Rule 7 of the Apprentices Rules 1992. IOCL has no obligation to offer employment after apprenticeship, and an apprentice cannot claim employment on that ground.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Bongaigaon Apprentice Reservation Policy
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), PwBD and EWS is in terms of the numbers shown in the seat table. Unfilled SC/ST seats may be filled by ST/SC candidates on merit; if still unfilled, first by OBC and then by unreserved candidates. Unfilled OBC seats may be filled by SC/ST candidates and then by unreserved candidates. Unfilled EWS seats may be filled by unreserved candidates. Unfilled PwBD seats may be filled by candidates meeting the minimum physical fitness standards in the Rules. All are on merit based on marks in the prescribed qualification. Minimum qualification marks are relaxed by 5% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates against reserved positions. PwBD reservation follows Section 34(1) of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and is horizontal, against notified seats in identified trades/disciplines. A person with a specified disability not covered under Section 34(1), certified as 40% or above, gets the concessions available to PwBDs but is selected only on merit against unreserved seats. OBC candidates must submit a caste certificate in the Govt. of India proforma stating they are not in the creamy layer (DoPT OM No. 36012/22/93-Estt.(SCT) dated 08-09-1993, OM No. 36036/2/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 30.05.2014 and OM No. 36033/1/2013-Estt.(Res.) as printed in the notification). Non-creamy layer status must be valid as on 30.09.2026. Creamy layer candidates should apply as UR. EWS candidates must submit an Income & Asset Certificate (DoPT OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 31.01.2019), or an undertaking if unavailable at document verification. Formats are on www.iocl.com. SC/ST/PwBD candidates called for document verification are reimbursed a single second class railway fare from the nearest railway station of the mailing address and back by the shortest route on production of the ticket, if the distance is at least 30 km. The candidate must submit a Disability Certificate from the competent authority as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017, or PwBD candidature is not considered. Section 2(r) of the RPwD Act 2016 defines a person with benchmark disability as certified with not less than 40% of a specified disability where not defined in measurable terms, and a disability defined in measurable terms. Because petroleum refining is a complex and hazardous process, PwBDs can be engaged only in identified seats and select disciplines. Apprentices in these categories may be engaged: PV – Low vision, Blind PH – Hard of hearing, Deaf PL – Musculoskeletal (OH-OA/OL), Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victim, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured Multiple Disabilities (a combination of the above) Abbreviations: P = Physical; V = Vision; H = Hearing; L = Locomotors; OH = Orthopaedic Handicap; OA = One Arm; OL = One Leg. Deployment of PwBDs with other disabilities is not included, as it may put them at risk in a hazardous industry.

content_sections.heading: IOCL Bongaigaon Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written test . Candidates registered on NAPS/NATS and applying against the notification are considered as follows. Selection is on the percentage of marks, in descending order, in the prescribed qualification for the trade applied for (aggregate of all subjects of all years/semesters), among candidates meeting the eligibility criteria. First-time apprenticeship applicants get preference. Tie-break: senior by date of birth first; if the date of birth is the same, higher Matriculation percentage. PwBD candidates who availed relaxation in qualification marks are considered against reserved seats irrespective of position in the select list (in order of merit within the category). Shortlisted candidates, subject to seats in each trade, are called for document verification and then pre-engagement medical examination. Filling of seats is at the management's discretion based on suitability, and no claim arises if seats remain unfilled. Finally shortlisted candidates whose documents and medical fitness certificate are in order are issued an offer of engagement.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for IOCL Bongaigaon Apprentice Document Verification
content_sections.text: Originals with a self-attested copy are needed: 10th Pass/Matriculation certificate from the concerned board as proof of date of birth. Class XII marksheet; semester-wise/year-wise mark sheets of Graduation/Diploma in Engineering. Graduation/Diploma certificate. Conversion certificate from CGPA/OGPA/Letter Grade to percentage, if applicable. Principal's certificate of result publication date, if applicable. It must also state that the course was completed in regular full-time mode and give the candidate's good conduct. SC/ST/Disability/OBC (NCL) certificate with declaration, or EWS Income & Asset Certificate/declaration, in the prescribed format (on www.iocl.com) from the Competent Authority. Print of NATS/NAPS portal registration with applicant details. Affidavit (Annexure–A) confirming compliance with the eligibility conditions. Any other certificate/document as specified. One original Photo ID: Aadhar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID Card, Driving License or Passport.

content_sections.heading: Medical Fitness and Declarations
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must meet the physical fitness standards under the Apprentices Act and amendments. Candidates should read the 'Guidelines and Criteria for pre-engagement medical examinations' on www.iocl.com. PwBD medical examination follows the RPwD Act, 2016. Only candidates declared fit are engaged. Candidates with reported ailments, deficiencies or abnormalities must declare them in the application. Candidates declared unfit in a medical examination by any refinery unit or PSU, while seeking apprenticeship or regular employment in the past, must declare it with reasons. Candidates must declare if they have been arrested, prosecuted, detained, fined, convicted by a court, or debarred/disqualified by any Public Service Commission.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IOCL Bongaigaon Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Both Step I and Step II must be completed. Applications with incomplete, incorrect or mismatching details, or with only one step done, are treated as invalid and summarily rejected. Apply for only one trade/discipline. Use the same email ID and mobile number as on NAPS/NATS; they must stay valid for the entire apprenticeship period (the notification also says at least the next one year). All communication is through the website, email and SMS alerts. Applications by any mode other than online are rejected.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions and General Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidature is provisional and subject to verification. False or incorrect information leads to cancellation, possible criminal prosecution, and termination even after engagement. The apprenticeship agreement is registered online with the respective authorities. Canvassing in any form makes a candidate ineligible. Management's decision is final and binding on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection and cancellation of the selection process. No correspondence is entertained. It carries the candidate's signature, name and NAPS/NATS registration number.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess one of the following qualifications in the relevant engineering discipline: A full-time Degree in Engineering or Technology granted by a statutory university. A full-time Degree in Engineering or Technology granted by an institution empowered by an Act of Parliament to award such a degree. A graduate examination conducted by a professional body and recognized by the Central or State Government as equivalent to the prescribed qualification. Candidates must possess one of the following qualifications in the relevant engineering discipline: A full-time Diploma in Engineering or Technology granted by a State Council or Board of Technical Education. A full-time Diploma in Engineering or Technology granted by a university. A Diploma in Engineering or Technology granted by an institution recognized by the Central or State Government as equivalent to the prescribed qualification.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply?
content_sections.text: The candidate must belong to Tamil Nadu. The relevant Degree or Diploma must have been completed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or May 2026. The candidate must hold a full-time qualification in the relevant engineering discipline. The candidate must be registered on the NATS portal. The candidate must enter the qualification percentage correctly in the NATS profile.

content_sections.heading: Who Is Not Eligible?
content_sections.text: The following candidates are not eligible to apply: Candidates who have already completed NATS or NAPS apprenticeship training. Candidates who are currently undergoing NATS or NAPS apprenticeship training. Candidates possessing one year or more of work experience. Candidates who do not belong to Tamil Nadu. Candidates who completed the qualification before 2022.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit will be followed according to the applicable Apprenticeship Rules. The notification does not provide a separate minimum or maximum age.

content_sections.heading: Training Duration
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training period will be one year under the Apprenticeship Amendment Act, 1973. Completion of the apprenticeship does not create any right to regular employment in CMWSSB. The organization is not obligated to offer employment after the training period.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention an application fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the following stages: Shortlisting based on the percentage of marks obtained in the prescribed Degree or Diploma qualification. Notification of shortlisted candidates through their registered email address. Certificate verification at CMWSSB, Chennai. No written examination or interview is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Reservation
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC, ST, OBC and PwD candidates will be followed according to the Apprentices Act and applicable government rules. Candidates claiming reservation must produce a valid certificate in the prescribed government format. BC and MBC candidates claiming OBC Non-Creamy Layer reservation must produce an OBC-NCL certificate in the approved format.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMWSSB Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the NATS 2.0 portal . Log in using the registered email address and password. Open the “Apply Against Advertised Vacancies” section. Search for “Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board.” Open the establishment with user ID STNCHS000035 . Check the qualification details and click the Apply option. Confirm that the application status shows “Applied.” Visit nats.education.gov.in . Select the Student option. Click Student Register. Complete the registration and application form. Obtain the 12-digit NATS enrolment number. Log in using the registered email address and password. Open “Apply Against Advertised Vacancies.” Search for “Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board.” Select establishment user ID STNCHS000035 and apply.

faq.answer: AWTM Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment drive announced by the Academy of Weapon Technology and Management, Ichapur, to fill 40 contract vacancies across various trades like Fitter, Machinist, Turner, Electroplater, and Heat Treatment Operator.

faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (Class 10) along with an NTC or NAC certificate issued by NCTVT in the relevant trade specific to the post applied for.
