Selection is carried out as per extant guidelines of the Competent Authority. The stages are as follows.

Screening of applications: Naval Dockyard Mumbai will not carry out detailed scrutiny of online applications before the examination. Detailed scrutiny of documents is done at a subsequent stage. Shortlisting: Fulfilling the basic criteria does not automatically entitle a candidate to the written examination. If applications are too many in proportion to vacancies
the authority may shortlist applications

in the ratio of 1:25 for every available vacancy in each trade and category. Merit calculation: Equal weightage (50:50) is given to marks in Class 10th from a recognised Board and marks in the ITI consolidated statement of marks for AITT issued by NCVET. For Crane Operator (SI)
100% weightage is given to Class 10th. For Rigger
100% weightage is given to Class 8th. Written examination: Objective type
OMR format
as described below. Medical examination: Selected candidates must submit a medical fitness certificate from a Government hospital before being engaged

as per Rule 4 and Schedule II of the Apprentices Rules. Document verification: Original documents uploaded on the portal are verified by Dockyard Apprentice School. Dates for verification and joining are intimated by email to selected candidates.
The written test has 100 questions of one mark each
is bilingual (English and Hindi)
and its questions match the Class 10th standard syllabus for all trades except Rigger
which follows the 8th standard syllabus. The exam is likely to be held on one day in one shift for all trades. Details of negative marking are not specified in the notification.
The exact date

time and venue are communicated to shortlisted candidates on registered email IDs and through the portal. The e-admit card must be downloaded from the portal. The exam is to be conducted in Mumbai and its suburban districts such as Thane
Kandivali etc.
Marks in the written examination are considered first. If written exam marks are the same
the older candidate (by date of birth) ranks higher. If date of birth is also the same
alphabetical order of the first name is considered.
PwBD candidates with disability of 40% and above: A scribe is given to candidates with blindness
locomotor disability (both arms affected – BA) and cerebral palsy if desired. For other benchmark disabilities

a certificate of physical limitation to write and need of a scribe is required from the Chief Medical Officer / Civil Surgeon / Medical Superintendent of a Government health care institution (Appendix I
MoSJE OM 34-02/2015-DD-III dated 29 Aug 2018). If the candidate brings their own scribe
the scribe's qualification must be one step below the candidate's

and details are submitted in the proforma at Appendix II of the same OM. PwD candidates with disability less than 40%: Scribe and/or compensatory time is granted only to those having difficulty in writing
on a certificate from the competent medical authority of a Government health care institution (Appendix I
MoSJE OM F. No. 29-6/2019-DD-III dated 10 Aug 2022). Own-scribe rules are the same
with the proforma at Appendix II of that OM. PwBD candidates with medical categories other than blindness
locomotor disability (both arms affected – BA) and cerebral palsy
who need a scribe
must carry the relevant original medical certificate to the examination
failing which the scribe and compensatory time may not be allowed.

how_to_apply: Visit https://www.apprenticeshipregistration.com and download the online application guidelines before filling in the form.

Check that you meet the educational qualification and other criteria. Candidates from a Board or institution using the grade point system must get grade points converted into percentage of marks by the appropriate authority, or use a conversion chart from the respective Board. If unavailable, the lowest percentage of the grade point will be considered for shortlisting.
Keep your valid and active email ID and mobile number ready. No change in the email ID or mobile number is allowed once entered.
Write your Name and Date of Birth strictly as given in the matriculation certificate. Otherwise the candidature may be cancelled.
Upload the photograph, signature and documents listed above in the required formats and sizes.
Remember the password set during registration; further login is possible only with it.
Submit the application within the registration window and take a printout of the application form for personal record. No copy needs to be sent anywhere.
Download the E-admit card from the portal when released.

Candidates may apply for more than one designated trade in the same application. The examination centre for each may be one or different and may fall on the same day/shift. If two trades fall in the same shift, the candidate can appear for only one trade of his/her choice. If two exams are in different shifts on the same day, the candidate must reach the allotted centre.
important_instructions: Previous training: Candidates undergoing apprenticeship in any Govt./Public Sector/Private industrial organisation must terminate their ongoing contract through the MSDE Portal before applying, and must have fulfilled any cooling down criterion if applicable. Multiple applications: Do not submit multiple applications. If more than one is submitted, the one with the higher application number, if complete in all respects, is the only one considered. Provisional candidature: Applications are accepted provisionally. False or incorrect information leads to cancellation without prejudice to legal action. Caste certificates: SC/ST candidates must hold a latest caste certificate and produce the original on demand. OBC candidates must produce a valid caste certificate stating they do not belong to the creamy layer, in the format under GoI DoP&T OM 36033/1/2013-Estt(Res) dated 27 May 2013 and 36036/2/2013-Estt.(Res) dated 30 May 2014. If the OBC(NCL) certificate is not in the prescribed format or outside its validity period, the candidate is treated as General. Applying early: Apply well before the closing date. Naval Dockyard Mumbai is not responsible for mistakes in the online application or for non-receipt of communication on the registered mobile number/email. At the exam centre: Carry the admit card and an original photo ID (passport / Aadhaar / Driving licence / Govt. issued ID). Late reporting after the time on the admit card is not permitted. The name on the admit card is as per the matriculation certificate (Class VIIIth mark sheet for Rigger). If the name was changed and published in the official gazette after Class 10, a copy of the gazette must be given to the invigilator. Check the admit card for discrepancies before the exam; no correspondence is entertained after the examination. Exam conduct: Mobiles and electronic gadgets are banned in the premises, even in switch-off mode. Companions are not allowed at the venue or in its proximity. Candidates must arrange their own lodging/boarding and avoid bringing valuables. Results: Results of the written examination are published online through the portal. The option of opting out of personal information must be exercised at the time of filling up the online application. Hostel: Limited hostel facility for boys only, allocated on merit with first preference to outstation candidates; if vacant, it may be extended to local candidates (proof of current address required). There is no hostel or lodging facility for female candidates. Employment after training: Naval Dockyard Mumbai is not obliged to offer employment after training, and the apprentice is not obliged to accept. Ex-Naval Apprentices can apply for Tradesman Skilled in Naval Dockyards per recruitment rules, subject to the upper age limit for that post, which also applies to those applying for Tradesman Skilled in the Indian Navy. Updates: Check the portal regularly for updates, corrigendum and further instructions. Orders, circulars and formats of certificates are available on the portal under Reference Documents. Queries and grievances: Send queries to the help desk email [email protected] within seven days of uploading of the provisionally eligible merit list for written examination and the provisional select list. No queries are accepted after the seven days. The notification also prints Helpdesk Number 971842361.

Candidates found guilty of the following can be summarily cancelled at any stage of enrolment, apart from criminal action, and debarred from Naval Dockyard Mumbai examinations for the period below. The Naval Dockyard can also cancel candidature on any other ground it considers sufficient, or for any irregular or improper means.

The notification warns candidates to beware of touts and job racketeers who may falsely promise selection for illegal consideration. Selection is purely on merit, no money is required to be paid to anyone, and the written test and selection process are stated to be strictly on merit and transparent. For any grievance or assistance, candidates may email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: Naval Dockyard Mumbai Apprentice Reservation Policy
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC and ST is as per Schedule II A of the Apprentice Rules, 1992, and for OBC (NCL) as per Maharashtra Act No. VIII of 2004. Reserved vacancies are filled separately from eligible SC, ST and OBC candidates, who are either lower in merit than the last candidate on the merit list of the UR category or SC/ST/OBC (NCL) candidates who have availed age relaxation, irrespective of their position in the merit list. Reserved vacancies for PwBD and ESM are filled from eligible candidates of the respective category who are lower in merit than the last candidate on the merit list of that category but otherwise found suitable for appointment even by relaxed standard. PwBD and ESM reservations are horizontal and cut across the vertical SC/ST/OBC(NCL) reservation (inter-locking reservation). Candidates selected against PwBD and ESM quota are placed in the appropriate category of UR/SC/ST/OBC(NCL), as the case may be. PwBD reservation follows MSDE-4/3/2023-AP(PMU) dated 11 Apr 25 regarding applicability of the RPwD Act 2016 to ATS and trade-wise suitability of PwBD. Persons with SD/SI with associated limb dysfunction are covered under the respective sub-category of LD, as the case may be. Horizontal reservation for Ex-Servicemen categories applies to the following, as per Para 3.6.3 of the Apprenticeship Training Manual: Children of deceased/disabled Ex-Servicemen including those killed/disabled during peace time Children of Ex-Servicemen Children of Serving Jawans Children of Serving Officers Ex-Servicemen Abbreviations used in the notification: UR – Unreserved; SC – Scheduled Caste; ST – Scheduled Tribes; OBC (NCL) – Other Backward Class (Non Creamy Layer); PwBD – Person with Benchmark Disabilities; ESM – Ex-Serviceman. Physical requirement suitability for PwBDs is as identified by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment notification No. 38-16-2020-DD-III dated 04 Jan 2021, amended vide notification No. 30-12/2020-DD-III dated 24 Aug 2022. Abbreviations: LD – Locomotor Disability; CP – Cerebral Palsy; LC – Leprosy Cured; DW – Dwarfism; AAV – Acid Attack Victims; B – Blindness; LV – Low Vision; D – Deaf; HH – Hard of Hearing; ASD (M, MoD) – Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild, Moderate); ID – Intellectual Disability; SLD – Specific Learning Disability; MI – Mental Illness; MD – Multiple Disabilities; SD – Spinal Deformity; SI – Spinal Injury. PwBD candidates must hold a disability certificate issued by the Competent Authority, in the prescribed format under Rule 18(1) of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment Notification G.S.R 591(E) dated 15 Jun 2017, before applying online. The format is available on the portal under Important Documents. To avail reservation, the certificate must show 40% or above disability.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Naval Dockyard Mumbai Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit https://www.apprenticeshipregistration.com and download the online application guidelines before filling in the form. Check that you meet the educational qualification and other criteria. Candidates from a Board or institution using the grade point system must get grade points converted into percentage of marks by the appropriate authority, or use a conversion chart from the respective Board. If unavailable, the lowest percentage of the grade point will be considered for shortlisting. Keep your valid and active email ID and mobile number ready. No change in the email ID or mobile number is allowed once entered. Write your Name and Date of Birth strictly as given in the matriculation certificate. Otherwise the candidature may be cancelled. Upload the photograph, signature and documents listed above in the required formats and sizes. Remember the password set during registration; further login is possible only with it. Submit the application within the registration window and take a printout of the application form for personal record. No copy needs to be sent anywhere. Download the E-admit card from the portal when released. Candidates may apply for more than one designated trade in the same application. The examination centre for each may be one or different and may fall on the same day/shift. If two trades fall in the same shift, the candidate can appear for only one trade of his/her choice. If two exams are in different shifts on the same day, the candidate must reach the allotted centre.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Candidates
content_sections.text: Previous training: Candidates undergoing apprenticeship in any Govt./Public Sector/Private industrial organisation must terminate their ongoing contract through the MSDE Portal before applying, and must have fulfilled any cooling down criterion if applicable. Multiple applications: Do not submit multiple applications. If more than one is submitted, the one with the higher application number, if complete in all respects, is the only one considered. Provisional candidature: Applications are accepted provisionally. False or incorrect information leads to cancellation without prejudice to legal action. Caste certificates: SC/ST candidates must hold a latest caste certificate and produce the original on demand. OBC candidates must produce a valid caste certificate stating they do not belong to the creamy layer, in the format under GoI DoP&T OM 36033/1/2013-Estt(Res) dated 27 May 2013 and 36036/2/2013-Estt.(Res) dated 30 May 2014. If the OBC(NCL) certificate is not in the prescribed format or outside its validity period, the candidate is treated as General. Applying early: Apply well before the closing date. Naval Dockyard Mumbai is not responsible for mistakes in the online application or for non-receipt of communication on the registered mobile number/email. At the exam centre: Carry the admit card and an original photo ID (passport / Aadhaar / Driving licence / Govt. issued ID). Late reporting after the time on the admit card is not permitted. The name on the admit card is as per the matriculation certificate (Class VIIIth mark sheet for Rigger). If the name was changed and published in the official gazette after Class 10, a copy of the gazette must be given to the invigilator. Check the admit card for discrepancies before the exam; no correspondence is entertained after the examination. Exam conduct: Mobiles and electronic gadgets are banned in the premises, even in switch-off mode. Companions are not allowed at the venue or in its proximity. Candidates must arrange their own lodging/boarding and avoid bringing valuables. Results: Results of the written examination are published online through the portal. The option of opting out of personal information must be exercised at the time of filling up the online application. Hostel: Limited hostel facility for boys only, allocated on merit with first preference to outstation candidates; if vacant, it may be extended to local candidates (proof of current address required). There is no hostel or lodging facility for female candidates. Employment after training: Naval Dockyard Mumbai is not obliged to offer employment after training, and the apprentice is not obliged to accept. Ex-Naval Apprentices can apply for Tradesman Skilled in Naval Dockyards per recruitment rules, subject to the upper age limit for that post, which also applies to those applying for Tradesman Skilled in the Indian Navy. Updates: Check the portal regularly for updates, corrigendum and further instructions. Orders, circulars and forma

content_sections.text: The Selection Committee may select candidates either by a direct interview or by an objective test (multiple-choice questions) followed by an interview on the same day. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR IHBT Project Associate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check the position code that matches your qualification and age. Download the prescribed application form from www.ihbt.res.in . Fill it in and affix a recent coloured passport-size photograph, cross-signed. Attach self-attested photocopies of age, qualification and experience certificates. Apply separately for each position code if you want to apply for more than one. Reach CSIR-IHBT, Palampur by 09:30 AM on the interview date for your code, with the original certificates. No travelling allowance is paid. There is no online application in this notification. Candidates apply offline by attending the walk-in interview with the filled form. The engagement is temporary and co-terminus with the project tenure or 6 years, whichever is earlier. It gives no right or claim to a regular post at CSIR or CSIR-IHBT. Performance is reviewed every six months, and unsatisfactory staff may be terminated. Project end dates range from 31.03.2027 to 31.03.2029, depending on the project.

The required two-year experience must be post-qualification experience. Application must be submitted online within the prescribed dates. Candidates should enter reservation category and sub-category correctly in the online application. Reservation benefits will be available only to eligible candidates who produce valid certificates according to Uttarakhand Government rules. Candidates claiming Uttarakhand reservation benefits must meet the applicable State eligibility conditions. Applicants must ensure that the information entered in the online form matches their original certificates. Any false information or discrepancy may result in cancellation of candidature. After the last date, candidates will be given a specified correction period from 28 November to 30 November 2026. The Commission will publish admit cards online. Admit cards will not be sent by post. Candidates should regularly visit the UKSSSC website for examination information and other updates. Mobile phones, calculators, pagers, scanners or other prohibited electronic devices are not permitted inside the examination centre. Candidates must follow all examination-centre security and identification instructions. Physical fitness conditions prescribed for Government service will apply. Reservation, horizontal reservation and certificate requirements will be governed by the rules and Government Orders cited in the notification. The advertised number of vacancies and category-wise distribution may be changed according to departmental requirements and applicable Government rules.

Ex-servicemen and Armed Forces Personnel (or their children) must produce a discharge certificate, or an Armed Forces serving certificate in the case of children of serving personnel, at the time of Document Verification. Ex-servicemen candidates are placed in their appropriate category (UR/SC/ST/OBC); if UR vacancies under the Ex-servicemen quota are unavailable, Ex-servicemen belonging to communities where vacancies are available will be considered.

how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online only, by visiting www.rrcjaipur.in, between 7 October 2026 and 6 November 2026 (23:59 hrs). No physical copy of the application needs to be sent to RRC, and any physical copy received will not be given cognisance. The broad process is:

Log in and fill personal details: Log on to the RRC/Jaipur website and carefully fill in personal details/bio-data, including a valid 12-digit Aadhaar Card number (the original Aadhaar card must be produced at Document Verification).

Select one unit only: Candidates must choose only one Division/Unit from the 8 listed, and should carefully check that a training slot exists for their specific ITI trade in that unit before selecting it, since changes are not allowed after final submission.
Upload photograph: A recent colour photograph (3.5 cm × 3.5 cm, not older than 3 months, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 KB–70 KB) with a clear front view, without cap or sunglasses.
Upload signature: A scanned signature (3.5 cm × 2.5 cm, JPG/JPEG format, 100 DPI, file size 20 KB–30 KB).

Pay the application fee: Pay the applicable fee (see Fee section above) through the integrated payment gateway, after verifying that all application details are correct, since no changes are allowed after payment.
Download and retain printout: After successful submission, download and keep a printout of the application; this will be required at the time of Document Verification, if shortlisted.

Candidates must ensure their name, father's name, and date of birth exactly match their Matriculation (or equivalent) certificate - any deviation found during Document Verification will lead to cancellation of candidature and debarment. Candidates should also provide an active mobile number and valid email ID, since all important communication will be sent via SMS/email.
important_instructions: Candidates may apply for only one unit; submitting more than one application with different particulars (name, father's name, community, photo, qualification, email, or mobile number) will result in summary rejection of all such applications. The decision of the Railway administration on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, and mode of selection is final. Imparting training on the Railway does not confer any right to absorption/employment on the Railway after successful completion of training; per the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, it is not obligatory for the employer to offer employment, nor for the apprentice to accept it, upon completion of training. No correspondence regarding engagement will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature, and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard. Candidates should ensure they fulfil all eligibility criteria before applying; if erroneously engaged, such candidates will be summarily dismissed without notice at any stage. For help with online submission or printing of the application, candidates can call the helpline number published on the website from 7 October 2026, available 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM (except Sundays and holidays) until the last date of application.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Co-Lead Job Description
content_sections.text: The Co-Lead positions involve heading specialized strategic functional domains, spearheading large-scale nationwide digital interventions, handholding Central Ministries and State/UT Governments, collaborating with industry, academia, and startups, and driving proactive Business Development and institutional partnerships for NeGD services and digital public platforms. Co-Lead – Digital Transformation & Strategy: Establish digital governance roadmap, draft techno-legal frameworks, provide technical and process advisory, handle solution architecture, monitor digital governance projects, provide cross-tech advisory (AI, Cloud, IoT, GIS), lead business development, conduct stakeholder engagement, and create procurement advisory models. Co-Lead – Digital Infrastructure & Cyber Security: Advise ministries on cyber security policies and incident response, support secure cloud and infrastructure adoption, facilitate new engagements for advisory services, review DPRs and security architectures, draft RFPs and SLAs for security services, and plan cyber security capacity building initiatives. Co-Lead – Emerging Technologies: Lead technical conceptualization and pilot development of AI/ML and Generative AI applications, integrate cross-disciplinary emerging technologies (Blockchain, IoT, Drones/GIS), engage with ministries for emerging tech deployments, define ethical AI frameworks, organize hackathons, and appraise AI/ML DPRs. Co-Lead – Data Analytics & Business Intelligence (BI): Architect and oversee Big Data analytics platforms and data lakes, define enterprise data integration and ETL/ELT pipelines, direct rollout of executive BI dashboards, lead business development for analytics requirements, establish data governance protocols, and formulate model RFPs for Big Data platforms.

content_sections.heading: CWC Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The online examination includes objective tests and an English descriptive test. Each post has a separately prescribed distribution of questions and subjects. The total comprises 200 objective questions carrying 200 marks and 2 descriptive questions carrying 30 marks . The exact subject-wise distribution depends on the post. Negative Marking: One-fourth of the marks assigned to each incorrectly answered objective question will be deducted. No penalty applies to unanswered questions. Qualifying Marks: The minimum qualifying marks for the Professional/Subject Knowledge section, wherever applicable, and the English descriptive test are 40% for unreserved candidates and 35% for OBC/EWS/SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-servicemen candidates.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-I Job Description
content_sections.text: The institute is looking for an experienced school teacher who can deliver high-quality STEM sessions and critically evaluate how well the kits enable concept learning in real classrooms. This is a field-intensive role focused on testing and improving hands-on STEM learning kits in real classrooms and is not a conventional classroom teaching role. Core Responsibilities: Conduct live classroom sessions (Grades 6–8) using STEM kits across partner schools. Observe student thinking, responses, and misconceptions. Work with curriculum and product teams to refine kits. Support teacher training and demonstrations.

content_sections.heading: Oil India Superintending Research Scientist Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: For Grade A & Grade B Posts (Table I & II): Computer Based Test (CBT) carrying 100 marks (85% weightage) and Personal Interview (PI) carrying 15 marks (15% weightage). content_sections.heading: Oil India Superintending Research Scientist Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The total duration of the Computer Based Test (CBT) is 1 hour and 30 minutes. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour is provided to PwBD candidates. Qualifying Marks for CBT (Grades A & B - Table I & II): 50 out of 100 for UR, OBC(NCL) & EWS posts; 40 out of 100 for SC, ST & PwBD posts. Qualifying Marks for CBT (Table III): 50 out of 100 for UR and OBC (NCL); 40 out of 100 for PwBD. Final Score Formula (Grades A & B): (CBT Marks obtained out of 100 × 0.85) + PI Marks obtained out of 15.

content_sections.heading: Oil India Superintending Research Scientist Job Description 2026
content_sections.text: Superintending Research Scientist: Conducting research, analytical, experimental, and technology development activities including laboratory, pilot-scale, field validation, and scale-up studies; designing, executing, and evaluating research projects; operating laboratory and pilot plant equipment; ensuring HSE compliance. Hindi Officer: Implementation and promotion of Official Language (Rajbhasha) policies; translation of official documents between Hindi and English; monitoring and reporting on Official Language implementation. Confidential Secretary: Managing confidential correspondence, scheduling and coordination of meetings, handling office documentation, liaison with internal and external stakeholders, and proficiency in Shorthand and transcription.

Verify Mobile Number and Email ID using the separate OTPs sent. Re-login using the received User ID and Password to complete Step-II, filling in Personal, Additional, Communication, and Qualification Details. Upload scanned digital image of recent passport-size photograph (100 KB to 200 KB) and signature in black ink (80 KB to 150 KB). Preview the application form and submit it before final redirection to SBI e-Pay Lite payment gateway. Pay the applicable application fee and take a printout of the submitted Application Form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Product Manager (AI) Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be responsible for the following key areas: Define and own the end-to-end product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-driven government services within the owned pod cluster. Lead product discovery, market research, and user research to identify citizen pain points and opportunities for AI intervention. Translate complex business requirements and government use cases into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Oversee complete product lifecycle from ideation through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement for 8–10 concurrent AI initiatives. Manage cross-functional collaboration between AI/ML engineers, data scientists, MLOps, UX designers, business analysts, and government stakeholders. Define and track key product metrics (KPIs, OKRs) including user adoption, accuracy, response times, cost per transaction, and citizen satisfaction scores. Manage product budgets, resource allocation, vendor evaluation, and contract negotiations. Ensure Responsible AI principles are applied, including ethical AI deployment, bias mitigation, transparency, and compliance with MeitY guidelines. Own the programme risk register and drive mitigation of delivery, technical, agency, and compliance risks.

content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the essential educational qualifications, experience, and certification criteria prescribed for each specific post:

rows.post_name: Senior Cyber Security Consultant Grade-2 (Team Lead)
rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: B.Tech. (CSE/IT/EC) or MCA with 8–10 years of relevant experience in Cyber Security. Must possess at least one globally recognized professional certification such as CEH, CISSP, or CISM, and have a minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience in the Central Government and/or Central Public Sector Undertakings (CPSUs/PSUs). Requires Technical Administrator Course/Training Certificate (TM Apex Central/ Apex One/SC-200) and minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in deployment, administration, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and management of Anti-APT solutions, EDR, XDR, threat intelligence integration, malware analysis, and incident response.

B.Tech. (CSE/IT/EC/EIC) or MCA with 3 years of relevant experience in Network. Must possess at least one globally recognized professional certification such as CCNA or CCNP, and have a minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in the Central Government and/or Central Public Sector Undertakings (CPSUs/PSUs). Requires hands-on experience in Cisco Enterprise Routers, Cisco Catalyst L2/L3 Switches, HP/Aruba Switches, Fortinet/Palo Alto/Checkpoint Firewalls, Proxy Solutions, Anti-DDoS Solutions, Enterprise Wi-Fi, Cisco Video Conferencing, TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, OSPF, BGP, Static Routing, VLAN, QoS, ACL, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and Network Monitoring Tools.

B.Tech. (CSE/IT/EC/EIC) or MCA with 3 years of relevant experience. Must possess at least one globally recognized professional certification, such as CCNA or CCNP. Requires essential skills in Government e-Governance ecosystem, NIC Applications, eOffice, MeghRaj Cloud, Linux & Windows Server basics, Database (MySQL/PostgreSQL/MSSQL), DNS & SSL Management, Digital Signature (DSC), Government Cloud Operations Support, Application Deployment, ITIL Incident Management, and Helpdesk Operations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The initial engagement is for a period of two (02) years, and it is further extendable by one (01) additional year subject to satisfactory performance, continued functional requirement, and approval of the Competent Authority. In no case shall the appointment be extended beyond three years from the initial date of appointment. The monthly remuneration is Rs. 1,45,000 for Consultant Grade-2 and Rs. 70,000 for Young Professional posts, with necessary TDS deducted as per rules. No other separate monthly allowances, HRA, residential accommodation, CGHS, medical reimbursement, personal support staff, or transport facilities shall be provided. Annual review of remuneration allows for an enhancement of up to 5% (or up to 10% in exceptional cases of exemplary performance and policy contributions) upon recommendations of the Performance Review Committee.

content_sections.heading: Department of Fisheries Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The engaged consultants will perform specialized technical duties across IT infrastructure and cyber security cells, which include: Planning, implementing, operating, and continuously improving the cyber security posture of the Department of Fisheries. Managing and monitoring Security Operations Centre (SOC) activities, security events through EDR, UEM, SIEM, and SOAR tools, and investigating alerts. Conducting malware analysis, threat hunting, digital forensics, and incident response (DFIR). Administering enterprise network infrastructure including routers, switches, next-generation firewalls, proxy servers, anti-DDoS solutions, and wireless networks. Providing complete support for NIC-hosted applications and services such as eOffice, Bharat VC, email (@gov.in), Sandes, and MeghRaj cloud services. Providing end-to-end cyber security and IT infrastructure support during high-level government meetings, VIP events, PRAGATI, and interactions involving the PMO and Cabinet Secretariat.

faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies: 1 post for Technical Assistant and 1 post for Research Associate I.

faq.answer: The last date to send applications by email is 27 October 2026, which is within 14 days of the advertisement date of 13 October 2026.

faq.answer: Candidates must hold BTech/BE degrees in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or MSc in Biotechnology, Botany, or Chemistry, or a 03-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology with 2 years of experience (or equivalent) with a minimum of 6.0 CGPA or 55% marks.

faq.answer: Eligible candidates must send an updated CV along with self-attested educational and experience certificates and publication lists to [email protected] with the specified subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting of applications followed by an offline personal interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q1. What is NIT Warangal Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NIT Warangal Faculty Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification (NITW/FR-2/2026) issued by the National Institute of Technology Warangal to fill 34 faculty positions across various departments at different pay levels.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 34 vacancies are available, comprising 1 for Professor, 3 for Associate Professor, 6 for Assistant Professor Grade I, and 24 for Assistant Professor Grade II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the online application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30 November 2026 up to 11:59 PM IST.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the respective discipline with First Class in preceding degrees (UG and PG, or direct Ph.D. after BE/B.Tech with First Class at the Bachelor's level).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Unreserved, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is ₹2000 for Unreserved, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates, ₹1000 for SC/ST/PwD candidates, and $50 for Indian citizens applying from abroad.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances like HRA provided on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, dearness allowance, transport allowance, and house rent allowance (if campus accommodation is not available) are provided as applicable to Central Government Employees.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible for age relaxations and category certificates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS, and PwD categories receive age relaxations and reservation benefits as per Government of India norms, subject to submitting valid prescribed certificates.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: The Institute conducts scrutiny, shortlisting based on cumulative essential credit points, written tests, presentations of teaching and research seminars, and personal interviews before a duly constituted selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates apply for more than one faculty position?
faq.answer: Yes, separate applications must be submitted if an applicant is applying for more than one faculty position.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Each post under APPSC Recruitment 2026 has its own educational qualification requirement. Candidates must possess the required qualification as on the date of the Detailed Notification. Full eligibility, including age limit and community-wise relaxation, will be published in the Detailed Notification. A Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Industrial Engineering from a recognised university, along with a minimum of two years of industrial work experience in medium and large-scale manufacturing process industries, preferably in Industrial Safety, Occupational Safety, Health and Environment Management. The experience certificate must be issued by the Chief Executive of the concerned industry. For English Reporters: a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline, Shorthand (English) at a minimum speed of 150 words per minute, and Typewriting (English) of a higher grade from the State Board of Technical Education. For Telugu Reporters: a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline, Shorthand and Typewriting (Telugu) both of a higher grade, and a practical test at 80 words per minute in Telugu Shorthand. Preference is given to candidates who additionally hold the corresponding qualification in the other language. A Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as a main subject, or with Mathematics, Economics, Commerce, or Computer Science as a main subject provided Statistics was studied as a paper in one, two, or all three years of the degree. A Bachelor's Degree in Chemistry, Bio-Chemistry, Biology or Environmental Sciences from a recognised university. First Class candidates will be given preference. A first or second class Master's Degree in Social Anthropology, Sociology or Social Work from a recognised university, along with a minimum of two publications in national-level academic journals. A Postgraduate Degree in Mathematics, Pure Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Applied Economics, Applied Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Econometrics or Computer Science from a recognised university.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: For every post under APPSC Recruitment 2026, selection is through a single-level examination only; no Screening Test will be conducted irrespective of the number of applications received. The examination will be conducted in online Computer Based Recruitment Test (CBRT) mode. If the single-level exam is held across multiple sessions, APPSC will apply a normalisation process to the marks, with the methodology to be notified separately. For all objective-type papers, each wrong answer is penalised with one-third of the marks prescribed for that question, as per the applicable government orders cited in each notification's syllabus annexure.

content_sections.heading: Why Has PSSSB Reopened the Junior Engineer Application Form?
content_sections.text: PSSSB has reopened the application window in compliance with an interim order dated 8 October 2026 passed by the Punjab and Haryana High Court in CWP No. 32342 of 2026, Manveer Singh vs State of Punjab and Others. Under the public notice, eligible candidates are being provided an additional opportunity to apply for Junior Engineer (Civil, Mechanical and Electrical) Group-B posts.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Junior Engineer Posts 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment covers the following Junior Engineer disciplines:

content_sections.heading: PSSSB Junior Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the required educational or technical qualification for the Junior Engineer discipline selected in the application form. Candidates should possess a three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institution. Candidates with a higher qualification in the same discipline from a recognized university or institution are also eligible under the qualification condition. Candidates should possess a three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institution. A higher qualification in the same engineering discipline is also accepted under the prescribed requirement. Candidates should possess a three-year Diploma in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institution. Candidates holding a higher qualification in Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution may also meet the educational qualification condition.

content_sections.heading: Can B.Tech Graduates Apply for PSSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Yes, candidates with a higher qualification in the same engineering discipline can satisfy the educational qualification requirement. For example, a candidate holding a recognized B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering may meet the qualification requirement for Junior Engineer (Civil). Similarly, candidates with recognized higher qualifications in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering may meet the relevant discipline requirement. Applicants must also satisfy the applicable age, Punjabi-language and other recruitment conditions. A higher qualification in an unrelated discipline does not automatically establish eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Is Punjabi Language Compulsory for PSSSB Junior Engineer?
content_sections.text: Yes. Under the Punjab Civil Services (General and Common Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994, candidates must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject, or an equivalent Punjabi-language examination recognized under the applicable Government rules. Applicants should verify their Punjabi-language qualification before proceeding with the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Balodabazar Bhatapara Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on merit list preparation from academic qualifications and experience, followed by a skill test or practical exam. Assistant Programmer: Weightage given to minimum educational qualification percentage out of 100 marks (45%), Computer practical test merit marks out of 100 (40% with minimum 60% required), and work experience in government rural development schemes (1 to 2 years: 5 marks, up to 5 years: 10 marks, above 5 years: 15 marks). Programme Officer: Weightage given to minimum educational qualification out of 100 marks (70%), Computer practical test merit out of 100 marks (15%), and work experience in government rural development schemes (1 to 2 years: 5 marks, up to 5 years: 10 marks, above 5 years: 15 marks). Computer Programmer: Weightage given to minimum educational qualification out of 100 marks (70%), Computer practical test marks (15%), .NET Technology/Java/MS.SQL/Oracle knowledge (5%), and work experience up to 2 years (5 marks) or above 2 years (10 marks). Accountant: Higher secondary marks weightage (20%), B.Com. qualification marks weightage out of 100 marks (50%), computer practical test marks (15%), and work experience in government rural development schemes (1 to 2 years: 5 marks, up to 5 years: 10 marks, above 5 years: 15 marks).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zila Panchayat Balodabazar Bhatapara Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website www.cg.nic.in/balodabazar to download the notification and application format. Print the application format provided from page 4 onwards of the PDF notification. Fill in all required details clearly in Hindi or English, including personal data, qualification, and employment details. Affix a self-attested passport-size photograph on the designated space of the application form. Attach self-attested copies of all mark sheets, degrees, caste certificates, domicile certificates, employment registration cards, experience certificates, and other required documents. Enclose 02 self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 5 postage stamps affixed. Write the name of the applied post and category clearly on top of the main envelope. Send the completed application form through Registered Post or Speed Post to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Balodabazar-Bhatapara, District Balodabazar-Bhatapara (Chhattisgarh) Pin 493332 on or before 30 October 2026 by 05:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Balodabazar Bhatapara Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date and time (30 October 2026, 05:30 PM) or through unauthorized modes will be summarily rejected. Separate applications must be submitted if applying for more than one post. Incomplete, unclear, or defective applications will be cancelled without any notice. The candidate must be a native resident of Chhattisgarh. Contract appointment will remain valid up to 28 February 2027, subject to extension based on performance, capacity, behavior, and mutual agreement. Applicants working in government or semi-government institutions must submit their application through the proper channel along with an NOC. The decision of the District Programme Coordinator / Collector regarding appointment and recruitment will be final and binding. The number of vacancies is subject to change.

For AEE (Civil), mark your order of preference among Water Resources, Works, and Housing and Urban Development; it is final.

(Engineering) in Civil Engineering. Experience: Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience in State/Central/Private power utilities. Applicants must have at least 10 years of experience in planning, construction and execution of greenfield or brownfield power projects, including 2 years at senior managerial level. Role: Leadership and supervision of civil engineering activities in thermal power project execution. Educational Qualification: B.Tech, B.E. or B.Sc. (Engineering) in Mechanical Engineering. Experience: Minimum 20 years of post-qualification experience in State/Central/Private power utilities. Applicants must have at least 10 years of experience in the execution of coal-based thermal power projects involving a 500 MW unit or above, including 2 years at senior managerial level. content_sections.heading: Can Private-Sector Employees Apply for Coal India E8 Recruitment?
content_sections.text: Yes. Eligible private-sector professionals can apply for Coal India General Manager Recruitment 2026. However, they must meet additional conditions relating to the employer's turnover, their employment status, CTC and relevant experience. The applicant must have worked in a regular capacity in an eligible private-sector company, joint venture or specified cooperative federation. The organization must meet the prescribed annual turnover threshold of Rs. 1,000 crore or more. The average audited annual turnover of the three relevant preceding financial years will be considered. The candidate must meet the minimum annual CTC requirement of Rs. 52 lakh in the last financial year. Preference will be given to applicants from listed companies in the case of private-sector companies. Important: Meeting the Rs. 52 lakh CTC condition alone does not establish eligibility. Candidates must also satisfy the prescribed engineering qualification, total experience and relevant domain-experience requirements.

content_sections.heading: Is Rs. 52 Lakh CTC Mandatory for Coal India General Manager?
content_sections.text: For applicants from the private sector, the notification prescribes a minimum CTC of Rs. 52 lakh per annum in the last financial year. This is a private-sector eligibility condition. Government and PSU applicants are assessed under the relevant grade and pay-scale equivalence requirements specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Can PSU E7 Officers Apply for Coal India General Manager E8 Posts?
content_sections.text: Yes. Government and PSU candidates can apply if they meet the prescribed educational qualification, experience and grade-equivalence requirements. For the notified posts, the additional grade requirement includes a minimum of 2 years in the immediately lower grade under the applicable DPE-notified IDA pay scale, or the corresponding prescribed Government/CDA equivalence. The notification specifies the following reference levels: IDA E7 Pay Scale: Rs. 1,00,000 - Rs. 2,60,000 (2017) IDA E7 Pay Scale: Rs. 43,200 - Rs. 66,000 (2007) CDA / Government: Rs. 37,400 - Rs. 67,000 (PB-4), Grade Pay Rs. 8,900 under 6th CPC, or Pay Level 13A under 7th CPC For Government organizations with non-comparable pay structures, the Selection Committee will determine grade equivalence using hierarchy, responsibility, pay structure, total emoluments and service period, based on supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: Does Contract or Trainee Experience Count Towards 20 Years?
content_sections.text: Coal India has prescribed rules for calculating qualifying experience. Experience is generally counted from the date of acquiring the required engineering degree. Internships and summer/winter training during studies do not count. Ad-hoc, contractual, officiating and ordinary trainee service do not count. Regular Management Trainee, Executive Trainee or Graduate Engineer Trainee service that subsequently leads to absorption in a regular cadre may be counted. Actual service across multiple organizations may be combined. Employment gaps are not counted as experience.

content_sections.heading: Coal India Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 55 years as on 7 October 2026, the notification date. The notification date is also the cut-off date for determining minimum qualification and experience.

content_sections.heading: Coal India General Manager Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The General Manager posts carry an E8 Grade basic pay scale of Rs. 1,20,000 to Rs. 2,80,000 . Pay fixation will follow applicable DPE guidelines. Candidates appointed from private organizations will have their basic pay fixed at the minimum of the prescribed pay scale without pay protection. The actual total remuneration may vary depending on applicable benefits and company rules.

content_sections.heading: Coal India General Manager Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment process involves eligibility screening, shortlisting and a physical Personal Interview. Eligibility Verification: Coal India will examine applicants' qualifications, professional experience and applicable grade or CTC requirements. Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted using the prescribed 100-mark assessment criteria. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will attend an interview in physical mode. Final Selection: Selection will be based solely on marks obtained in the Personal Interview. The normal interview-shortlisting zone is a maximum of 12 candidates per vacancy, subject to availability of eligible applicants and the company's discretion in exceptional cases. Qualification - Maximum 20 Marks Minimum essential qualification: 12 marks Additional recognized relevant postgraduate degree/diploma: 5 marks Additional relevant qualification or certification: 3 marks Total Post-Qualification Experience - Maximum 40 Marks Minimum prescribed experience: 20 marks Each additional completed year beyond minimum experience: 5 marks, subject to the maximum Specific / Domain Experience - Maximum 40 Marks Minimum prescribed domain experience: 20 marks Each additional completed year beyond minimum domain experience: 5 marks, subject to the maximum Important distinction: The 100-mark assessment is used for shortlisting candidates for interview. Final selection is based solely on performance in the Personal Interview, not on the combined shortlisting and interview scores.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Coal India General Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official Coal India website during the application window. Important: The notification states that modifications are not permitted after application submission. Incorrect details or missing documents may lead to rejection.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Coal India General Manager Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload relevant documents supporting their qualification, employment and professional experience. Date of birth proof Valid photo identity proof B.Tech / B.E. / B.Sc. (Engineering) degree Additional qualification certificates, if applicable Brief description of relevant domain experience, including designation, grade, period and position held Employment experience certificates showing pay scale, designation, position and relevant responsibilities, merged into a PDF Appointment letters and promotion orders establishing applicable grade or level equivalence Proof of specific Renewable Energy or Thermal Power experience relevant to the selected post Documents establishing senior managerial responsibilities for the applicable Thermal Power positions Private-sector employer turnover evidence based on audited financial statements with valid UDIN, where applicable Certificate supporting CTC for the last financial year and latest payslip Employer NOC for serving Government/PSU applicants, specifying current grade and pay scale Original documents will be verified at the interview. Shortlisted candidates who fail to produce the required originals may be debarred from appearing for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Coal India General Manager Interview and Travel Allowance
content_sections.text: Coal India will publish the interview shortlist on its official website and subsequently communicate the interview date, time and venue to shortlisted candidates through email. Eligible outstation applicants called for interview may receive reimbursement of travel expenses by the shortest route, up to Economy Class Air fare or AC 2-tier train fare, subject to the conditions mentioned in the notification. Original tickets or boarding passes are required for reimbursement. The amount will be credited to the candidate's bank account. Reimbursement will not be provided if the candidate is not interviewed because of ineligibility or failure to produce the necessary documents.

content_sections.heading: Coal India Recruitment 2026 Job Location and Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates may be required to serve in Coal India Limited or its subsidiaries anywhere according to the organization's requirements. Appointments are subject to medical fitness and other applicable verification conditions. Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year.

application_fee.details: The application fee is Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred only), inclusive of 18% GST. Candidates belonging to SC / ST / PwBD categories are exempted from the payment of application fee. | An online application form submitted without the requisite fee will be summarily rejected, and no refund will be admissible in such cases. Once deposited, the application fee will not be refunded under any circumstances, even if the candidate is unable to complete the registration process. Payment is made online through SBI Collect. The payment page shows the account details as 'HAL CHRC RECRUIMENT 2026-27', as written in the notification. Payment modes mentioned: credit card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 3 years from the date of engagement
age_limit.maximum_age: 56 years for PwBDs and 55 years for other candidates
age_limit.details: The upper age limit is not above 28 years as on 17 October 2026 for UR and EWS category candidates. Candidates from OBC-NCL / SC / ST / EWS categories applying for a UR post will be treated on par with UR criteria. Age will be reckoned as on the last date for receipt of applications only. | For SC / ST and OBC-NCL candidates, the caste / tribe name must appear in the Central List notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India. The certificate must contain the date of issue, and the name must be spelled exactly as in the central list. For EWS candidates, the Income and Asset Certificate must be valid for the financial year 2026-2027 and prepared on the basis of income and asset verification for the financial year 2025-26.

qualification.details: To be eligible for HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026, candidates must be Indian Nationals and must meet the qualification, minimum marks and age requirements given below. Candidates should also apply only for the Engineering Discipline that best matches their educational qualification. | Candidates must hold a Regular / Full Time Degree in Engineering / Technology from Universities / Institutes recognized by appropriate Statutory Authorities in India under the 10+2+4 system (10+3+3 in case of lateral entry to Engineering Courses), in the disciplines / eligible branches listed below. | Note 1: In addition to the above branches, HAL reserves the right to allow candidates with a Degree in any other branches of the same Engineering Disciplines to be considered eligible, provided they meet the other criteria. In such cases, the Degree / provisional Certificate should mention one of the Discipline or Branch mentioned above. | Note 2: As per MHRD O.M. F. No. 11-15/2011-AR(TS.II) dated 06.12.2012, the Technical Courses offered by Professional Bodies / Institutions were de-recognized w.e.f. 01.06.2013. Only candidates who enrolled for these courses up to 31.05.2013 are eligible for consideration as equivalent to a Degree in Engineering. Candidates who enrolled on or after 01.06.2013 are not eligible. | Candidates must have secured the minimum aggregate percentage of marks (or corresponding CGPA ratings / gradations) across all Semesters / Years of their relevant educational qualifications. | The total maximum marks and total marks obtained for all the Semesters / Years will be summed up to arrive at the aggregate percentage, with no rounding off and no weightage to any particular Semester or Year. | Documentary proof of having passed the qualifying examination with the minimum prescribed aggregate marks must be submitted at the time of Interview, tentatively scheduled during November 2026. Candidates with a Diploma and the respective Engineering Degree must enter the marks of the Engineering Degree as Qualifying Marks in the online application. Candidates with a 5/6 years Integrated Degree in the relevant Discipline and Branch of Engineering are also eligible to apply. Where CGPA, letter grade, etc. is awarded, the equivalent percentage of marks should be indicated in the application form as per the norms adopted by the University / Institute. A Conversion Certificate must be submitted at the time of Interview, if shortlisted / called for. Only qualifications acquired through Regular or Full Time courses from recognized Institutes or Universities are accepted. Qualifications through Correspondence / Distance Education / Part Time / E-Learning are not equated with a Regular / Full Time course, and such candidates are not eligible to apply. Where specialization is required for a Discipline, the certificate must clearly indicate the relevant specialization. If not available, the candidate must produce a Certificate issued by the concerned Institute. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: HAL is looking for young, energetic and result oriented Graduate Engineers / Professionals for engagement as Junior Executives on Short Term Basis. The selected candidates will be posted across HAL's Production, Overhaul and Service Divisions, Research & Development Centres and Offices. Register for Job Alerts HAL is a Maharatna Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, and a premier Aerospace and Defence Company in India. According to the notification, HAL has worked over the last eight decades on the design, development, manufacture, maintenance, repair, overhaul and upgrade of Aircraft, Helicopters, Aero-engines, Accessories, Avionics and Systems. HAL operates with 20 Divisions and 10 Research & Development Centres spread across seven States and ten geographical locations in India. HAL's major customers include the Indian Air Force, Indian Army, Indian Navy and Indian Coast Guard. HAL is also a key partner in the space programmes of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).

content_sections.text: HAL has notified 150 vacancies for Junior Executive on Short Term Basis. Mechanical has the highest number of vacancies (78), followed by Electrical (25) and Electronics (21). SC – Scheduled Caste; ST – Scheduled Tribe; OBC-NCL – Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer); EWS – Economically Weaker Sections; UR – Unreserved. OBC-NCL: The candidate must not belong to the Creamy Layer. OBC candidates who belong to the Creamy Layer are not entitled to the relaxation admissible to OBC-NCL and must indicate their category as UR in the application form. The name of the caste and community must appear in the Central List of Other Backward Classes. The OBC-NCL certificate must be in the prescribed format and not older than 6 months as on 17.10.2026, at the time of Interview, if called for. EWS: Reservation will be as per the prevalent Government Directives. PwBD: Reservation of vacancies for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) will be distributed among all categories, i.e. SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS and UR. PwBDs suffering from not less than 40% of the identified disability are eligible for the benefit of reservation. Candidates must submit the Disability Certificate issued by the Competent Authority in the prescribed format only. The notification mentions 06 vacancies reserved for PwBDs. This number is shown once for all disciplines in the notification, and a discipline-wise split is not specified. content_sections.heading: HAL Junior Executive Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be eligible for HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026, candidates must be Indian Nationals and must meet the qualification, minimum marks and age requirements given below. Candidates should also apply only for the Engineering Discipline that best matches their educational qualification. Candidates must hold a Regular / Full Time Degree in Engineering / Technology from Universities / Institutes recognized by appropriate Statutory Authorities in India under the 10+2+4 system (10+3+3 in case of lateral entry to Engineering Courses), in the disciplines / eligible branches listed below. Note 1: In addition to the above branches, HAL reserves the right to allow candidates with a Degree in any other branches of the same Engineering Disciplines to be considered eligible, provided they meet the other criteria. In such cases, the Degree / provisional Certificate should mention one of the Discipline or Branch mentioned above. Note 2: As per MHRD O.M. F. No. 11-15/2011-AR(TS.II) dated 06.12.2012, the Technical Courses offered by Professional Bodies / Institutions were de-recognized w.e.f. 01.06.2013. Only candidates who enrolled for these courses up to 31.05.2013 are eligible for consideration as equivalent to a Degree in Engineering. Candidates who enrolled on or after 01.06.2013 are not eligible. Candidates must have secured the minimum aggregate percentage of marks (or corresponding CGPA ratings / gradations) across all Semesters / Years of their relevant educational qualifications. The total maximum marks and total marks obtained for all the Semesters / Years will be summed up to arrive at the aggregate percentage, with no rounding off and no weightage to any particular Semester or Year. Documentary proof of having passed the qualifying examination with the minimum prescribed aggregate marks must be submitted at the time of Interview, tentatively scheduled during November 2026. Candidates with a Diploma and the respective Engineering Degree must enter the marks of the Engineering Degree as Qualifying Marks in the online application. Candidates with a 5/6 years Integrated Degree in the relevant Discipline and Branch of Engineering are also eligible to apply. Where CGPA, letter grade, etc. is awarded, the equivalent percentage of marks should be indicated in the application form as per the norms adopted by the University / Institute. A Conversion Certificate must be submitted at the time of Interview, if shortlisted / called for. Only qualifications acquired through Regular or Full Time courses from recognized Institutes or Universities are accepted. Qualifications through Correspondence / Distance Education / Part Time / E-Learning are not equated with a Regular / Full Time course, and such candidates are not eligible to apply. faq.answer: The available post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF), with potential progression to Senior Research Fellow (SRF) based on performance and project duration requirements.

Selection to APPSC Group-I Services involves a Screening Test
a Main Written (Descriptive) Examination
and an Interview (Personality Test).

Candidates must appear in all papers of the Screening Test; absence in any paper renders the candidate liable for disqualification. Each wrong answer is penalized with 1/3rd of the marks prescribed for the question. The number of candidates admitted to the Main Written Examination will be 50 times the number of vacancies available
irrespective of community.
Appearance in all papers of the Main Written Examination is compulsory; absence in any paper automatically disqualifies the candidature. The Telugu and English papers are qualifying in nature
and marks secured are not counted for merit. Minimum qualifying marks for Telugu & English are 40% for OC/Sports Persons/EWS
35% for BCs
and 30% for SC/ST/PBD. All papers except Telugu & English may be answered in English
Telugu
or Urdu
as chosen by the candidate
but the medium chosen must be used consistently across all five papers.
Mere securing of minimum qualifying marks does not confer any right to the candidate for being considered for selection.
After the Main Written Examination
eligible candidates will be called for an Interview (Personality Test) in the ratio of 1:2 with reference to the number of vacancies
duly following special representation as per General Rule-22 of A.P. State and Subordinate Service Rules
The Screening Test will be held at all District Centres (26 centres
including newly organized districts)
with candidates choosing up to three preferences. The Main Written Examination will be held at four centres only: Visakhapatnam
Vijayawada
Tirupati
and Ananthapuramu. The Commission reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of centres or allot a different centre based on administrative requirements.
how_to_apply: APPSC Group 1 Apply Online process is conducted through the Commission's website, and requires a One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) before applying.

Step 1: Login to the Commission's website, https://psc.ap.gov.in, with your registered OTPR number. First-time applicants must register their bio-data particulars through One Time Profile Registration (OTPR); a User ID is then generated and sent to the registered mobile number and email ID. Note: OTPR registration is not considered an application for any post.
Step 2: Login with your User Name (OTPR ID) and password, click "Online Application Submission," and then "Fill Application" against Notification No. 07/2026.

Step 3: Fill application-specific data such as Local/Non-Local status, White Card details (used to calculate fee), Qualification details, Post preferences, and examination centre. Use "Save" to save partial details, or "Save & Submit" to proceed to payment — only "Save & Submit" generates the payment link and finalizes the application.

Payment Process: Verify the pre-populated fee and age-relaxation details from OTPR data, then complete payment via Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card. A payment reference ID is generated and an SMS alert sent to the registered mobile number upon successful payment.
Step 4: If the payment process fails, restart the payment process as described in Step 2.

Step 5: After successful submission, corrections are enabled for up to 7 days from the last date of application, on payment of Rs. 100/- per correction (fields affecting Name, Fee, and Age Relaxation cannot be corrected). No changes are allowed after this window.
Download and retain the filled application PDF for future reference and correspondence.
important_instructions: Any application sent through any mode other than the prescribed online mode will not be entertained under any circumstances. Submission of the application form is construed as confirmation that the candidate has read the notification and will abide by its terms and conditions. The particulars furnished in the application form will be taken as final; incomplete/incorrect applications will be summarily rejected, and no relevant column should be left blank. Candidates belonging to Backward Classes must produce a Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 but not later than the closing date of the application. EWS candidates must possess an EWS certificate based on income for FY 2025-2026, issued by a Revenue Authority in the rank of Tahsildar, in digital format, on or after 01.04.2026. Reservation for local candidates applies to Post Codes 01 to 03 and 05 to 13 (not applicable to Post Code 04, which is a State cadre post). Posts are organized into Multi-Zone-I, Multi-Zone-II, and Zonal cadre (Post Code 12), with 95% local reservation as per the Presidential Order 2025. Candidates furnishing incorrect information or making false declarations regarding eligibility are liable to be debarred for up to five years from appearing in any examination conducted by the Commission, in addition to summary rejection of candidature. Use of mobile phones (even switched off), calculators, or any electronic/programmable devices, storage media, smart watches, cameras, or Bluetooth devices is strictly prohibited in the examination; violation entails disciplinary action, including a ban from future examinations. Candidates must ensure their eligibility for the recruitment before submitting the application; the Commission's decision on all matters pertaining to the application, examination, and selection process is final. There shall be no waiting list; recruitment will be made only to the vacancies notified. Objections on the Screening Test's initial Answer Key must be filed within three days of publication, with a fee of Rs. 100/- per objection (refundable if the objection is found valid). The question paper is set in English and translated into Telugu; the English version is authentic for evaluation.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 1 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection to APPSC Group-I Services involves a Screening Test, a Main Written (Descriptive) Examination, and an Interview (Personality Test). Candidates must appear in all papers of the Screening Test; absence in any paper renders the candidate liable for disqualification. Each wrong answer is penalized with 1/3rd of the marks prescribed for the question. The number of candidates admitted to the Main Written Examination will be 50 times the number of vacancies available, irrespective of community. Appearance in all papers of the Main Written Examination is compulsory; absence in any paper automatically disqualifies the candidature. The Telugu and English papers are qualifying in nature, and marks secured are not counted for merit. Minimum qualifying marks for Telugu & English are 40% for OC/Sports Persons/EWS, 35% for BCs, and 30% for SC/ST/PBD. All papers except Telugu & English may be answered in English, Telugu, or Urdu, as chosen by the candidate, but the medium chosen must be used consistently across all five papers. Mere securing of minimum qualifying marks does not confer any right to the candidate for being considered for selection. After the Main Written Examination, eligible candidates will be called for an Interview (Personality Test) in the ratio of 1:2 with reference to the number of vacancies, duly following special representation as per General Rule-22 of A.P. State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996. The Screening Test will be held at all District Centres (26 centres, including newly organized districts), with candidates choosing up to three preferences. The Main Written Examination will be held at four centres only: Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Tirupati, and Ananthapuramu. The Commission reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of centres or allot a different centre based on administrative requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APPSC Group 1 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: APPSC Group 1 Apply Online process is conducted through the Commission's website, and requires a One Time Profile Registration (OTPR) before applying. Step 1: Login to the Commission's website, https://psc.ap.gov.in, with your registered OTPR number. First-time applicants must register their bio-data particulars through One Time Profile Registration (OTPR); a User ID is then generated and sent to the registered mobile number and email ID. Note: OTPR registration is not considered an application for any post. Step 2: Login with your User Name (OTPR ID) and password, click "Online Application Submission," and then "Fill Application" against Notification No. 07/2026. Step 3: Fill application-specific data such as Local/Non-Local status, White Card details (used to calculate fee), Qualification details, Post preferences, and examination centre. Use "Save" to save partial details, or "Save & Submit" to proceed to payment — only "Save & Submit" generates the payment link and finalizes the application. Payment Process: Verify the pre-populated fee and age-relaxation details from OTPR data, then complete payment via Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card. A payment reference ID is generated and an SMS alert sent to the registered mobile number upon successful payment. Step 4: If the payment process fails, restart the payment process as described in Step 2. Step 5: After successful submission, corrections are enabled for up to 7 days from the last date of application, on payment of Rs. 100/- per correction (fields affecting Name, Fee, and Age Relaxation cannot be corrected). No changes are allowed after this window. Download and retain the filled application PDF for future reference and correspondence.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 1 Recruitment 2026 – Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Any application sent through any mode other than the prescribed online mode will not be entertained under any circumstances. Submission of the application form is construed as confirmation that the candidate has read the notification and will abide by its terms and conditions. The particulars furnished in the application form will be taken as final; incomplete/incorrect applications will be summarily rejected, and no relevant column should be left blank. Candidates belonging to Backward Classes must produce a Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 but not later than the closing date of the application. EWS candidates must possess an EWS certificate based on income for FY 2025-2026, issued by a Revenue Authority in the rank of Tahsildar, in digital format, on or after 01.04.2026. Reservation for local candidates applies to Post Codes 01 to 03 and 05 to 13 (not applicable to Post Code 04, which is a State cadre post). Posts are organized into Multi-Zone-I, Multi-Zone-II, and Zonal cadre (Post Code 12), with 95% local reservation as per the Presidential Order 2025. Candidates furnishing incorrect information or making false declarations regarding eligibility are liable to be debarred for up to five years from appearing in any examination conducted by the Commission, in addition to summary rejection of candidature. Use of mobile phones (even switched off), calculators, or any electronic/programmable devices, storage media, smart watches, cameras, or Bluetooth devices is strictly prohibited in the examination; violation entails disciplinary action, including a ban from future examinations. Candidates must ensure their eligibility for the recruitment before submitting the application; the Commission's decision on all matters pertaining to the application, examination, and selection process is final. There shall be no waiting list; recruitment will be made only to the vacancies notified. Objections on the Screening Test's initial Answer Key must be filed within three days of publication, with a fee of Rs. 100/- per objection (refundable if the objection is found valid). The question paper is set in English and translated into Telugu; the English version is authentic for evaluation.
