content_sections.heading: THSTI Posts: Desirable Skills, Duties and Posting Location
content_sections.text: The details below are taken from the notification’s job description and skills columns. Posting: Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi. Desirable: Experience in clinical/health research project. Registered with RCI. Computer skills including proficiency in use of Microsoft Office applications. Effective communication skills to provide timely and accurate information to participants and their caregivers. Responsibilities: Application, interpretation and recording of GSED assessment of infant. Application, interpretation and recording of Bayley’s scale IV of infant development. Application, interpretation and recording of HINE. Application, interpretation and recording of INCLEN Diagnostic Tool for Autism Spectrum Disorder (INDT-ASD). Application, interpretation and recording of INCLEN Diagnostic Tool for Epilepsy (INCLEN-INDT-EPI). Training and monitoring of Psychologist, Project Nurse, Field Worker in the study. Counselling of mothers with health concerns. Essential package of care for baby with cognitive/social delays (counselling of parents in early intervention). Any other work as assigned by PI. Posting: Civil Hospital, Sector 10, Gurgaon, Haryana. Desirable: Experience in performing HINE assessments for infants between 0-2 years. Experience in working with pediatrics age groups. Registered with a recognized council of occupational therapy and physiotherapy (COTPT). Good communication skills both in Hindi and English. Responsibilities: Assessment of infants and children in a clinical research cohort at a district hospital. Perform Hammersmith Infant Neurological Examination (HINE) and Hammersmith Neonatal Neurological Examination (HNNE) and assess infants and children in the cohort. Perform electronic data collection in terms of assessment points and scores. Provide inputs into study related materials such as clinical operations plan, SOPs, CRFs, guideline and training module. Assist the clinical Research coordinator (CRC) and site investigator for study related activities and work assigned by the PI. Posting: The selected candidate may be required to work at the Gurugram Civil Hospital, depending on project requirements. Desirable qualifications are not specified in the notification. Responsibilities: Collection and processing of infant/clinical biospecimens. Scanning, barcoding, and storage of processed biospecimens using laboratory management software and digital platforms. Sorting, retrieval, packing, and shipment of biospecimens to laboratories in accordance with IATA guidelines. Molecular biology techniques, including nucleic acid isolation from blood samples and DNA concentration estimation. Maintaining accurate documentation and records related to receipt, processing, storage, retrieval, and shipment of biospecimens at the Biorepository. Supporting day-to-day biorepository activities and ensuring compliance with established SOPs and quality requirements. Posting location is not specified; the walk-in is at THSTI, Faridabad. content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 General Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: These are short-term positions. Extension will be granted subject to satisfactory performance of the incumbents and the tenure of the project. Those appointed will have no claim for regularization of employment. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University. The experience requirement is the experience acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications. Candidates must satisfy themselves about eligibility before applying/appearing. No query will be entertained regarding eligibility criteria. The date of interview of the respective post is the crucial date for determining eligibility with regard to age, experience, essential qualification etc. Age and other relaxations are as listed in the age relaxation section above. All results/notifications will only be published on the THSTI website, so candidates should visit it regularly. All communications will only be made through email. If many candidates appear for the walk-in interview, screening will be done to limit the number of candidates to those possessing higher/relevant qualification and experience. The number of vacancies may change subject to actual requirement at the time of the written test/skill test/interview. For any provisions not covered in the notification, the bye laws of THSTI/Govt. of India rules/guidelines will prevail. Canvassing wrong information in any form will be a disqualification. The notification adds that the Government strives to have a work force which reflects gender balance and women candidates are encouraged to apply. It is signed by the Head-Administration.

faq.question: Q1. What is the full form of THSTI?
faq.answer: THSTI stands for Translational Health Science and Technology Institute, which is an autonomous institute of the Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of selection for THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for various project positions at THSTI is carried out through a written test, skill test, and personal interview conducted during the walk-in drive.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies have been announced under advertisement number THS/RN/20/2026 for various project posts including Senior Psychologist, Occupational Therapist, and Research Scientists.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for the Senior Psychologist post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Research Scientist-II (Senior Psychologist) position is scheduled to be held on 19 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is generally set up to 50 years depending on the specific post, with permissible age relaxations applicable for reserved categories like SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No application fee has been prescribed in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview sessions for these project-based positions.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is required for the Senior Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post-Graduate degree in Psychology or Clinical Psychology or relevant subjects from a recognized university along with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their updated CV, original educational and experience documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of all certificates, a valid photo ID card, and passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for the Research Scientist position?
faq.answer: The Research Scientist position offers a consolidated salary of up to Rs. 1,50,000/- per month, while other posts range between Rs. 28,000/- and Rs. 75,000/- per month.

faq.answer: You can check the official notification details, venue details, and further updates by visiting the official website of THSTI at www.thsti.res.in.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CURAJ to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

salary_details.details: Fixed Stipend for Cadet Training: Rs. 56,100 per month (starting pay in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix) throughout training at IMA Dehradun. On successful commissioning, the officer's pay is fixed in the first cell of Level 10; the training period is not treated as commissioned service, but arrears of admissible allowances for the training period are paid to cadets. Military Service Pay (MSP): Rs. 15,500 per month, fixed, for officers from Lieutenant to Brigadier rank. Dearness Allowance: Admissible at the same rates and conditions as applicable to civilian personnel, from time to time. Para Reserve Allowance: Rs. 2,625 per month. Technical Allowance: Tier-I – Rs. 3,000 per month; Tier-II – Rs. 4,500 per month. Field Area Allowances: Officers posted to Field Areas are eligible for allowances depending on rank and area of posting, ranging up to Rs. 42,500 (RH-Max) and including Siachen Allowance, High Altitude Allowance, Flying Allowance, Special Forces Allowance, and several other risk/hardship-linked allowances specified in the notification. These allowances apply strictly as per the laid-down qualification/eligibility conditions and are not admissible to everyone. Dress Allowance: Rs. 20,000 per year. Ration in Kind: In Peace and Field Areas. Transport Allowance (TPTA): For Pay Level 10 and above, Rs. 7,200 per month plus DA in Higher TPTA Cities (Hyderabad, Patna, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Surat, Bengaluru, Kochi, Kozhikode, Indore, Greater Mumbai, Nagpur, Pune, Jaipur, Chennai, Coimbatore, Ghaziabad, Kanpur, Lucknow, Kolkata), and Rs. 3,600 per month plus DA at other places. This is not admissible where Government transport is provided; officers in Pay Level 14 and above can opt for an official car or Rs. 15,750 per month plus DA; not admissible for months fully covered by leave; physically disabled service personnel are paid at double rate, minimum Rs. 2,250 plus DA per month. Children Education Allowance: Rs. 2,812.50 per month per child (per the Hindi text) / Rs. 2,250 per month per child (per the English text), for the two eldest surviving children, from pre-primary to Class 12. Reimbursement is once a year, after the financial year, on a certificate from the head of the institution. Hostel Subsidy: Rs. 6,750 per month per child, for the two eldest surviving children, from pre-primary to Class 12. Rates of Defence-specific allowances increase automatically by 25% each time Dearness Allowance rises by 50%, as per Government of India letter No. A-27012/02/2017-Est.(AL) dated 16 August 2017. | Pay, allowances and their rules/provisions are subject to revision from time to time. | Officer Cadets, while in receipt of stipend, are insured for Rs. 1.25 crore, as applicable to regular Army officers, with a monthly advance subscription of Rs. 12,500. Cadets invalided out by an Invaliding Medical Board (IMB) due to disability, and not entitled to any pension, are provided Rs. 25 lakh for 100% disability, proportionately reduced to Rs. 5 lakh for 20% disability; for disability below 20%, only an Ex-Gratia grant of Rs. 50,000 is paid. Disability due to alcoholism, drug addiction, or diseases of pre-enrolment origin does not qualify for this benefit. Officer Cadets withdrawn on disciplinary grounds, expelled as undesirable, or leaving the Academy voluntarily, are not eligible for the disability benefit or Ex-Gratia grant.

selection_process: Shortlisting of Applications: The Integrated HQ of MoD (Army) reserves the right to shortlist applications based on the vacancy-to-call-up ratio for each engineering stream

without assigning any reason. A cut-off is applied in each stream on the cumulative percentage of marks obtained up to the final semester/year. Percentages given by the college/university after applying their own CGPA-to-percentage formula are considered final; a candidate whose converted percentage falls below the cut-off should not report for SSB even if shortlisted as per the marks entered in the application. Allotment of Selection Centre and Dates: After shortlisting
candidates must log in to the website and select their SSB dates and centres
available on a first-come
first-served basis. The SSB centre and date
once selected
cannot be changed later

except that the Directorate General of Recruiting reserves the right to change a selected centre/date due to any exceptional circumstance. Conduct of SSB: Only shortlisted eligible candidates are called to one of the Selection Centres — Prayagraj (Uttar Pradesh)
Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh)
Bengaluru (Karnataka)

or Jalandhar (Punjab). The Call Up Letter is issued only through the candidate's registered email ID and SMS. Candidates go through a two-stage selection process; those who clear Stage-1 proceed to Stage-2

and those who fail Stage-1 are returned the same day. The SSB interview lasts a maximum of five days. Candidates recommended after Stage-2 undergo a medical examination. Joining Pre-Commission Training Academy (PCTA): Candidates recommended by the SSB and declared medically fit are issued a Joining Letter for training
in order of merit
subject to the number of vacancies available and meeting all eligibility criteria.
Candidates should check www.joinindianarmy.nic.in for the medical standards and procedures applicable to Officer Entry. The SSB medical examination is valid for 270 days

i.e. from the Special Medical Board (SMB) to the PCTA joining date. A candidate who has already undergone SSB medical examination (SMB/AMB/RMB) for the Army and been declared "Medically Fit" need not undergo it again for TGC-145

provided the gap between the medical (SMB) date and the course joining date (01 July 2027) is less than 270 days. Candidates already training in any Army PCTA need not undergo a fresh medical for TGC-145
even if this gap exceeds 270 days. Medical Board proceedings are confidential and are not divulged to anyone; the Directorate General of Recruiting has no role in any Medical Board.

Qualifying at the SSB interview does not by itself confirm final selection. The merit list is prepared stream/subject-wise on the marks obtained at the SSB interview. If candidates have equal SSB marks
the older candidate (by age) ranks higher. If SSB marks and age are both equal
the candidate with a higher percentage of marks in the qualifying degree is ranked higher; higher educational qualifications or previous performance play no role. Candidates within the merit list
within the stream-wise vacancies
and declared medically fit are issued Joining Letters for pre-commission training at IMA Dehradun
subject to meeting all eligibility criteria. If a candidate fails to report within 7 days of the reporting date in the Joining Letter
without the concerned Academy Adjutant's prior permission
the candidature is cancelled and a joining letter is issued to the next candidate in merit.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online, on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in.
Click 'Officer Entry Apply/Login' and then 'Registration' (not required if already registered on the website).

Fill the online registration form after reading the instructions carefully. After registering, click 'Apply Online' under the Dashboard; a page 'Officers Selection Eligibility' will open. Click 'Apply' shown against Technical Graduate Course.

A page 'Application Form' will open. Read the instructions carefully and click 'Continue' to fill details under Personal information, Communication details, Education details, and details of previous SSB (if any). Click 'Save & Continue' before moving to the next segment.
After filling the last segment, you reach a 'Summary of your information' page, where you can check and edit entries already made. Only after confirming the details are correct, click 'Submit'.
Candidates must click 'Submit' each time they reopen the application to edit any detail.
After the online application finally closes on the last day, candidates must, 30 minutes later, take out two printed copies of their application bearing the Roll Number.

Aadhaar number and Matriculation certificate are mandatory for registration on the website. Candidates are advised to read the notification carefully before filling the online application, to avoid mistakes and rejection. Only one online application should be submitted; multiple applications from the same candidate will lead to cancellation of candidature, with no representation entertained.

No changes can be made to details submitted in the online application after its closure. CGPA/Grades must be converted into marks as per the formula adopted by the concerned university for filling 'Marks obtained in Graduation'; any discrepancy found at any stage of selection will lead to cancellation of candidature. The candidate's name, parents' names, and date of birth in the profile and online application must exactly match the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate (or equivalent) issued by the concerned Board of Education; any variation will lead to cancellation.

content_sections.heading: Type of Commission, Seniority and Training
content_sections.text: Grant of Commission: Selected candidates are granted a Short Service Commission on probation in the rank of Lieutenant, from the date of course commencement or the date of reporting at IMA Dehradun, whichever is later. Permanent Commission: On successful completion of training, cadets are granted Permanent Commission in the Army in the rank of Lieutenant. Ante Date Seniority: Engineering Graduates of TGC entry are granted one year of ante-date seniority from the date of commission, in the rank of Lieutenant, for seniority, promotion and pay increment purposes. Induction in IMA: Selected candidates are detailed for training at IMA Dehradun according to their position in the final order of merit (stream-wise), up to the number of available vacancies. Duration of training is about 12 months. Marriage During Training: Candidates are not allowed to marry during training, nor to live with parents/guardians. A candidate who marries during training is discharged and is liable to refund all government expenditure on him; a candidate who marries after applying (even if successful in the SSB and medical) is not inducted for training, and the candidature is cancelled. Cost of Training: Training at IMA Dehradun is at government expense. If an Officer Cadet is withdrawn from the Academy for reasons other than medical grounds or reasons beyond his control, he is liable to refund the cost of training at Rs. 20,481.96 per week (tentative; actual cost calculated at the time of withdrawal/resignation), as per MoD letter No. 16(1)/2017-D(GS.II) dated 15 March 2022, with an annual increment of 8%. The cost of training borne by the State is recovered from candidates withdrawing for personal reasons. Allocation of Arms/Services: The final allocation of Arms/Services is made prior to the Officer Cadets' passing out from IMA, at the sole discretion of the Integrated HQ of the Ministry of Defence (Army). No representation on this allocation is entertained.

content_sections.heading: Indian Army TGC-145 Pay, Stipend and Allowances
content_sections.text: Fixed Stipend for Cadet Training: Rs. 56,100 per month (starting pay in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix) throughout training at IMA Dehradun. On successful commissioning, the officer's pay is fixed in the first cell of Level 10; the training period is not treated as commissioned service, but arrears of admissible allowances for the training period are paid to cadets. Military Service Pay (MSP): Rs. 15,500 per month, fixed, for officers from Lieutenant to Brigadier rank. Dearness Allowance: Admissible at the same rates and conditions as applicable to civilian personnel, from time to time. Para Reserve Allowance: Rs. 2,625 per month. Technical Allowance: Tier-I – Rs. 3,000 per month; Tier-II – Rs. 4,500 per month. Field Area Allowances: Officers posted to Field Areas are eligible for allowances depending on rank and area of posting, ranging up to Rs. 42,500 (RH-Max) and including Siachen Allowance, High Altitude Allowance, Flying Allowance, Special Forces Allowance, and several other risk/hardship-linked allowances specified in the notification. These allowances apply strictly as per the laid-down qualification/eligibility conditions and are not admissible to everyone. Dress Allowance: Rs. 20,000 per year. Ration in Kind: In Peace and Field Areas. Transport Allowance (TPTA): For Pay Level 10 and above, Rs. 7,200 per month plus DA in Higher TPTA Cities (Hyderabad, Patna, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Surat, Bengaluru, Kochi, Kozhikode, Indore, Greater Mumbai, Nagpur, Pune, Jaipur, Chennai, Coimbatore, Ghaziabad, Kanpur, Lucknow, Kolkata), and Rs. 3,600 per month plus DA at other places. This is not admissible where Government transport is provided; officers in Pay Level 14 and above can opt for an official car or Rs. 15,750 per month plus DA; not admissible for months fully covered by leave; physically disabled service personnel are paid at double rate, minimum Rs. 2,250 plus DA per month. Children Education Allowance: Rs. 2,812.50 per month per child (per the Hindi text) / Rs. 2,250 per month per child (per the English text), for the two eldest surviving children, from pre-primary to Class 12. Reimbursement is once a year, after the financial year, on a certificate from the head of the institution. Hostel Subsidy: Rs. 6,750 per month per child, for the two eldest surviving children, from pre-primary to Class 12. Rates of Defence-specific allowances increase automatically by 25% each time Dearness Allowance rises by 50%, as per Government of India letter No. A-27012/02/2017-Est.(AL) dated 16 August 2017. Pay, allowances and their rules/provisions are subject to revision from time to time. Officer Cadets, while in receipt of stipend, are insured for Rs. 1.25 crore, as applicable to regular Army officers, with a monthly advance subscription of Rs. 12,500. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Indian Army TGC-145 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only online, on www.joinindianarmy.nic.in. Click 'Officer Entry Apply/Login' and then 'Registration' (not required if already registered on the website). Fill the online registration form after reading the instructions carefully. After registering, click 'Apply Online' under the Dashboard; a page 'Officers Selection Eligibility' will open. Click 'Apply' shown against Technical Graduate Course. A page 'Application Form' will open. Read the instructions carefully and click 'Continue' to fill details under Personal information, Communication details, Education details, and details of previous SSB (if any). Click 'Save & Continue' before moving to the next segment. After filling the last segment, you reach a 'Summary of your information' page, where you can check and edit entries already made. Only after confirming the details are correct, click 'Submit'. Candidates must click 'Submit' each time they reopen the application to edit any detail. After the online application finally closes on the last day, candidates must, 30 minutes later, take out two printed copies of their application bearing the Roll Number. Aadhaar number and Matriculation certificate are mandatory for registration on the website. Candidates are advised to read the notification carefully before filling the online application, to avoid mistakes and rejection. Only one online application should be submitted; multiple applications from the same candidate will lead to cancellation of candidature, with no representation entertained. No changes can be made to details submitted in the online application after its closure. CGPA/Grades must be converted into marks as per the formula adopted by the concerned university for filling 'Marks obtained in Graduation'; any discrepancy found at any stage of selection will lead to cancellation of candidature. The candidate's name, parents' names, and date of birth in the profile and online application must exactly match the Matriculation/Secondary School Examination Certificate (or equivalent) issued by the concerned Board of Education; any variation will lead to cancellation.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required at the SSB (Selection Centre)
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following documents, along with their originals, must be carried to the Selection Centre. DIGILOCKER certificates will not be accepted in place of original certificates. One printout of the application, duly signed and affixed with a self-attested photograph. Matriculation/Secondary School Examination certificate (or equivalent) and marksheet issued by the concerned Board of Education, as proof of date of birth, candidate's name and parents' names (no other document such as admit card/marksheet/transfer certificate is acceptable). If parents' names are not mentioned on this certificate, the candidate must produce a Government of India/State Government document (PAN card, Aadhaar Card, Passport, Driving Licence, etc.) for verification, and the names in the online application must match this document exactly. 12th class marksheet and certificate, or equivalent certificate/Diploma marksheet and certificate (for Diploma holders). Engineering Degree/Provisional Degree issued by the recognised university (the Provisional Degree must not be more than six months old at the time of joining the Academy). Marksheets of all semesters/years. Certificate from the Controller of Examination/Registrar of the concerned university regarding the CGPA/Grades-to-marks conversion formula. For final-year candidates: a certificate from the Controller of Exam/Registrar/Dean/Principal regarding the cumulative percentage of marks up to the relevant semester/year, and a certificate from the Principal/Head of the Institution confirming the candidate is in the final year with the result to be declared by 01 July 2027, plus a declaration to submit proof of passing by 01 July 2027 to the Directorate General of Recruiting. Documents related to civil/police verification. A candidate who does not carry the above documents for the SSB interview will have their candidature cancelled and be returned. All certificates must be carried in original for verification; originals are returned after verification at the Service Selection Board itself. If a school/college issues only e-certificates through DIGILOCKER (no hard copy), a certificate to this effect must be obtained from the school/college, along with a duly authenticated colour printout of the e-certificate.

content_sections.heading: Other Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Disclosure of Material Information: Candidates must disclose all material information in their application/at the SSB, including any previous training in a training academy, release, withdrawal, resignation or dismissal from it, medical invalidment/unfitness declared by a competent authority, and any other information bearing on eligibility or suitability for commission. Suppression of material information can lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage up to grant of commission, or thereafter. Travelling Allowance: Candidates appearing for the SSB interview for the first time for a particular type of commission are entitled to AC-III Tier railway fare (or bus fare with reservation-cum-sleeper charges) to and fro, within Indian limits. Candidates reapplying for the same type of commission are not entitled to this allowance on any subsequent occasion. Change of Interview Date/Centre: Once the SSB date is selected, no request for a change of date/centre will be entertained or replied to. Any ambiguity, false information, or concealment of information detected in certificates/documents/the online application will result in cancellation of candidature at any stage of selection and thereafter. A candidate must never have been debarred from appearing in any examination by the UPSC, and must never have been arrested or convicted by a criminal court or involved in any case; if such an issue comes to notice during selection or pre-commission training, the candidature/cadetship is liable to cancellation/withdrawal by the Integrated HQ of MoD (Army). Candidates withdrawn from the NDA, IMA, OTA, Naval Academy, Air Force Academy, or any Service Training Academy on disciplinary grounds are not eligible to apply. Candidates serving in the Armed Forces must inform their Commanding Officer in writing that they have applied, and their application (countersigned by the Commanding Officer) must be carried to the SSB along with the other documents. For queries on centre allotment, interview dates, merit list, joining instructions or other information, candidates should check www.joinindianarmy.nic.in; queries are answered only through the 'Feedback/Query' option on the website, and only those received up to 3 days before the closing of the online application will be entertained. On joining the Army, certain personal restrictions apply under Article 33 of the Constitution of India, as promulgated in the Army Act and Army Rules from time to time.

content_sections.heading: NICL CISO Selection Process
content_sections.text: As per the notification, the selection process comprises: Preliminary screening and shortlisting based on the eligibility criteria, candidate's qualifications, experience, etc. submitted with the application. Personal Interview for shortlisted candidates. The notification clarifies that mere eligibility, shortlisting, and appearance in the interview do not imply that NICL is satisfied about a candidate's eligibility, and it does not vest any right in a candidate for selection. NICL reserves the right to reject any candidature at any stage if the candidate is found ineligible or has furnished incorrect/false information. content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NICL CISO Interview

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NICL CISO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Follow these steps to apply for the NICL Chief Information Security Officer post: Prepare a detailed CV/Resume along with testimonials supporting your qualifications, certifications, and experience. Submit your application between 15th July 2026 and 06 October 2026. Applications received outside this window will not be considered. Submit only one application. Any information submitted in the application is binding on the candidate, and providing false information or testimonials can lead to prosecution or civil consequences.

content_sections.text: The common essential qualification across all posts is B.E/B.Tech (CS/IT), M.Sc (CS/IT), or MCA from a recognized University/Institute with 55% marks or equivalent grade. Additional working-knowledge requirements apply for Assistant Director - LMS (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JAVA, MySQL/RDBMS, MongoDB/NoSQL DB, API integration, SSO, app development for Android/iOS, and more - see the official notification for the full list). At least 3 years of relevant working experience in the specific technical domain (LMS, Networking, Animation, Game Design, VR/AR, or AI) in PSUs, Universities, Educational Institutions, GoI organizations, or reputed IT organizations. At least 5 years of relevant working experience in the corresponding technical domain, in similar organizations as above. At least 10 years of relevant working experience in the corresponding technical domain (LMS or Networking), in similar organizations as above. Desirable certifications (e.g., CCNA/CCNP, Moodle Administrator, Unity Certified Professional, Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate, and others specific to each specialization) are listed in the official notification and give preference but are not mandatory.

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on the closing date for submission of the online application. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD, Government employees, and Ex-servicemen will be as per prevailing Government of India rules; relaxation for IGNOU employees will be as per the University's R&P Rules. Category candidates opting for unreserved vacancies are not entitled to age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee must be paid online through Debit Card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, or Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets. The fee, once paid, is neither refundable nor adjustable under any circumstances. Applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Salary is based on the applicable Pay Matrix Level under the 7th CPC: The notification does not specify additional allowances or gross in-hand salary figures.

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notification indicates that the University reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on merit, experience, and a written test and/or skill test, as applicable, and to fix screening criteria in case of a large number of applications. It also states that a Computer-Based Test (CBT)/Written Test/Skill Test/Interview may be conducted where required. The exact stages, weightage, and syllabus are not specified in the provided notification and will be communicated separately on the IGNOU website if applicable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IGNOU Recruitment 2026 (IGNOU Apply Online)
content_sections.text: Candidates may apply for more than one post if they meet the eligibility criteria for each, subject to CBT/test-timing constraints where applicable. Applications submitted through any mode other than online will be rejected, as will incomplete applications or those lacking fee/signature/enclosures.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Applicants
content_sections.text: Only citizens of India, or subjects of Nepal/Bhutan, Tibetan refugees (pre-1962), or persons of Indian origin migrated from specified countries (with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India), may apply. Candidates claiming reserved-category benefits must submit the requisite SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwBD certificate in the prescribed format from a Competent Authority. Candidates already employed with Central/State Government/PSU must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of document verification. All original certificates (age, qualification, experience, caste) must be produced at the time of document verification/interview. Experience gained on a part-time, daily-wage, or visiting/guest-faculty basis will not be counted for shortlisting. IGNOU reserves the right to amend, cancel, or modify any part of the recruitment process at any stage. For queries, candidates can email: [email protected] . Note: This article is based only on the details available in the provided official notification. Any information not specified there (such as the detailed selection-test syllabus or exact salary in-hand) has been noted as "not specified" rather than assumed.

Regular Bachelor of Education with min 50% aggregate marks from UGC/ NCTE recognized University/ institution. 06 years regular service as a PGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school. OR 10 years combined service as PGT/ TGT in any teaching subject in a recognized CBSE school with minimum 03 years as a PGT in a recognized CBSE School. IT Proficient. Adequate working knowledge of computers/ MS Office/ MS PowerPoint. Additional Desired Qualifications: PhD, M.Ed and minimum 03 years administrative experience in a recognized CBSE School. For APS Employees (PGT/ TGT): Only experience and age criteria is required to be fulfilled. Headmaster/ Headmistress: Graduate in any specialization with minimum 50% marks in each and overall aggregate. B.Ed/ M.Ed/ B.El.Ed/ two years Diploma in elementary education. Minimum 08 years of teaching experience with atleast of 05 years as PRT in a CBSE recognized school. Qualified in CTET/ State TET and OST. IT/ Computer literate. Teachers from the same school who fulfill the min QR as laid down above would be preferred. Special Educator (PRT): Graduate with B.Ed (Special Education). OR B.Ed (General) with one year Diploma in Special Education. OR B.Ed (General) with two years Diploma in Special Education. OR B.Ed (General) with Post Graduate Professional Diploma in Special Education (PGPC). OR B.Ed Special Education and Post Graduate Professional Certificate in Special Education (PGPC). OR PG Diploma in Special Education (Multiple Disability: Physical & Neurological). OR PG Diploma in Special Education (Locomotor, Impairment and Cerebral Palsy). OR Any other equivalent qualification approved by RCI. Mandatory Requirements: RCI Registration: A valid Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) registration number is mandatory for all special educators. PRT (Computer Science): BCA or Graduation in Computer Science or BE/ B Tech (Computer Science/ IT) or Graduate in any subject and A level course from DOEACC, Ministry of Info & Communication & Technology, Govt of India. B El. Ed/ 02 years D El Ed. OR Teachers who were already in service with Army Public Schools/ APPS prior to 11 Aug 2023 with B Ed degree can also apply, subject to enrolment/ completion of Bridge Course launched by NCTE. Pass in CTET/ TET conducted by CBSE/ State Govt for PRT in accordance with the guidelines framed by NCTE for the purpose. Proficiency in teaching English and Hindi medium. PRT (All Subjects): Graduate holding Bachelor's degree with at least minimum 50% marks in aggregate. B.El.Ed./ O2-year D.El.Ed. OR Teachers who were already in service with Army Public Schools/ APPS prior to 11 Aug 2023 with B Ed degree can also apply/ continue, subject to enrolment/ completion of Bridge Course launched by NCTE. Pass in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET)/ Teachers Eligibility Test (TET), conducted by CBSE/ State Govt for PRTs in accordance with the guidelines framed by NCTE for the purpose. Proficiency in teaching in English and Hindi medium. Knowledge of Computer Application. PRT (Physical Education Trainer/ Karate Instructor) (Preferably Lady): Bachelor's degree with Physical Education as an elective subject with 50% marks. OR Bachelor's degree with physical Education as an elective subject with 45 % marks and participation in National or State or Inter University competition in sports or games or athletics recognized by Association of Indian University or Indian Olympics Association. OR Bachelor's degree with 45 0/ 0 marks and having participated in National or State or Inter-University sports or games or athletics. OR For deputed in-service candidate (i.e., trained Physical Education Teachers/ Coaches)-Graduation with 45 o/ o marks and at least 3 years of teaching experience as per National Council for Teacher Education (Recognition Norms & Procedure) Regulations, 2009. OR Graduation in Physical Education with 40 % Marks. OR Graduation with Physical Education as an elective subject with 40% marks. OR Graduate who participated school, Inter-Collegiate in sports/ games or passed NCC 'C' Certification in accordance with the National Council for Teacher Education (Recognition Norms and Procedure) Regulations, 2007 notified on 10.12.2007. OR Graduation in Physical Education i.e., B.P. Ed course (or its equivalent) of 3 years duration. OR Graduate having represented State/ University in sports/ games/ athletics. OR Graduate who has secured I st, 2nd or 3rd position in Inter-Collegiate sports/ games tournaments/ possessing NCC 'C' Certificate or passed basic course in Adventure Sports. OR Graduate with one year training programme in Sports Science, Sports Management, Sport Coaching, Yoga, Olympic Education, Sports Journalism etc. (in accordance with the National Council for Teacher Education (Form of application for recognition, the time limit of submission of application, determination of norms and standards for recognition of teacher education programmes and permission to start new course or training) Regulations, 2002 notification 13.11.2002. and Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) of at least one year duration (or its equivalent) from any National council for Teacher Education recognized institution. TGT (Bengali & Nepali): 1.Four years “Integrated Degree Course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate. OR Post-Graduation with a minimum 50% marks or equivalent grade and three year Integrated B.Ed./ M.Ed. OR Bachelor Degree with at least 50% marks in the concerned subject/ combination of subjects and in aggregate in one of the following:- Educational Qualification Bengali as a subject in all the three years of Graduation. Nepali as a subject in all the three years of Graduation 2. B.Ed. from a NCTE recognized institution / University with minimum 50% marks 3. Preferably pass in Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET)/ Teachers Eligibility Test (TET), conducted by CBSE/ State Govt in accordance with the guidelines framed by the NCTE for the purpose. 4. Proficiency in teaching in English and Hindi medium. 5. Knowledge of Computer Application.

content_sections.text: For all three posts, the examination consists of a single-level examination only ; no Screening Test is conducted irrespective of the number of applications received. The examination is held in online (CBRT) mode, and if conducted in multiple sessions, the Commission will apply normalisation of marks wherever necessary, per its own methodology (to be notified in due course). Syllabus highlights (Paper II – Common Subject): Ecosystems; Natural Resources; Biodiversity and Biotic Resources; Engineering Materials; Fluid Mechanics and Hydraulics; Process Calculations and Thermodynamics; Air, Water, Soil and Noise Pollution and Control Technologies; Solid and Industrial Waste Management; Global Environmental Problems, Policies and Legislations; Environmental Impact Assessment towards Sustainable Future. Negative marking: As per G.O. Ms. No. 235, Finance (HR-I, Plg & Policy) Dept., dt. 06/12/2016, each wrong answer is penalized with 1/3rd of the marks prescribed for that question. Syllabus highlights: Horticulture-I covers Fruit Crops – area, production, botany, classification, rootstocks, high-density planting, climate, soils, planting, training and pruning, nutrition, irrigation scheduling, harvesting and post-harvest handling for crops such as mango, banana, citrus, grape, pineapple, guava and papaya (and related fruit-crop topics per the annexure). Full topic lists for Horticulture-I and Horticulture-II are in the official annexure. Negative marking: As per G.O. Ms. No. 235, Finance (HR-I, Plg & Policy) Dept., dt. 06/12/2016, each wrong answer is penalized with 1/3rd of the marks prescribed for that question. Syllabus highlights: Paper I (common) covers Current Events, General Science, History and Geography of India, Indian Polity & Governance, Indian Economy, Sustainable Development & Environmental Protection, Disaster Management, and Logical Reasoning/Data Analysis. Forensic Engineering’s Paper II covers Thermodynamics, Heat Transfer, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, and Steam Generators & Turbines among other Mechanical/Structural/Civil/Production Engineering topics; Physics, Chemistry and Biology Paper II follow their respective postgraduate-level syllabus, including forensic-specific applications for Chemistry/Biology. faq.question: Q1. What is GAIL recruiting for through GATE-2027?
faq.answer: GAIL (India) Limited will recruit Executive Trainees (ET) in Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation, and Mechanical disciplines using GATE-2027 marks.

faq.question: Q2. When can I apply on the GAIL website?
faq.answer: The GAIL application window opens on 17 February 2027 at 11:00 AM and closes on 18 March 2027 at 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in Engineering in the relevant discipline (or an equivalent/allied branch as listed) with a minimum of 65% marks for General/EWS/OBC(NCL) candidates, or 60% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 26 years as on 18 March 2027, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL), and 10 years for PwBD, subject to conditions.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply with GATE 2026 marks?
faq.answer: No. Only GATE-2027 marks are valid for this recruitment; GATE marks from 2026 or earlier will not be considered.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for more than one discipline?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can apply for only one post/discipline; multiple applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Are final-year students eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates currently in the final year (2026–27) of their Engineering degree are eligible, subject to securing the minimum prescribed aggregate percentage up to the last semester/year at the time of applying, and submitting the final degree certificate and mark sheets by 31 August 2027.

(Computer Science & Technology/Information Technology) or equivalent with two years' relevant experience. Desirable: CCNA/CCNP or equivalent certification. Library Assistant: Bachelor's degree in Library & Information Science or equivalent; typing speed of 30 words per minute in English; knowledge of computer applications. | Professor (Economics, Human Rights, Public Administration, Demographic Studies): Ph.D. with 10 research publications and a total research score of 120 as per UGC 2018 norms, and 10 years' teaching/research experience with evidence of guiding doctoral candidates; OR an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. and 10 years' relevant experience. Professor - Law: LL.M. and Ph.D. in Law, plus other UGC 2018 conditions for Professor. Professor - Civil/Electronics & Communication Engineering: Ph.D. in the relevant field with first class at Bachelor's or Master's level; minimum 10 years' teaching/research/industry experience (at least 3 years as Associate Professor); at least 6 SCI/UGC/AICTE-listed publications at Associate Professor level with 2 successful Ph.D. supervisions, OR 10 such publications. Associate Professor (Human Development & Family Studies, Hindi): Ph.D. in the relevant discipline; Master's with at least 55% marks; 8 years' teaching/research experience with 7 peer-reviewed publications and a research score of 75 as per UGC 2018 norms. Assistant Professor - English: Master's degree with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. as per UGC exemption conditions), OR a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500 globally (QS/THE/ARWU). Assistant Professor - Education (as per NCTE Regulations): Postgraduate degree in Social Sciences (55%) + M.Ed. (55%), OR PG in Education (55%) + B.Ed./B.El.Ed. (55%); plus UGC-NET/JRF/Ph.D. in Education. For Curriculum & Pedagogic subjects, a relevant PG subject + M.Ed. (55% each) is required; for Music/Fine Arts, only a PG degree in the subject with 55% marks is required. Professor-cum-Resident Director: Same eligibility as Professor (Category A or B above) plus three years of administrative experience for direct recruitment; for deputation, holding an analogous Academic Level-14 post, or at least 3 years in Academic Level-13A and above as Associate Professor or equivalent. Associate Professor-cum-Deputy Director (CSSI): Ph.D. in any Social Science subject; Master's with 55% marks; 8 years' relevant experience with 7 publications and a research score of 75. Assistant Professor-cum-Assistant Director (CSSI): Master's degree in Social Science with 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET (or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC norms), OR a foreign-university Ph.D. ranked in the top 500 globally. | Detailed, post-wise UGC 2018 eligibility clauses (including NET/SLET/SET exemption conditions for Ph.D. holders) are given in full in the official notification and should be read carefully before applying.

content_sections.heading: BBAU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening of applications as per eligibility criteria; the ratio of candidates called for interview to vacancies is generally up to 1:15. Written test with an objective-type qualifying paper (Paper I, 100 marks, minimum 40% qualifying marks) and a descriptive-type paper (Paper II, 100 marks); only candidates clearing Paper I are evaluated in Paper II. Candidates securing 50% marks in Paper II are called for the skill test/interview, wherever applicable. Skill test carries 50 marks with a minimum qualifying score of 25. The final merit list is based on Paper II (descriptive test) marks, subject to qualifying the skill test. Interview marks, wherever applicable, carry 20% weightage and are added to the Paper II/single written test score for the final merit list. The University may, at its discretion, hold a single written (descriptive) test and skill test instead of the two-stage process, depending on the post and number of candidates. Selection is made purely on the basis of Interview. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not guarantee a call for interview. The Screening Committee shortlists candidates as per University rules and UGC Regulations, 2018 (using the Academic Score in Appendix II, Table 3A, for shortlisting only, wherever applicable). content_sections.heading: IPL Recruitment 2026: Remuneration by Grade
content_sections.text: Remuneration for Individual Consultants is decided within the corresponding band, based on years of post-qualification relevant experience. Final remuneration for a selected candidate depends on expectations, experience, and expertise, and the decision of IPL is final and binding. Consultants will also be allowed to undertake tours as required by their duties, for which TA/DA and Hotel Accommodation shall be paid or reimbursed as per Company policy.

content_sections.heading: IPL Recruitment 2026 Selection Procedure
content_sections.text: Selection is done by way of Interview. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview. IPL reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates for interview after preliminary screening/shortlisting, with reference to qualifications, experience, suitability, city preference, and business requirement. IPL will call only those candidates who match the requirements for the specific grade, position, and IC Code indicated in the application form. Applying for a higher grade does not automatically make the applicant eligible for a lower grade. Applicants must apply separately for each IC Code and Grade Code. Shortlisted applicants will be required to attend an interview in Delhi or in online mode, as decided by IPL in its absolute discretion. IPL will not reimburse any expenditure incurred by an applicant for appearing at the interview. IPL reserves the right to appoint none, one, or more Individual Consultants against any IC Code.

content_sections.heading: Period and Nature of Engagement
content_sections.text: Individual Consultants will be engaged for a fixed period of two years, which may be extended by one year at a time, up to a maximum tenure of five years (2+1+1+1 years), for providing services on specific projects as per requirement. Continuation beyond the first and subsequent years is contingent on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on defined Key Performance Indicators. Engagement is on a Contractual and Full-Time basis, during which the selected candidate is not allowed to take up appointment/engagement/assignment anywhere else.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IPL Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications can be submitted by email or by post, depending on the IC Code applied for. Postal Address (alternative mode): AGM-HR, IIFCL Projects Limited (IPL), 3rd Floor, Tower – E, World Trade Centre (WTC), Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi - 110029

Account Assistant/Jr. Account Assistant: B.Com (Graduate) with knowledge in Tally entry and operation. At least two years of Tally entry and operation experience is mandatory. Executive (Sales): Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University. MBA/BBA or higher qualification receives additional weightage. Must have a minimum of 02 years of experience in the field of marketing of packet milk and milk products of reputed brands. The maximum age limit is 40 years as on 01.01.2026 for all posts. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government norms.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Management Trainee positions carry a consolidated stipend of Rs. 15,000.00 per month along with other admissible benefits as per Milk Union's norms. Remuneration for Account Assistant and Executive (Sales) is negotiable based on qualification and experience, accompanied by admissible benefits as per Milk Union's norms for contractual engagements. All engagements are initially for a period of one year, and any extension is subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: MIMUL Management Trainee Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will perform various operational duties depending on their assigned posts: Management Trainee (Field Extension Activity): Village survey, data collection and entry; assessing milk production, surplus availability, and feasibility of Dairy Co-operative formation; conducting awareness programs and training; milk testing and AMCU operation; guiding Dairy Co-operative societies. Management Trainee (Plant Operation): Receiving milk from societies, testing, recording, chilling, and dispatching; operating and maintaining Bulk Milk Cooling units and maintaining plant hygiene; maintaining relations with societies and farmers; managing records and reports. Account Assistant/Jr. Account Assistant: General entry in Tally and billing software; bill generation and related activities; ledger posting, general accounts work, and handling accounting & taxation tasks; bill verification and release of payments. Executive (Sales): Marketing MIMUL milk and milk products, increasing sales volume, and handling distributors and retailers; planning and achieving sales targets; developing marketing intelligence; ensuring collection of sales proceeds; managing assets and logistics for distribution.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MIMUL Management Trainee
content_sections.text: Check eligibility criteria for the desired post from the official notification. Prepare the complete application format along with self-attested photocopies of educational certificates (Madhyamik Pariksha admit card and mark sheets, Higher Secondary, and Graduation certificates) and relevant experience documents. Place the application and required enclosures inside an envelope. Send the application via Post or Courier to the designated address: The Midnapore Co-op. Milk Producers' Union Ltd., Ashok Nagar, Midnapore, Paschim Medinipur. PIN - 721101 . Ensure the application reaches the office positively within or on 06th November 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of short-listing of candidates followed by an interview. Shortlisting: Shortlists of eligible candidates are prepared based on the aggregate of marks obtained (ten percent) in Madhyamik Pariksha (MP), Higher Secondary Examination (HS), and Graduation. Vocational or distant courses are not considered for shortlisting. Total Marks Distribution: Madhyamik Pariksha (MP) - 10 Marks, Higher Secondary (HS) - 10 Marks, Graduation - 10 Marks, and Interview - 10 Marks (covering experience, personal appearance, speaking ability, and knowledge), totaling 40 Marks. Interview: Only short-listed eligible candidates will be called for an interview. Venues, dates, and times will be communicated directly to eligible candidates.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The Government Children Home for Girls, Jangaon (Balasadanam) has announced a total of 6 vacancies for women candidates on an outsourcing basis under Mission Vatsalya.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible women candidates may apply for these posts. Candidates must have completed 21 years and shall not have completed 44 years of age on 01.10.2026. The upper age limit is relaxed by five years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and Backward Classes, and by ten years for persons with benchmark disabilities. Local candidates of Jangaon District, as defined in the Telangana Public Employment (Organisation of Local Cadres and Regulation of Direct Recruitment) Order 2018, will be selected first in order of merit. Qualifications required for each post are as follows: Counsellor: Degree in Psychology, Counselling, Public Health, Social Work, Sociology, Education, Food and Nutrition or Home Science, from a recognised University; or post graduate diploma in Counselling and Communication. Child Welfare Officer: Degree, preferably B.A. in Social Work, Sociology or Social Sciences, or LL.B., from a recognised University. Store Keeper cum Accountant: Degree in Commerce, Finance or Accounting, from a recognised University. Paramedical Staff: Pass in the course of Auxiliary Nursing and Midwifery recognised by the Indian Nursing Council or the Telangana Nursing Council. Attender: Ability to read and write Telugu. Sevika: No educational qualification is prescribed. The candidate shall be able to read and write Telugu.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be by a written examination followed on the same day by an oral test of 25 marks. For posts at Sl.No.1 to 3, the written test carries 200 objective questions for 90 minutes in English. For Sl.No.4, the test carries 100 objective questions for 60 minutes in English and Telugu. For Sl.No.5 and 6, the test carries 50 objective questions for 45 minutes in Telugu and English. Each question carries one mark with a negative marking of 0.25 marks for every wrong answer. Five bonus marks are added for candidates belonging to specified vulnerable categories upon production of valid certificates.

Attach self-attested copies of SSC certificate, qualification certificates and marks memos, experience certificates, study certificates from Class I to VII (or residence certificate), community certificate (if age relaxation is claimed), disability certificate, category certificate for 5 bonus marks, identity proof, and two passport size photographs. Hand over the filled application form at the Inward Section of the Collectorate, Integrated District Offices Complex, Jangaon between 13.10.2026 and 17.10.2026 (working days 10.30 AM to 5.00 PM, Saturday up to 1.00 PM), or send it by registered post or speed post superscribed with the name of the post to reach by 5.00 PM on 17.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for APPSC ASO Recruitment 2026 will be based on merit in the written examination, subject to qualifying the Computer Proficiency Test (CPT). Computer Based Recruitment Test: Candidates must appear in the objective-type written examination. Computer Proficiency Test: Provisionally shortlisted candidates must qualify the CPT. Certificate Verification: Candidates must satisfy the applicable educational, reservation, local status and other documentary requirements.

content_sections.heading: APPSC ASO Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer written examination consists of two papers carrying 300 marks in total. Each paper contains 150 questions and has a duration of 150 minutes. Negative Marking: One-third of the marks assigned to each incorrect answer will be deducted. Obtaining the prescribed minimum marks does not guarantee selection. Final selection is subject to merit, vacancies and the applicable recruitment conditions.

content_sections.heading: APPSC ASO Computer Proficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates provisionally shortlisted after the written examination must qualify the Computer Proficiency Test. It is a practical examination assessing office automation and computer software proficiency.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The APPSC ASO syllabus consists of General Studies and Mental Ability in Paper I and subject-related topics in Paper II. The Computer Proficiency Test has a separate practical syllabus. Current events at international, national and Andhra Pradesh state levels. General Science and developments in Science and Technology. Indian History, with emphasis on Andhra Pradesh and the National Movement. Geography of India and Andhra Pradesh. Indian Polity, Constitution, Governance and Public Policy. Indian Economy and Economic Planning. Sustainable Development and Environmental Protection. Disaster Management and Remote Sensing. Logical Reasoning and Analytical Ability. Data Analysis, Tabulation, Mean, Median, Mode and Variance. The subject paper includes Economics, Statistics, Accounting and related analytical topics prescribed in the official syllabus. Economic Concepts and National Income. International Economics and International Trade. Indian Economy and Economic Planning. Financial Accounting. Statistical Methods and Applications. Data Analysis and Interpretation. Index Numbers and related statistical concepts. Candidates should refer to Annexure II of the official notification for the complete topic-wise Paper II syllabus. Introduction to Computers and Computer Components. Input and Output Devices. Computer Hardware and Software. Operating Systems. Windows Operating System. Basic Linux and Mac OS Concepts. Internet and Computer Communication. Office Automation and Related Software Applications.

content_sections.heading: APPSC ASO Examination Centres 2026
content_sections.text: The Computer Based Recruitment Test will be conducted at four examination centres. Candidates may indicate three centre preferences in their application. APPSC reserves the right to allot examination centres based on availability and administrative requirements.

content_sections.text: The selection process involves application scrutiny, shortlisting of candidates, verification of original certificates, physical fitness verification, and execution of an apprenticeship contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MeECL Graduate Apprentice
content_sections.text: Visit the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal at www.mhrdnats.gov.in and complete online registration to obtain a valid NATS enrollment ID. Obtain application format A from the notification PDF. Fill out all mandatory fields in the application form in capital letters without using initials. Attach self-attested photocopies of EPIC or Passport, consolidated or final mark sheet of essential qualification, conversion certificate for grades if applicable, 10th standard certificate or birth certificate for DOB, 2 passport size photographs, caste certificate, and physical challenge certificate if applicable. Fill out the undertaking form with required personal details, place, date, and signature. Submit the completed application form along with necessary documents to the Office of the Director, Human Resource Development Centre, MeECL, Umiam-793103, Ri-Bhoi District, Meghalaya on or before 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: EPIC or Passport Consolidated Mark sheet or last mark sheet of essential qualification University/College conversion certificate for grades/CGPA to percentage (if applicable) 10th Standard Certificate or Birth Certificate for Date of Birth 2 Nos. Passport size photographs Caste certificate in prescribed format (for SC/ST/OBC) Certificate of Physical Challenge (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: MeECL Graduate Apprentice Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must have an active email ID, mobile number, and EPIC card. No graduate holder who has training or job experience for one year or more after attaining the qualification is eligible. Persons with previous job experience of one or more years after passing the minimum qualifying examination are not eligible unless approved by the Apprentice Advisor of BOAT. Selected candidates will be required to appear for original certificate verification at their own cost. Selected candidates must produce a physical fitness certificate from a medical practitioner at their own cost. Selected candidates have to execute a contract of apprenticeship and arrange their own transport, accommodation, and food during training. Incomplete applications, forms not in the prescribed format, unsigned applications, or applications without required enclosures will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: SSSB Punjab Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates who successfully apply for the notified posts will be called for an Objective Type (Multiple Choice Question, MCQ) written examination. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination. There will be negative marking in this written examination: each question carries 1 mark, and ¼ mark will be deducted for a wrong answer. In case of a tie in merit in the written examination: first, the candidate with the higher age (based on date of birth) will rank above; if the date of birth is also the same, the candidate with a higher percentage in the required educational qualification will rank above; if this is also tied, the candidate with higher marks in Matriculation will rank above. Based on the merit list, candidates will be called for counseling for verification of all documents. The number of candidates called for counseling will be decided by the Board or its competent authority/officer, keeping in view the category-wise number of vacancies. After counseling, the names of candidates found completely successful/eligible will be recommended to the concerned department as per the then-current number of vacancies (which may be reduced or increased at any time during the recruitment process as per the concerned department's orders/instructions). Applying online, appearing in the written exam, having one's name in the merit list, or being called for counseling does not by itself entitle a candidate to be recommended for a post. Only after the candidate's eligibility is proved in every respect will their name be recommended to the department on the basis of merit in the written examination. If a candidate is unable to prove their eligibility, their candidature will be cancelled, and the Board's decision in this regard will be final. Candidates called for counseling will be considered only under the category/post code against which they applied.

content_sections.heading: KVIC Technical Expert Job Description
content_sections.text: Technical Expert Responsibilities: To act as mentor for units setup under PMEGP, provide handholding support to the new and old entrepreneurs, guide prospective entrepreneurs to establish viable projects and about PMEGP Scheme benefits and procedure, provide guidance on modern technology processes and management practices, and regular monitoring of progress made. Marketing Expert Responsibilities: Develop, implement, and track marketing programs such as email, social media, or digital campaigns, and events; collaborate with other internal teams to develop and monitor strategic marketing initiatives; analyze and report on the performance and efficiency of campaigns; conduct market research and analyze trends to identify new marketing opportunities; develop and create marketing materials, such as sales and product collateral; write, proofread, and edit creative and technical content across different mediums; work with external agencies and vendors to execute marketing programs; excellent time management; and ability to travel as necessary. Retired Bank Official Responsibilities: Provide handholding support to the new and old entrepreneurs, guide prospective entrepreneurs to establish viable projects, help in preparation of detailed project reports and other related documents to reduce rejection from financing banks, reduce time to market by streamlining application process, and regular monitoring of progress made.

selection_process: The selection process consists of two primary stages:

exam_pattern.details: Written Examination: The written test comprises 25 objective-type multiple-choice questions carrying 2 marks each, totaling 50 marks. The duration of the exam is 45 minutes. Attach self-attested photocopies of all educational certificates, technical qualifications, age proof (Matriculation marksheet), category certificate, and domicile certificate.
Enclose self-signed photocopies of identity documents such as Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence, or Voter ID Card.
If employed in government or semi-government service, attach a self-attested copy of the No Objection Certificate (NOC) issued by the competent authority.
Write the name of the post applied for and category clearly on the top of the envelope containing the application.
Send the completed application form exclusively by post to reach the office of the District and Sessions Judge Korba on or before 30 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

Increments accrued shall continue at the time of renewal of each contract period, and the contract may continue till the retirement age of 60 years or the project period whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance and renewal of the contract period from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Bank of Baroda Faculty Job Description
content_sections.text: The support staff for Faculty at RSETIs shall perform the following duties and responsibilities: Any other work assigned by the Director from time to time. Work as Faculty of the Institute handling sessions relating to entrepreneurship, motivation personality development, business management, conducting business games etc., guiding/educating the trainees and coordinating the programmes of the Institute. Conducting pre-training activities - EAPs, generation of applications and selection of candidates. Assisting the Director in designing the Annual Action Plan and training programmes. Arranging logistics for the training programmes, including training materials and arranging Guest faculty. Providing post Training escort services including conducting follow-up meets/visits. Providing counseling, credit linkage, preparation of project reports etc. Preparation of Success Stories and circulation of a minimum of two stories per month to the Controlling Office/MoRD. Preparation of Post Programme Report and monthly/periodical reports. Assisting/Guiding the Office assistant in maintaining of Day book, General Ledger and all other registers and Books. Design new training programs by collecting feedback on emerging business opportunities in the area. Prepare case studies and training materials for effective delivery of sessions and establish liaison with outside agencies. Assist Director in internal control/administration, organizing functions, events, and meetings of the Institute. Preparation of Press release/reports on various activities, supervising assistant, attender, watchman cum Gardner, and monitoring Guest faculty performance. Maintenance of Inventory and Library books, and overseeing the maintenance of the entire campus including classrooms, kitchen, dining, and dormitory to keep premises clean and tidy. Maintaining discipline in the Institute and ensuring administration of MILLY, LOG, PRAYER, YOGA, SHRAMADHAN etc., on daily basis.

and a candidate must additionally secure at least 40% marks in aggregate in the Written Examination to be considered to have qualified. along with a Disability Certificate and

and candidates may raise objections or cross-objections
supported by reasons and documentary proof

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, under the head "Clerk District Courts of Punjab" on the official website sssc.gov.in. No other mode of submission is accepted. The broad process is:
Registration: Fill the Registration form first, followed by the Application Form.
Real-time photograph: Capture a real-time photograph using an inbuilt or attached webcam, as required within the Online Application Form.
Upload documents: Upload a scanned recent passport-size photograph (not more than one month old, against a white background) and a scanned signature.
Fill in all details carefully: Enter all personal details, including category and sub-category, correctly - no change is permitted after submission.

Pay the fee: The application form is linked to a fee payment gateway (internet banking, debit card, credit card, or UPI); the online application is considered submitted only after successful payment of the fee, which is non-refundable.
Retain documents: Keep a printed copy of the submitted application, and retain 5 copies of the uploaded photograph for later stages of the recruitment process.

Candidates must ensure the real-time photograph, the uploaded scanned photograph, and the photograph pasted on the E-Admit Card all match, and that their facial appearance at the exam matches these photographs - any mismatch means the candidate will not be allowed to enter the examination centre.
important_instructions: All applicants, irrespective of category, can submit only one application for a particular category; if more than one application is submitted, only the latest will be considered. Merely satisfying the eligibility criteria does not entitle an applicant to be called for the examination; admission at every stage is provisional and subject to subsequent scrutiny. Applicants currently in government service must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their Head of Office/Department and produce it when called for; failure to do so will result in cancellation of candidature. Reservation benefits require applicants to submit the latest, valid certificates issued by the Competent Authority of the Government of Punjab, valid as on the closing date of the application. E-Admit Cards will be uploaded on the website (with E-mail/SMS notification) and must be downloaded by candidates themselves; admit cards are not sent by post. No mobile phone, electronic device, watch, or jewellery/ornaments are allowed inside the examination centre. All applicants must give an undertaking that they will work anywhere in the State of Punjab where posted. Concealing material facts or furnishing false information can lead to rejection of candidature at any stage; canvassing in any form or use of unfair means will lead to cancellation of candidature. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the exam or for checking of original testimonials/interaction. Success in the examination confers no automatic right to appointment, which remains subject to the Competent Authority's satisfaction regarding the candidate's suitability in all respects.

basic_details.job_title: UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 530 Posts
basic_details.organization_name: UCO Bank, HRM Department, Head Office, Kolkata
basic_details.short_information: UCO Bank invites online applications from candidates for engagement as apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended). Candidates can apply for only one State/UT. Selection is through an online objective test conducted by the BFSI Sector Skill Council of India (BFSI SSC), followed by a local language test during document verification and a medical fitness check. Apprentices are trainees, not employees of the Bank, and have no right to employment after training. Register for Job Alerts

application_fee.details: The fee is paid online to BFSI SSC through the secure payment link in the application form, between 14 October and 29 October 2026. It is non-refundable under any circumstances, whether or not the candidate attends the test or is shortlisted, and cannot be adjusted against any other selection process.

age_limit.details: The age limit is a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 28 years as on 1 October 2026 (the maximum applies to Unreserved and EWS candidates).

qualification.details: Candidates must hold a graduate degree from a recognised University/Institute approved by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies. The graduation mark sheets and provisional/final degree certificate must have been issued on or after 1 April 2022. | Nationality: A citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before January 1962 to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries and Vietnam with the intention of settling in India (the last three categories need an eligibility certificate from the Government of India). Candidates must not have undergone, or be currently undergoing, apprenticeship with UCO Bank or any other organisation, and apprentices terminated by their organisation are not eligible. Candidates with training or job experience of one year or more after completing their educational qualification are not eligible. Candidates applying for a particular State/UT must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding at least one local language of that State/UT. A language test is conducted during document verification; candidates who produce a 10th or 12th mark sheet showing they studied the local language are exempt. Candidates may apply for only one State/UT; multiple applications will be rejected (only the last valid application is considered).

salary_details.details: Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances or benefits. Daily training hours are as applicable to the Bank's clerical staff. Transport, hostel or any other residential accommodation is not provided.
