The local language test is held during document verification. Engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit as per the Bank's requirement. The Bank may declare a wait list at its discretion to cover non-acceptance or non-reporting by selected candidates.
UCO Bank Apprentice Syllabus 2026
how_to_apply: Applications are accepted online only; no hard copy of the application or documents is to be sent to the Bank. The process is:
Register on NATS: Register on the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal (nats.education.gov.in, "Student Register/Login") and note your Enrolment ID.
Apply for UCO Bank's apprenticeship: After logging in, view the "UCO Bank" apprenticeship advertisement and apply for it on the portal, choosing one State/UT.

Check your email from BFSI SSC: Candidates who applied on NATS receive an email from BFSI SSC ([email protected]) inviting them to provide caste category, choice of districts for training, and other details, and to pay the fee.
Complete details and pay the fee: Submit the additional information and pay the online fee at beep.bfsissc.com by 29 October 2026. Details entered must match those on the NATS portal.

Upload documents: Upload the photograph, signature, date of birth proof, graduation certificates and other certificates as required by the apprenticeship portal or when advised by the Bank or BFSI SSC.
Appear for the online test: Take the test on 7 November 2026 using the link sent by email.

The candidate's name must be spelt exactly as in the certificates/mark sheets, percentage should be given to two decimals (CGPA must be converted to percentage), and no change is allowed after submission.
important_instructions: Candidates must have a valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active until the engagement process is complete; call letters and intimations are sent by email/SMS only. Original certificates for educational qualification, age and category must be produced at document verification, or candidature is cancelled. OBC candidates need a non-creamy layer certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026; EWS candidates need an Income and Asset Certificate valid for FY 2026-27 (income of FY 2025-26); PwBD candidates need a disability certificate (UDID/certificates may be verified, and a medical board may reassess). Apprentices are trainees, not employees; PF, ESI, bonus and other labour-law provisions do not apply, they may not join or form a union, and the Bank has no obligation to offer employment after training. Candidates must execute a Contract of Apprenticeship before training begins; those who absent themselves may have to refund training costs and stipend received. Travel costs for document verification are borne by the candidate. Requests for changes of contact details, address, email or test centre are not entertained. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. All disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the Courts at Kolkata. All revisions and corrigenda will be published only on www.uco.bank.in (career section).

faq.question: Q1. What is UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. HO/HRM/RECR/2026-27/COM-02 from UCO Bank for the engagement of 530 apprentices for one year under the Apprentices Act, 1961, across 31 States/UTs.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 530 provisional seats: 106 SC, 49 ST, 147 OBC (NCL), 23 EWS and 205 UR. West Bengal has the most seats (86), followed by Uttar Pradesh (45) and Odisha (41).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for registration, exam fee payment and submission of additional information is 29 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for UCO Bank Apprentice?
faq.answer: A graduate degree from a recognised University/Institute, with mark sheets and degree certificate issued on or after 1 April 2022.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 20 to 28 years as on 1 October 2026, with relaxation for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10 to 15 years) and concessions for widows, divorced and legally separated women.

faq.question: Q6. What is the UCO Bank Apprentice application fee?
faq.answer: ₹200 plus GST for SC/ST and PwBD candidates; ₹800 plus GST for General/EWS/OBC male candidates; and ₹600 plus GST for General/EWS/OBC female and transgender candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UCO Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register on the NATS portal, apply for UCO Bank's apprenticeship there, then complete details and pay the fee at beep.bfsissc.com by 29 October 2026, as described in the How to Apply section above.

faq.question: Q8. What is the UCO Bank Apprentice selection process?
faq.answer: A 100-mark, 60-minute online objective test on 7 November 2026, a local language test at document verification, and a medical fitness check. The merit list is State-wise and category-wise.

faq.question: Q9. What is the stipend for UCO Bank Apprentices?
faq.answer: ₹16,650 per month, made up of ₹10,500 from UCO Bank and ₹6,150 government share through DBT.

content_sections.heading: SCI Senior Personal Assistant Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of four stages: an Objective Type Test containing multiple-choice questions, a Shorthand (English) Test, a Typing Speed Test on Computer, and an Interview. Stage 1: Objective Type Test (100 marks, 1.5 hours) containing questions on General English, General Knowledge, provisions relating to the Judiciary in the Constitution of India, Supreme Court Rules 2013, and Knowledge of Computer operation. Minimum qualifying marks: 50. Stage 2: Shorthand (English) Test at the speed of 110 words per minute (7 minutes dictation, 45 minutes transcription). Maximum marks: 100, minimum qualifying marks: 50. Stage 3: Typing Speed Test on Computer in English language with minimum speed of 40 w.p.m. (duration: 10 minutes). Maximum marks: 20, minimum qualifying marks: 10. Stage 4: Interview (Maximum marks: 30, minimum qualifying marks: 15).

The entire face must be clearly visible and centered. The head should occupy at least 50% of the photograph area. Do not wear a cap, mask or spectacles while capturing the photograph. Do not photograph a printed or existing digital photograph. Important: Since the photograph is captured live, there is no separate RRB NTPC photo upload size or KB requirement for a pre-existing photograph under CEN 06/2026. content_sections.heading: Canara Bank Apprentice Reservation Details
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC/ ST/ OBC/ EWS/ PwBD candidates is as per the prescribed reservation percentages of the respective States/ UTs as per Government guidelines. Candidates from reserved categories, including those for whom no reservation is mentioned, may apply for unreserved vacancies if they fulfil all eligibility conditions applicable to the unreserved category. Under section 34 of "The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016", persons with benchmark disabilities are eligible for reservation. The post is identified as suitable for the following disability categories as defined in the Schedule of the RPwD Act 2016. Visual Impairment (VI): Persons with blindness (total absence of sight; visual acuity less than 3/ 60 or less than 10/ 200 (Snellen) in the better eye with best possible correction; or limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 10 degrees) or low vision (visual acuity not exceeding 6/ 18 or less than 20/ 60 up to 3/ 60 or up to 10/ 200 (Snellen) in the better eye with best possible correction; or limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 40 degrees up to 10 degrees). Hearing Impaired (HI): Deaf (70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears) or Hard of Hearing (60 DB to 70 DB hearing loss in speech frequencies in both ears). Orthopedically Challenged/ Locomotor Disability (OC/ LD): Inability to execute distinctive activities associated with movement of self and objects resulting from affliction of the musculoskeletal or nervous system or both, including Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism (adult height of 4 feet 10 inches (147 centimeters) or less), Muscular Dystrophy, Acid Attack Victims, Spinal Deformity and Spinal Injury without any associated neurological/ limb dysfunction. Intellectual Disability (ID): Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), Specific Learning Disability (SLD) and Mental Illness (MI), as defined in the notification. Multiple Disabilities: Multiple disabilities among the categories above. Only persons with benchmark disabilities are eligible for reservation. A benchmark disability means not less than 40% of a specified disability, as certified by the certifying authority. Candidates must submit a disability certificate issued by a Competent Authority as per Government of India guidelines, which is subject to verification or re-verification at any point. PwBD reservation is not applicable on the basis of a temporary disability certificate. It is only for persons with irreversible permanent benchmark disability in terms of O.M. No. 36035/ 8/ 2023-Estt. (Res-II) dated 19.05.2023 of DoPT. Government guidelines may change from time to time. Persons not covered under the reservation schemes for SC, ST and OBC, and whose family gross annual income is below Rs. 8.00 lakh, are identified as EWS. content_sections.text: Candidates must apply online. No other mode of application will be accepted. Register on https:/ / nats.education.gov.in and complete your profile to 100%. Keep the enrollment number generated. Visit www.canarabank.bank.in, open Careers, then Recruitment, then the link "Engagement of Graduate Apprentices in Canara Bank under Apprentices Act, 1961 for FY 2026-27". Click "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter basic information. A provisional registration number and password are generated and sent by email and SMS. Saved data can be reopened using them. Enter the NATS enrollment ID, fill all fields, and choose one State along with district preferences. Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as specified below. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to verify details. No change is possible after clicking FINAL SUBMIT. Pay the fee online (if applicable), then take a printout of the application and e-receipt. Apply well before the closing date to avoid website load issues. Only one application should be submitted; if multiple are submitted, only the latest valid completed application is retained. The declaration text is: "I, ____ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." Candidates without a left thumb may use the right thumb or other alternatives given in the notification, and must mention the finger and hand/ toe used in the uploaded document. Candidates who cannot write may type the declaration and put their left thumb impression below it. Images should be scanned at a minimum of 200 dpi in true colour, in JPG/ JPEG format. Unclear or smudged images may lead to rejection. Candidates also need a valid personal email ID and mobile number, active until the process ends, and should spell their name as in the SSC/ SSLC/ X Standard marks card (or as per Gazette Notification/ Marriage Certificate if changed). An application that is incomplete or has unsuccessful fee payment is invalid. If no email/ SMS intimation is received, the application is considered not successfully registered.

basic_details.job_title: DPCC Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Offline for 59 Legal Assistant, Scientific Assistant & More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Delhi Pollution Control Committee (DPCC), Department of Environment, Government of NCT of Delhi, has issued a rolling advertisement for 59 posts on deputation, including short-term contract, open only to officers holding a regular post in the Central or State Government, a Union Territory, a recognised research institute, an autonomous or statutory body, or a PSU. Candidates must be no older than 56 on the closing date of the phase they apply in. Officers working in private organisations, on contract, retired or unemployed are not considered.

important_dates.age reckoned as on: Closing date of the phase in which the application is received

qualification.details: "Analogous post" means the same post held on a regular basis in the parent organisation. Where the circular names a pay level, the years of regular service must be in that level or its equivalent. "Related field of engineering" for the engineering posts means Civil, Environment, Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, ECE, Biomedical Engineering, Water Resources, Remote Sensing, GIS or Hydrology.

selection_process: The circular does not set out a written test or a scoring scheme. It refers to candidates being called for interview
and the NOC requirement for advance-copy applicants is specifically for "appearing in interview". DPCC reserves the right not to fill any post
and the number of posts may change. Selection details will be posted on the DPCC website from time to time.
how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only through proper channel, in the prescribed proforma, in English or Hindi.
Download the advertisement and the application form from dpcc.delhigovt.nic.in under "Office Order & Circulars".

Fill in the proforma: post applied for, personal and department details, date of retirement, education, a point-by-point statement of how you meet each essential and desirable requirement, employment history with pay level of the post held on a regular basis (enclose your latest salary slip), nature of present employment, feeder-grade status, total emoluments, and supporting information such as publications, awards and professional affiliations. Affix a recent passport-size photograph and sign the declaration.
Attach self-attested copies of proof of age, educational qualifications, work experience, and SC/ST/OBC/PwD certificate if claiming.

Have your employer or cadre-controlling authority complete the certification on the last page: that the particulars are correct, you hold the qualifications and experience, you will be relieved if selected, no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending, integrity is certified, the CR dossier or attested ACR/APAR copies for the last five years are enclosed, and whether any major or minor penalty was imposed in the last ten years.

Your department forwards the application with the signed bio-data, attested APAR copies for five years, integrity certificate, vigilance clearance and penalty statement to: The Administrative Officer, Delhi Pollution Control Committee, 3rd Floor, IT Park, DMRC Building, Shastri Park, Delhi – 110053
Write the name of the post on the envelope.

If your department's forwarding may be delayed, you may send an advance copy. In that case you must produce a No Objection Certificate from your department to appear for the interview, with an undertaking to submit all requisite documents before joining. An advance copy does not replace the proper-channel application.
Applications that are incomplete, not through proper channel, or without attested APAR copies are not considered; there is no second chance within the phase.
If you already applied to DPCC's earlier rolling advertisement with complete documents, you do not need to apply again.
Each post has two independent conditions (service and qualification). Check both before asking your department to forward the application, since candidature cannot be withdrawn later.
No correspondence or representation is entertained about interview calls or selection.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Eligibility
content_sections.text: "Analogous post" means the same post held on a regular basis in the parent organisation. Where the circular names a pay level, the years of regular service must be in that level or its equivalent. "Related field of engineering" for the engineering posts means Civil, Environment, Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, ECE, Biomedical Engineering, Water Resources, Remote Sensing, GIS or Hydrology. Senior Environmental Engineer (Level 12, 8 posts): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 11; and a Master's degree in engineering in a related field with ten years' experience in pollution control or a related field after the Master's. Environmental Engineer (Level 11, 15 posts): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 10; and either a Bachelor's degree in engineering in a related field with eight years' experience in pollution control after the degree, or a Master's degree in engineering in a related field with six years' experience after the Master's. Assistant Environmental Engineer (Level 10, 15 posts): analogous post in Level 10 on a regular basis; and a degree in engineering in a related field with two years' experience in pollution control or a related field, or a Master's degree in engineering. Additional Director (Scientific) (Level 13, 1 post): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 12; and a Master's degree in science with fifteen years' experience in pollution control or related subjects, or a doctorate in science with ten years' experience. Senior Scientist L-II / Scientist-D (Level 12, 1 post): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 11; and a Master's degree in science with thirteen years' experience in pollution control or related subjects, or a doctorate in science. Senior Scientist L-I / Scientist-C (Level 11, 2 posts): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 10; and a Master's degree in science with eight years' experience in pollution control or related subjects. Scientist-B (Level 10, 1 post): analogous post, or eight years' regular service in analogous posts in Level 6; and a Master's degree in science with three years' experience in pollution control or related subjects. Scientific Assistant (Level 6, 4 posts): analogous post, or ten years' regular service in Level 4; and a Bachelor's degree in science with experience in laboratory work. Senior Lab Assistant (Level 4, 5 posts): analogous post, or eight years' regular service in Level 2. The circular sets no separate educational qualification for this post. Assistant Law Officer (Level 7, 1 post): analogous post, or five years' regular service in Level 6; and a Bachelor's degree in law with four years' experience as a legal practitioner or four years handling legal work in a government department, PSU, autonomous or statutory body. Legal Assistant (Level 6, 5 posts): analogous post, or three years' regular service in Level 6 after regular appointment; and a degree in law. Service condition: analogous post,

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay: each post carries the pay matrix level shown in the vacancy table. Pay, allowances and other terms of deputation are regulated by DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended, which governs pay fixation and deputation (duty) allowance for officers on deputation. Tenure: one year, extendable up to three years. Deputation including any immediately preceding ex-cadre post should not ordinarily exceed three years in total. Withdrawal: candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later.

Attach certified copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HOD on each page.
Attach attested copies of educational qualification certificates, work experience certificates, and administrative/no-objection certificate (Annexure-IV).
Enclose the applicant undertaking regarding non-withdrawal of candidature and vigilance clearance certificate (Annexure-V).
Superscribe the envelope as "Application for the post of Dy Personnel Officer on deputation / absorption basis".

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Technical Assistant post under the District Climate Change Mission - Krishnagiri.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have basic typing skills in Tamil and English. Minimum 1 year of experience in a related field gets preference. Particular preference for candidates with 1 year of experience in a government department or government office. Data Entry / Data Management experience. Experience in government office file maintenance, inward/outward register maintenance, and archiving. Good proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel, and MS Power Point. Ability to prepare government reports, letters, statistical data, and Power Point Presentations. Experience in data collection and office document work. Good communication and coordination skills.

rows.qualification_required: Degree in any of the following departments: Life Science, Environmental Science, Forestry, Wild life Science, Public Policy, or Related/Similar fields. Must also possess basic typing skills in Tamil and English.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Age Limit
content_sections.text: Applicants must not exceed 40 years of age at the time of applying. Candidates must belong to or be residents of Krishnagiri district.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Salary
content_sections.text: Travel Head allowances are provided for official travel related to the post.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applicant qualifications, personal interview, and typing test. A waiting list of 2 to 3 persons will be maintained as required. Under the guidance of DCCM, the Technical Assistant's key responsibilities include coordination between departments, capacity-building events, archiving, and coordinating DCCM operations.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DCCM Krishnagiri Technical Assistant
content_sections.text: Check eligibility criteria for the Technical Assistant post as per the notification. Prepare the application with required educational and experience documents. Ensure the applicant is a resident/native of Krishnagiri district and under 40 years of age. Send or submit the filled application to the official office address before the last date. Note the last date for application submission, which is 30.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates (Degree in Life Science, Environmental Science, Forestry, Wild life Science, Public Policy, or related fields) Proof of age and residency (Krishnagiri district residency proof) Experience certificates (if any, particularly government department experience) Proof of computer skills (MS Word, Excel, Power Point, Data Entry) Typing skill proof (Tamil and English)

content_sections.heading: DCCM Krishnagiri Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on a contract basis for a period of 19 months. Monthly remuneration is Rs. 22,000/- with a project duration allocation of 19 months. The workplace is the District Collectorate, Tiruchirapalli, as stated in the administrative context, under the District Climate Change Mission, Krishnagiri. Applicants must be residents or natives of Krishnagiri district. The applicant's age must not exceed 40 years at the time of application. Preference is given to candidates with at least 1 year of relevant experience, especially in government departments. A waiting list of 2 to 3 candidates will be maintained as needed.

rows.qualification_required: Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture/ Horticulture/ Community Science/Veterinary Science as relevant to the requirement of the post. For the post of Assistant Professor in Sericulture, the essential requirement is Bachelor’s degree in either Sericulture or Agriculture. Secured minimum 55% marks or minimum Cumulative Grade Point Average (MCGPA) of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in the discipline relevant to the post from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified National Eligibility Test (NET), or NET is waived for candidates with Ph.D. degree obtained under course credit system as per UGC Regulations, 2009, provided the candidate has at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5 on the last date of submission of application. A minimum score (44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST) as stipulated in the 'Academic Performance Indicator' (API) based 'Performance Based Appraisal System' (PBAS) is required to be called for interview.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Science with Physics or Meteorology as the major subject OR Passed Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture/Veterinary Science/Community Science/ Fisheries/ Forestry. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Meteorology/Agricultural Meteorology from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified NET or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Agriculture/ Veterinary Science/ Community Science/ Fisheries/ Forestry/ Agricultural Engineering. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Business Administration from an Indian university or a foreign university. OR MBA/PGDM from reputed institutions like IIM with two years working experience in reputed organization. Qualified NET (where applicable) or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. Minimum score of 44 out of 80 for General & 40 out of 80 for SC/ST based on PBAS for interview call.

Passed Bachelor’s Degree in Science with Statistics as major subject OR Passed Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture/Veterinary Science/Community Science/ Fisheries/ Forestry. Secured minimum 55% marks or MCGPA of 3.00 in 4 point scale or 7.00 in 10 point scale at the Master’s degree level in Statistics/Agricultural Statistics from an Indian university or a foreign university. Qualified NET or NET waived for Ph.D. degree holders under specific UGC regulations with at least two full length publications having NAAS rating not less than 5. how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, through the Commission's website upsssc.gov.in. Applications sent through any other mode will not be accepted. The broad process is:
On the UPSSSC homepage, under the "Live Advertisement Segment," locate and download/view the relevant advertisement.
Login via PET-2025 registration number: Candidates authenticate/log in using their PET-2025 registration number, verified via an OTP sent to their registered mobile number/email.

Review auto-filled details: Personal details recorded at PET-2025 (name, parents'/spouse's name, UP residency status, category, EWS status, horizontal reservation details, date of birth, gender, marital status, contact details) are displayed automatically.
Select post(s): Candidates must select the post(s) they wish to apply for; a post not selected will not be considered.

Confirm qualification details: Candidates confirm Yes/No for holding the required qualification for the selected post(s), and enter board/institution/university name, year of passing, certificate/roll number, and marks obtained.
Verify photo and signature: The photo and signature uploaded at PET-2025 are displayed automatically and cannot be changed at this stage.
Preferential qualification and address: Candidates indicate Yes/No for any preferential qualification, and their permanent/correspondence address from PET-2025 is displayed automatically.

Declaration and submission: Candidates must read and accept the declaration, enter the verification code, and submit. A completed application with an 11-digit registration number is generated; a printed copy should be retained safely.

Pay the fee: Pay the applicable fee (see Fee section above) via the payment options on the portal. The application cannot be finally submitted, downloaded, or printed until the fee payment is confirmed/adjusted by the bank.
Download and verify printout: After successful fee payment and adjustment, download and print the application form and check all entries carefully.
important_instructions: Candidates must possess the required essential qualification(s) and other eligibility conditions, and fall within the prescribed age limit, by the application closing date (6 November 2026). Candidates seeking reservation/age relaxation benefits must obtain the relevant caste/reservation certificate, in the prescribed format, issued by a competent authority on or before the date specified in the notification, and must produce it to the Commission when required. EWS category applicants must hold an EWS certificate issued between 1 April 2026 and 6 November 2026 (the application closing date), based on income for financial year 2025–26, valid for financial year 2026–27, in the prescribed format. Candidates must indicate their post preference at the time of document scrutiny; the Commission will attempt to allot posts as per preference, subject to availability, seniority, educational qualification, and age, but the Commission's decision is final. Only one application is to be made for the advertised posts. After final submission, applications can be modified only via the "Modify Application" option on the Applicant's Dashboard, using an OTP sent to the registered mobile/email, and only for specified fields (correspondence address, EWS and horizontal reservation category details, mandatory/preferential qualification details, and marital status) - other details, including category, date of birth, and gender, cannot be changed. Candidates must adjust their fee payment and download their application printout by the closing date or within 7 days thereafter (by 13 November 2026); after this, no fee adjustment or printout will be possible, and the application will not be considered valid. No request for correction/modification will be accepted after the correction deadline of 13 November 2026 under any circumstances. If any discrepancy or false information is found at any stage, the candidate's application/candidature will be rejected, and further debarment or disciplinary action may follow.

Higher age relaxation is available to candidates of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, and such other categories as may be notified by the Government from time to time, to the extent specified in those notifications. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Yuva Kalyan Adhikari & Vyayam Prashikshak Selection Process
content_sections.text: As stated in the notification, the basis of selection is the written (Main) examination . The minimum physical standards and the Physical Efficiency Test described below are qualifying in nature; candidates who clear these are shortlisted, but the final merit list is prepared strictly on the basis of marks obtained in the written examination. The written exam consists of a single objective-type, multiple-choice paper of 2 hours (120 minutes) duration. Each question carries 1 mark, and there is a negative marking provision of 25% (i.e. one-fourth) of the marks allotted to a question for each wrong answer. As per the 2017 Service Rules, candidates must also clear a discipline-specific Physical Efficiency Test:

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Yuva Kalyan Adhikari & Vyayam Prashikshak Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the required essential qualification(s) and other eligibility conditions, and fall within the prescribed age limit, by the application closing date (6 November 2026). Candidates seeking reservation/age relaxation benefits must obtain the relevant caste/reservation certificate, in the prescribed format, issued by a competent authority on or before the date specified in the notification, and must produce it to the Commission when required. EWS category applicants must hold an EWS certificate issued between 1 April 2026 and 6 November 2026 (the application closing date), based on income for financial year 2025–26, valid for financial year 2026–27, in the prescribed format. Candidates must indicate their post preference at the time of document scrutiny; the Commission will attempt to allot posts as per preference, subject to availability, seniority, educational qualification, and age, but the Commission's decision is final. Only one application is to be made for the advertised posts. After final submission, applications can be modified only via the "Modify Application" option on the Applicant's Dashboard, using an OTP sent to the registered mobile/email, and only for specified fields (correspondence address, EWS and horizontal reservation category details, mandatory/preferential qualification details, and marital status) - other details, including category, date of birth, and gender, cannot be changed. Candidates must adjust their fee payment and download their application printout by the closing date or within 7 days thereafter (by 13 November 2026); after this, no fee adjustment or printout will be possible, and the application will not be considered valid. No request for correction/modification will be accepted after the correction deadline of 13 November 2026 under any circumstances. If any discrepancy or false information is found at any stage, the candidate's application/candidature will be rejected, and further debarment or disciplinary action may follow.

faq.answer: A total of 412 posts: 368 for Kshetriya Yuva Kalyan evam Pradeshik Vikas Dal Adhikari (142 Special Selection + 226 Regular Selection) and 44 for Vyayam Prashikshak (22 + 22).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UPSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application and fee payment last date is 6 November 2026, with fee adjustment and correction permitted up to 13 November 2026.

faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years of age as on 1 July of the calendar year of advertisement, with age relaxation available for SC/ST and other notified categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the UPSSSC application fee?
faq.answer: At this application stage, the fee is ₹25 (online processing fee only) for Unreserved, OBC, SC, and ST candidates. A separate Main Examination fee applies only to shortlisted candidates, payable before downloading the Main Exam admit card.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UPSSSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible PET-2025 candidates must log in at upsssc.gov.in using their PET-2025 registration number and OTP, then follow the steps described in the How to Apply section above.

faq.answer: Selection is based on the written Main Examination (100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours); candidates must also separately clear a qualifying, discipline-specific Physical Efficiency Test and meet minimum physical standards, as detailed in the Selection Process section above.

content_sections.heading: IARI Young Professional Selection Process

content_sections.heading: APPSC CCE Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants for APPSCCE-2026 must satisfy all three mandatory eligibility conditions notified vide Government Notification F.No.AR-33/17/2026-SECT-1-AR dated 26 August 2026. This is a restricted, state-specific recruitment - candidates who do not meet all three conditions below are not eligible, regardless of qualification. Permanent Residence Criterion: The candidate must be a citizen of India and an inhabitant of Arunachal Pradesh holding a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) issued by the designated Competent Authority. Indigenous Status and APST Criterion: The candidate must be an original inhabitant of Arunachal Pradesh holding an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) Certificate, as per the list of Tribes notified under the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950. Indigenous Tribal Language Proficiency Criterion: The candidate must be able to speak an indigenous tribal language of Arunachal Pradesh and possess working knowledge of the local indigenous tribes.

The notification outlines the following steps: Keep ready a valid e-mail ID, mobile number, and Aadhaar number. Keep ready a scanned recent passport-size photograph and signature. Keep ready self-attested (signed) scanned copies, PDF preferred (DigiLocker or e-issued copies where available), of the certificates and mark sheets for every qualification and experience entered. Sign in with your e-mail address; a one-time password (OTP) will be sent to it. Fill in the application, upload the supporting document against each entry, accept the terms and conditions, and submit. The application, once submitted, is final. Note the application number and retain a print-out of the application for your records. Check the application status, and, if shortlisted, download the interview call letter, on the same portal by signing in with the same e-mail. A candidate may submit only one application per position through the portal; a separate application must be submitted for each position the candidate wishes to be considered for. No hard copy of the application needs to be submitted unless specifically called for by the Bureau.

basic_details.job_title: NHSRC Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is recruiting candidates for 1 Consultant post on a contractual basis. The initial contract is till 31st March 2028 with further extension subject to satisfactory performance, with a pay of Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,20,000 per month commensurate with qualification and experience. Applicants must possess an MBBS or BDS with MPH, MD, or Post Graduate Degree in Social Science in Health through regular courses only. Eligible candidates can apply online by filling out the prescribed online application form on the NHSRC website on or before 3 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official NHSRC website.
Access the online application portal for the Consultant position in the Knowledge Management Division.
Fill out the prescribed online application form correctly with all required details.
Submit the application online on or before the last date.
important_instructions: Only online applications submitted in the prescribed format through the official website are accepted. An age relaxation of up to 2 years may be granted to deserving candidates over the upper age limit of 45 years. Travel to states and districts may be involved as part of the work requirements. Applications received after 3 November 2026 will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Consultant at a Glance
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the following educational and experience criteria to be eligible for the Consultant position: Educational Qualification: Full-time regular bachelor's degree (minimum 3 years) and full-time regular postgraduate qualifications (minimum 2 years). Diploma, certificate, executive programmes, and qualifications obtained through distance, online, part-time, or correspondence mode are not considered. Required Degree: MBBS or BDS with MPH (Master of Public Health), or MD (Community Medicine / Preventive & Social Medicine), or MD (Social Preventive Medicine), or Post Graduate Degree in Social Science in Health from regular courses only. Additional Requirement: Published work in the area of health systems or public health. Experience: At least 2 years of post-qualification experience. Only post-qualification experience is counted.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fee offered is within the band of Rs. 60,000/- to Rs. 1,20,000/- per month, commensurate with qualification and experience. In addition to the remuneration, consultants are entitled to free accidental insurance, subsidized medical insurance, mobile bills reimbursement, laptop reimbursement as per NHSRC policy, 30 days consolidated leave, fully paid maternity leave for female consultants as per Government of India policy, performance-linked increments, and TA/DA with per diem for on-duty visits. The initial contract runs until 31st March 2028 and may be extended further subject to satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Consultant will handle various responsibilities under the Knowledge Management Division (KMD): Provide technical assistance to undertake research activities under KMD. Support activities as part of research including Implementation Research for Health Systems Strengthening (IR-HSS) and coordinate research priority setting workshops and annual research agendas. Provide technical inputs to research studies and protocols as required. Support review and analysis of published and grey literature and data from national, state, and district-level surveys, HMIS, SDG indicators, and UHC indicators. Create platforms for partners and stakeholders to share and create evidence-based knowledge. Ensure the availability of information from available data sources in an easily transferable and usable form and keep divisions abreast of latest findings. Support data collection, collation, analysis, and report writing for IR-HSS. Identify best practices and innovations within states and districts and support documentation. Ensure timely and high-quality responses to MoHFW and parliament questions. Support the KMD Advisor on administrative and technical matters.

Fill out the prescribed online application form correctly with all required details. Submit the application online on or before the last date.

content_sections.text: The recruitment process may include a written test, for which the minimum qualifying mark is 70%. In case two or more candidates qualify with the same marks, all such candidates will be considered. Candidates selected in the interview may also be considered for other vacant positions at NHSRC requiring similar skill sets at an appropriate level.

Plus, cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET, or awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with UGC Regulations 2009/2016. Alternatively, a Ph.D. degree obtained from a foreign university/institution ranked among the top 500 in World University Ranking by QS, Times Higher Education, or ARWU.

content_sections.heading: THDC Selection Process
content_sections.text: The marks obtained in Personal Interview will be taken as a basis for drawing final merit and empanelling the candidates for selection. No candidate securing overall less than 50% marks will be empanelled. Empanelment will be made in order of merit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for THDC Recruitment
content_sections.text: Go to the THDC website career section at the official link. Fill in your Basic Information and enter your name as mentioned in your Xth Marksheet certificate. Complete the fields for State Domicile, Category, Religion, Academics, Professional Qualification, Languages Known, and Address details. Fill in your experience details with proper mention of the period of service. Upload all required scanned documents in the specified formats and sizes. For General, OBC(NCL), and EWS candidates, click on 'Make Payment' to pay the registration fee of Rs. 600/- via SBIePay, check auto-fetched payment details, and click Submit. For ST/SC/PwBDs / Ex-Servicemen / Doob Kshetra / Departmental Candidates, directly click on the Submit button for Final Submission as no fee is required. Take a print out of the completed application form and keep it safely for future reference. Do not send printouts by post.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Scanned passport size color photograph with white background (Size: 50 KB, Format: JPG/PNG) Scanned signature in black ink against white background (Size: 20 KB, Format: JPG/PNG) Class Xth and XIIth Marksheet (Size: 125 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Marksheet & Degree (Full-Time/Regular) of essential qualification along with additional qualifications if any as one file (Size: 500 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Experience Certificate clearly mentioning the period of service and designation as one file (Size: 1 MB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Caste / Category / PwBD / J&K Domiciled / Ex-Servicemen / Victims of riots / Doob Kshetra Certificate in Government of India format (Size: 125 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Proof of norms adopted by University/Institute to convert CGPA/OGPA/DGPA into percentage or marksheet if CGPA is not applicable (Size: 125 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Form 16 of Previous Employer of FY 2024-2025 and FY 2025-26 for private sector candidates (Size: 500 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) Payslips for Sep 2024, Sep 2025, and Sep 2026 as one file (Size: 500 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF) CTC certificate duly signed and issued by Employer of FY 2024-25 and FY 2025-26 as per Annexure-A (Size: 500 KB, Format: JPG/PNG/PDF)

faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available across Senior Manager, Deputy General Manager, and Additional General Manager posts in Finance and HR.

faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 6 November 2026 up to 06:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for THDC Finance posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be CA or CMA qualified from The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or The Institute of Cost Accountants of India, along with required post-qualification executive experience.

faq.answer: Candidates need a full-time MBA with HRM specialization (HR as main or major subject) / HRD / HRM with minimum 60% marks, or a Post Graduate Degree / 2-year full-time Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management/IR/Labour Welfare with minimum 60% marks, or Masters in Social Work or MHROD, plus required post-qualification experience.

faq.answer: Candidates are selected based on marks obtained in a Personal Interview, which is used for drawing the final merit list.

faq.answer: The pay scale for Additional General Manager in E-8 Grade is Rs. 1,20,000 - 3% - 2,80,000.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | professor (academic level 14a): Ph.D. with 10 years of experience out of which 4 years should be as Associate Professor. First Class (Min 60%) or equivalent grade in Master’s Degree with a consistently good academic record (5% relaxation for SC/ST/DAP and 3% relaxation for OBC). Minimum eight ABDC-B/ ABS-3 or specified publication combinations indexed in WOS or Scopus. | associate professor (academic level 13a2): Ph.D. with six years of experience out of which 3 years post Ph.D. experience should be as Assistant Professor or equivalent / Candidates from Industry (Government/PSU/Research Organization) having experience of 6 years at the level equivalent to Assistant Professor. First class (Min 60%) or equivalent grade in Master’s degree with a consistently good academic record (5% relaxation for SC/ST/PWD and 3% relaxation for OBC). Minimum five ABDC-B/ ABS-3 or specified publication combinations indexed in WOS or Scopus. | assistant professor (academic level 13a1): Ph.D. with five years of experience out of which 3 years post Ph.D. experience should be as Assistant Professor or equivalent / Candidates from Industry (Government/PSU/Research Organization) having experience of 5 years at the level equivalent to Assistant Professor. First class (Min 60%) or equivalent grade in Master’s degree with a consistently good academic record (5% relaxation for SC/ST/DAP and 3% relaxation for OBC). Minimum four ABDC-B/ ABS-3 or specified publication combinations indexed in WOS or Scopus. | assistant professor, grade i (academic level 12): Ph.D. with three years of experience excluding Ph.D. experience / Candidates from Industry (Government / PSU / Research Organization) having experience of 3 years at the level equivalent to Assistant Professor. First class (Min 60%) or equivalent grade in Master’s Degrees with a consistently good academic record (5% relaxation for SC/ST/PWD and 3% relaxation for OBC). Minimum three ABDC-B/ ABS-3 or specified publication combinations indexed in WOS or Scopus. | assistant professor, grade ii (academic level 11): Ph.D. in the appropriate branch with more than one year of post-Ph.D. experience / Candidates from Industry (Government /PSU/Research Organization) having experience of more than one year of post-Ph.D. experience at the level equivalent to Assistant Professor. First-class (Min 60%) or equivalent grade in Master’s and Graduation Degrees, and Class XII and Class X (5% relaxation for SC/ST/PWD and 3% relaxation for OBC in Master’s and Bachelor’s degree). Minimum two ABDC-B/ ABS-3 or one ABDC-A/ABS-4 publications indexed in WOS or Scopus. | assistant professor, grade ii (academic level 10): Fresh Ph.D. in the appropriate branch with less than one year of post-Ph.D. experience excluding Ph.D. experience (candidates who have given viva voce with provisional award of Ph.D. may also apply). First-class (Min 60%) or equivalent grade in Master’s and Graduation Degrees, and Class XII and Class X (5% relaxation for SC/ST/DAP and 3% relaxation for OBC in Master’s and Bachelor’s degree). Minimum of one publication in an ABDC-B / ABS-3 category journal indexed in WOS or Scopus is mandatory. | professor/associate professor of practice (academic level 14a/13a2): Substantial experience (minimum 20 years) in industry or government with demonstrated understanding of and impact on practice, and interest/potential to teach Leadership Development Program (LDP) courses as a full-time activity. Ph.D. is desirable but not essential.

salary_details.details: The pay carries all other allowances such as DA, HRA/Leased Accommodation, LTC, Medical re-imbursement, Children Education Allowance, NPS, re-imbursement of telephone bills, incentive for research publications, faculty development fund for attending national and international conferences, membership of professional bodies etc. as per IIM Bodh Gaya Rules. Faculty members are permitted to pursue management consulting with income sharing with the Institute as per rules.

how_to_apply: Visit the official IIM Bodh Gaya website at www.iimbg.ac.in.
Go to the faculty recruitment section for the rolling advertisement details and Application Form.
Fill out the application form completely with all required academic and professional details.
Ensure all necessary supporting documents and publication details are attached.
Submit the application form online through the portal.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications in any respect will not be entertained by the Institute. Papers published ONLY in ABDC Journals will be considered for shortlisting of applications. Mere fulfillment of the qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. The Institute reserves the right to consider and to fill or not to fill positions in any of the above and/or any other specialization(s). All qualifications must be from UGC recognized University/ Deemed University or AICTE approved autonomous institution. For regular appointments, there would be a probation period of 2 years. Depending on the academic credentials of the candidate, the Institute may consider them for an offer on a contractual basis of one/two years. Reservation Policy will apply as per the Government of India Rules.

how_to_apply: Candidates satisfying the prescribed eligibility criteria must apply online through the KVIC online recruitment system. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted, and candidates are not required to send application documents separately to KVIC.
Visit the official KVIC website at www.kvic.gov.in.
Open the VACANCIES section.
Select the relevant Young Professional recruitment advertisement.
The candidate will be redirected to the KVIC Online Recruitment Portal at apps.kvic.gov.in.
Register using a valid and active email ID and mobile number.
Create the required login credentials.
Log in and select the relevant recruitment.
Select the Young Professional post for which you are eligible.
Enter personal details, educational qualification, experience and other required information.
Upload the photograph, signature and required certificates.
Check all information carefully before final submission.
Submit the online application.
Note the generated application/registration number and retain a copy of the submitted application form for future reference.
Valid email ID.
Valid mobile number.
Personal details.
Educational qualification details.
Recent passport-size colour photograph.
Scanned signature using black ink.
A 200-word write-up about experience for entry in the online application.
Documentary proof of date of birth, such as Matriculation/10th certificate.
Final or provisional Postgraduate Degree/Certificate, as applicable.
Other educational, experience or relevant certificates wherever required.
Recent photograph: JPG/JPEG format, generally 50 KB to 100 KB.
Photograph should preferably be approximately 200 × 230 pixels.
Minimum scanning resolution should preferably be 200 DPI.
Signature should be made on white paper with a black ink pen.
Signature should preferably be approximately 140 × 60 pixels.
Date-of-birth and Postgraduate certificates are mentioned with a size range of 50 KB to 1000 KB in the initial document checklist.
Other relevant certificates should preferably be in JPG/JPEG/PDF format and should generally not exceed 1000 KB unless otherwise specified.

Important upload-size note: The notifications contain an internal difference regarding the signature file size. The initial checklist states 10 KB to 50 KB, while the later detailed signature-upload instructions state 50 KB to 100 KB. Candidates should therefore follow the file-size requirement displayed on the live KVIC recruitment portal at the time of uploading.
important_instructions: Only full-time regular qualifications from the recognized institutions specified in the notification will be considered. Candidates must satisfy the eligibility conditions by the applicable last date. CGPA/OGPA or letter grades must be converted into percentage according to the University's or Institute's prescribed norms, and proof of the conversion formula must be produced when required. Internship training will not be counted as work experience. Candidates should use a valid email ID and mobile number and keep them active throughout the recruitment process. The name entered during registration should match the name appearing on the photo identity proof. Candidates must produce the original photo identity proof and provide a photocopy when attending the interview. The printed online application form and an original photo ID such as Voter ID, Driving Licence, PAN Card, Passport or Aadhaar Card should be carried to the interview. Original testimonials and documents must be produced at the time of interview or joining. Candidates should submit only a single application for the same recruitment post. Multiple applications may lead to cancellation or rejection. Once the application is finally submitted, changes may not be permitted except where specifically enabled by KVIC. Candidates should retain the application/registration number and a copy of the submitted application. The same passport-size photograph should be used throughout the recruitment process. Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate. False, fabricated or tampered documents, suppression of information, impersonation, misconduct or use of undue influence may result in cancellation of candidature. Serving Government/PSU officials, if selected, will be allowed to join only after being properly relieved from their parent organization. Recruitment updates, corrigenda, addenda and errata will be published through the KVIC website. KVIC reserves the right to shortlist candidates, reschedule the interview date or venue, alter advertised conditions or cancel the selection process. The engagement is temporary and contractual and does not confer a right to permanent employment or regularization.

The initial contract period is one year. Extension may be considered based on performance and requirement for a further period of up to two years. Working hours will be the same as those applicable to regular KVIC employees. No extra remuneration is payable for working beyond normal working hours or on holidays. Young Professionals are eligible for eight days of leave in a single year of consultancy. Unavailed leave cannot be carried forward to the next one-year tenure. Intervening Saturdays, Sundays and Government holidays during a spell of leave will not be counted against the eight days of leave. Young Professionals must maintain confidentiality and secrecy regarding information obtained during the assignment. Selected candidates must provide integrity certificates from two references along with an undertaking regarding criminal record or pending/contemplated criminal cases. Young Professionals are responsible for arranging and maintaining appropriate insurance at their own expense. Income Tax or other applicable State tax will be deducted at source according to prevailing rules. Young Professionals are required to comply with the applicable rules and regulations of KVIC and the Government of India. Either KVIC or the Young Professional may terminate the contract by giving one month's notice as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kanpur (CSJMU) for filling various teaching positions across multiple departments under Uttar Pradesh state norms.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 36 vacancies have been announced for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor positions in various disciplines and engineering branches.

faq.question: Q3. What are the starting and closing dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 26 September 2026 and concludes on 31 October 2026. Candidates must submit their applications well before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess qualifications as per UGC Regulations-2018, AICTE-2019, and U.P. State Government's rules depending on the specific teaching post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General, OBC, and EWS category candidates is Rs. 2500/-, while SC/ST candidates are required to pay Rs. 2000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a requirement to submit a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must submit a printout of their online application along with photocopies of relevant certificates and documents to the office of the Registrar, CSJMU, Kanpur via registered or speed post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSJMU teaching posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes short-listing of candidates, a written test (specifically for Assistant Professor posts), assessment of teaching skills, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from states other than Uttar Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: Yes, eligible candidates from all over India can apply, though reservation benefits and age relaxations will be applicable strictly as per U.P. State Government rules.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of CSJMU to apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the online application portal and find detailed notifications by visiting the official university website at www.csjmu.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The official notification has been released under the advertisement number No.CSJMU/Gen.Admin/980/Teaching/2026 dated 26-09-2026.

content_sections.heading: Kochi Metro Rail Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Kochi Metro Rail Apprenticeship Recruitment 2026 must have completed the relevant qualification through a full-time regular course from a government-recognized institution. Educational qualifications obtained through part-time, correspondence, distance education or online modes are not accepted. Applicants must have completed a full-time regular four-year B.Tech or B.E. degree in one of the engineering disciplines notified by KMRL. Applicants must possess a full-time regular three-year degree in BBA, B.Com or BCA from a recognized institution. Candidates must possess a full-time regular three-year engineering diploma in the relevant notified discipline. Applicants must have completed a full-time regular ITI course in the relevant advertised trade. Applicants for Assistant Manager should have a social-work background and relevant experience in areas including land acquisition, provisions of the RFCTLARR Act, 2013 and Government of Gujarat resolutions, Resettlement & Rehabilitation, implementation of R&R policies, social development, planning and monitoring, livelihood programmes, resettlement of project-affected persons, training and capacity building, and liaison with Government bodies and private agencies. Candidates should also have computer proficiency in MS Office. Preference is given to candidates familiar with relevant national and State guidelines and policies. Candidates should have a social-work background with relevant experience in Resettlement & Rehabilitation, implementation of R&R policy, social development, planning and monitoring, livelihood programmes, resettlement of project-affected persons, training and capacity building, liaison with Government bodies and private agencies, and MS Office. GMRC states that preference will be given to candidates with knowledge of national and State guidelines, policies and Acts relating to land acquisition, rehabilitation and resettlement, and those with experience in infrastructure or urban transport sectors.

content_sections.heading: GMRC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age and experience will be calculated as on 3 October 2026. The notification states that the age limit will not apply to GMRCL employees. However, this age relaxation does not apply to officials re-employed in GMRCL after superannuation.

content_sections.heading: Assistant Manager Pay Scale and CTC Eligibility
content_sections.text: For Assistant Manager, candidates from Government, PSU or Metro Rail organisations are required to meet the pay-scale conditions specified in the notification. Candidates may presently be working in the revised IDA scale of ₹50,000–1,60,000 or an equivalent CDA scale in Government, PSU or Metro Rail Corporation. Alternatively, candidates should have worked for at least two years in the revised IDA pay scale of ₹46,000–1,45,000 in a Non-Executive grade, ₹40,000–1,40,000 in an Executive grade, or Level 6 under the 7th CPC in Government, PSU or Metro Rail Corporation. Another permitted condition is at least four years in the revised IDA pay scale of ₹40,000–1,25,000 in a Non-Executive grade, ₹35,000–1,10,000 in an Executive grade, or equivalent CDA scale. Applicants from the private sector should have a minimum CTC of ₹70,000 per month.

content_sections.heading: Other Preference Conditions
content_sections.text: GMRC states that preference will be given to candidates who have worked in Gujarat State for around five to seven years, particularly in urban or revenue offices or branches of the Government of Gujarat, and who are conversant with Gujarati language and typing. Candidates who have worked for more than five years in Ahmedabad or Gandhinagar and are familiar with the geography of the city will also be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The available GMRC recruitment notification does not mention an application fee for these posts.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for GMRC Online Application
content_sections.text: The notification asks applicants to attach documents supporting their age, qualification and experience. Detailed curriculum vitae. Matriculation certificate or birth certificate as proof of age. SSC and HSC marksheets. Graduation marksheets for all years or semesters. Relevant degree or diploma certificates. Experience or service certificates from previous employment showing date of joining, date of relieving and department worked. Pay details showing the pay scale or CTC along with the experience certificate. Latest CTC breakup for candidates from private organisations. Current organisation appointment letter, proof of date of joining and latest payslip. Form 16 as applicable, including Form 16 of the last three years for current organisation details. The notification states that applications from private-organisation candidates will not be considered for the position applied for if the required CTC breakup is not submitted. Form 16 will be considered for determining the current CTC.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gujarat Metro GMRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation official website . Use the Careers section for the online application process. Register using details such as name, date of birth, category, mobile number and email ID. Use the passcode sent to the registered email ID to log in. Select the position for which you want to apply. Fill in the online application with the relevant details and complete the application form. Use the preview option to check the information before submission. Submit the form after verifying all entered information by 21 October 2026. GMRC states that only online applications will be accepted. The information can be edited before final submission, but the submitted form cannot be edited afterwards.

content_sections.heading: GMRC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The official notification identifies Personal Interview, Document Verification and Medical Examination as the selection components. It also separately states that document verification of candidates will be conducted before the interview and that candidates must carry their original certificates. Document Verification Personal Interview Medical Examination as prescribed for the post The interview process will assess knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude and physical fitness. The date, time and venue will be communicated to shortlisted applicants in advance. Interview call letters will be sent through the registered email address.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Candidates
content_sections.text: Candidates should verify their age, educational qualification, experience and other eligibility requirements before applying. Candidates working in Indian Railways, Metro Rail organisations, State or Central Government, PSU, Board or other Government organisations may apply on deputation subject to the stated conditions. Applicable candidates should submit the required NOC on or before the interview date. Candidates working in PSU, Government Boards, Government organisations or Metro Rail Corporations should also submit the last five years' APAR records with the application on or before the interview date. Original qualification and experience documents must be produced during the recruitment process as specified in the notification. Incomplete applications are liable to be rejected. Any corrigendum or addendum will be published on the GMRC website.

content_sections.heading: GMRC Posting Location
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are likely to be posted at Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat or other GMRC projects anywhere in Gujarat. The notification states that HRA for IDA/CDA-scale employees may vary according to the place of posting and applicable Government and company policies.

content_sections.heading: GMRC Salary and Benefits
content_sections.text: For deputation candidates, pay and other terms will be governed by the standard deputation conditions. GMRC also states that other benefits will be provided according to company policy, including Group Medical Coverage and Group Personal Accident Insurance Coverage under the applicable GMRCL policies.

content_sections.heading: What Happens Next
content_sections.text: GMRC will shortlist eligible applicants and issue interview call letters through the registered email address. The call letter will contain the interview date, time and venue. The notification does not announce a fixed interview schedule.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 37 vacancies are available for the grant of Short Service Commission to desirous civilian Dental Surgeons in the Army Dental Corps.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. BDS (with a minimum of 55% marks in aggregate in final year BDS) or MDS degree, from a College/University recognised by the Dental Council of India (DCI) for the respective batch/year of graduation. Candidates must have registered themselves as Registered Dental Practitioners with any State Dental Council. Must have completed a one-year Compulsory Rotatory Internship, as mandated by DCI, by 30 June 2026. No condonation of the internship period is accepted, except for specific historical batches (2007-08 batch with 4.5-year BDS + 6 months' internship, and the 2006-07 Rajah Muthiah Dental College batch with a 5-year BDS course without internship). Must possess a Permanent or Provisional Dental Registration Certificate from a State Dental Council/DCI, valid at least up to 31 December 2026. Must have mandatorily appeared in the National Eligibility-cum-Entrance Test, NEET (MDS)-2026, conducted by the National Board of Examinations (NBE), New Delhi, on 02 May 2026, under the aegis of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India. Eligibility of candidates is entirely the responsibility of the candidate as per the criteria mentioned in the Information Brochure - candidates must check their eligibility before participating in the application process.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum permissible age for SSC in Army Dental Corps is 45 years, as on 31 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation (Class X)/SSLC/ICSE certificate or Birth certificate issued by a municipality, as valid proof of age. NEET (MDS)-2026 Admit Card. NEET (MDS)-2026 Score card. Final year BDS Mark Sheets (Part I & Part II, if the final year exam was held in two parts), showing a minimum of 55% marks in final BDS - or an MDS degree. BDS/MDS Provisional Pass Certificate/Degree Certificate. Compulsory Rotatory Internship completion certificate, or a certificate from the Principal/Dean of the college certifying the date of completion of internship. Permanent/Provisional State Dental Council registration certificate, valid up to 31 December 2026. Valid Passport/Nationality Certificate/Domicile/Nativity Certificate/Voter ID card issued by the Election Commission of India. Notification/authority document for any change of name after Matriculation, if applicable. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if applicable. Self-certified Page No. 16/17 of the Information Brochure, as applicable for BDS/MDS qualified candidates. Photograph uploaded with the application form; 5 additional passport-size photographs (white background) in hard copy, required at the time of Medical Examination for shortlisted candidates.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Application Processing Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates are required to make an online payment of ₹200 (Rupees Two Hundred only) towards the DGAFMS (APF Fund), along with the application. Candidates must ensure all details are correctly entered before submitting the payment. Incomplete applications, or applications not in accordance with instructions, will not be considered and are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on the marks scored in NEET (MDS)-2026. The list formulated will be used for screening candidates in a ratio of 1:10 - for each advertised vacancy, ten candidates will be called for interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called to appear before a duly constituted Selection Board at New Delhi, to assess suitability and merit for grant of SSC. The final merit list for grant of SSC in Army Dental Corps is based on interview performance alone. Candidates who qualify the interview must mandatorily undergo a detailed Medical Examination by a duly constituted Medical Board of the Armed Forces Medical Services, to ascertain their medical fitness. The decision of the Medical Board is final. Candidates declared unfit are classified as Temporary Unfit as per the outcome of the commissioning medical examination. Candidates shortlisted for interview must produce all original certificates, including the application/admit card, for verification at the time of interview. Candidates without original documents at the time of interview will not be eligible, even if they possess the necessary merit. Candidates who have deposited original documents with another institution may attend the interview by producing a deposit certificate from the Dean/Head of that institution, along with attested photocopies.

content_sections.text: On commission, candidates are granted the rank of Captain in Pay Level 10B (₹61,300 – ₹1,20,900) of the Defence Pay Matrix, as per Army Pay Rules 2017 (7th Pay Commission). Military Service Pay (MSP) of ₹15,500 per month. Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) at 20% of Basic Pay. House Rent Allowance (HRA), as per city category (X/Y/Z), and Dearness Allowance as admissible. Field Area Allowance, High Altitude Allowance, and Siachen Allowance, as applicable depending on rank and area of posting. Dress Allowance of ₹20,000 per year on commission. Transport Allowance (TPTA): ₹7,200 + DA per month (Higher TPTA cities) or ₹3,600 + DA per month (other cities), applicable for Level 9 and above. Children's Education Allowance of ₹2,250 per month per child, for up to two children, from nursery to Class 12. PG Allowance of ₹2,250 per month for MDS degree holders, or Specialist Pay after fulfilling mandatory requirements. Free Medical Facilities for self and dependents, Canteen facilities, entitled rations, Mess/Club/Sports facilities, Government accommodation, and subsidised Car/Housing Loans. Army Group Insurance Scheme coverage of ₹1 crore. 60 days' Annual Leave and 20 days' Casual Leave per year, 40% railway concession, and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) as per Government rules.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 Terms & Conditions of Service
content_sections.text: Tenure: 5 years, extendable by a further 9 years in two spells (5 years, then 4 years) - total SSC tenure of up to 14 years for those willing to continue, subject to vacancies and eligibility. Probation: 12 months from the date of receiving Commission. Antedate Seniority: BDS graduates with at least 6 months' paid appointment (House Officer/Resident Demonstrator/Lecturer/Clinical Assistant) are eligible for 6 months' antedate seniority; MDS degree holders (3-year PG) are eligible for 36 months' antedate seniority. Maximum antedate seniority is capped at 36 months; claims must be made within one year of joining service. Termination: Commission may be terminated by the Government of India at any time for misconduct, unsatisfactory service, or if services are no longer required. Liability of Service: Officers are liable for service in any part of the country or abroad, in the Army, Navy, or Air Force, as per service requirements. Training: After commissioning, candidates undergo training at Government expense at AMC Centre & College, Lucknow. Departmental Permanent Commission (DPC): After 2 years of SSC service, officers may apply for a limited number of Permanent Commission vacancies, provided they have not attained 30 years (BDS) or 35 years (MDS) of age as on 31 December of the application year. Promotion: Commissioned as Captain on entry; eligible for promotion to Major (or equivalent) after 4 years 6 months of service, and to Lt Col (or equivalent) after 11 years 6 months of service. MDS degree holders (3-year course) get 3 years' antedate seniority and are promoted to Substantive Major after 1 year 6 months of service.

content_sections.heading: Army Dental Corps SSC Recruitment 2026 TA/DA Entitlement
content_sections.text: Candidates appearing for interview for the first time are entitled to "To and Fro" First Class/AC-III/AC Chair Car railway fare by Mail/Express train, or actual Government bus fare if travelling by bus, to New Delhi (Interview Centre) and back, payable by CDA. Candidates appearing for a second or subsequent time are not eligible for this entitlement.

content_sections.text: Selection is made in two stages - a Preliminary Examination and a Main Examination. There is no interview . Objective-type General Studies paper; all questions carry equal (1) marks. Duration: 2 hours ; Total marks: 150 . Each question offers 5 options (A, B, C, D, E); candidates must mark one option. Negative marking: 1/3 mark deducted for each wrong answer, and 1/3 mark deducted for any question left unanswered without selecting option (E).
