content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Matriculation certificate (proof of date of birth) Educational and professional/training qualification certificates and mark sheets as per the applied post CTET/BTET/STET (Paper-I or Paper-II, as applicable) qualifying certificate and mark sheet RCI-issued valid CRR number and certificate (for special school teacher posts) 6-month special/inclusive education training certificate (where applicable) Category certificate (SC/ST/EBC/BC), with caste and domicile certificate EWS certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable Disability (Divyang) certificate issued/countersigned by a government medical college or civil surgeon, where applicable Ex-servicemen certificate, where applicable Freedom fighter grandchild/great-grandchild relationship certificate, where applicable Transgender identity proof certificate issued by the competent authority, where applicable Guest teacher experience and appointment certificates issued by the District Education Officer, where weightage is claimed Valid photo identity card, as declared in the application 4 recent passport-size photographs Printed copy of the submitted Preliminary/Main exam application and e-Admit Card

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for a maximum of 38 districts, listed in order of preference; the merit list and posting will follow district priority against category-wise availability. A candidate may take part in this recruitment examination a maximum of 5 times , as per the Bihar Vidyalaya Adhyapak (Appointment, Transfer, Disciplinary Action & Service Conditions) Amendment Rules, 2024. Reservation benefits are applicable only to candidates who are original/domiciled residents of Bihar. Candidates must select only one subject - the one in which they have qualified the relevant Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET/BTET/STET). Reserved-category candidates applying against unreserved posts will not receive reserved-category age or qualifying-mark relaxations. There is no provision for re-evaluation of the objective-type Main Examination. Merely submitting the online application does not guarantee candidature; final eligibility will be decided based on documents furnished by the candidate. Provisional merit lists will be verified by the Education Department against submitted documents; the merit list may be revised based on this verification. No supplementary result will be published after the provisional result is declared. The Commission reserves the right to modify, postpone or cancel the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: IGNOU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process (Screening & Interview)
content_sections.text: Selection is interview-based (no written exam). For Professor posts, applications are first screened and scored by a Screening Committee against a weighted research/academic-credential scale; shortlisted candidates are then called for interview by the Selection Committee. Full category list (research papers, books, e-content/MOOCs, curricula design, research guidance, projects, patents, policy documents, awards, invited lectures) and detailed point values are in Appendix I of the official notification; research score must come from a minimum of 3 out of 6 categories Combined research score from "Policy Document" and "Invited Lectures/Resource Person" categories is capped at 30% of the teacher's total research score Up to 15 candidates will be called for interview per Professor post, based on descending merit from the screening score Screening/shortlisting marks carry no weightage in the final Selection Committee interview assessment Publications "under submission" or sent to referees are not considered for scoring

basic_details.job_title: VNSGU Professor of Practice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Not specified in the notification.

qualification.details: Not specified in the notification. | In the case of Departments running programmes under AICTE, the qualification and experience norms prescribed for Professor of Practice in the Government of Gujarat Resolution dated 14/10/2024 shall also be kept in view, namely: Ph.D. with 10 years of relevant experience in a large conglomerate; or a Master's degree with 15 years of relevant working experience in a large conglomerate; or B.E./B.Tech. with 17 years of relevant working experience in a large conglomerate; or Ph.D. / Master's / B.Tech. with a minimum of five (5) patents and 5 years of experience in a start-up. A Ph.D. is desirable for guiding research scholars at the Ph.D. level but is not mandatory for teaching. | Persons who are in the teaching profession — whether serving or retired — are excluded and shall not be engaged as Professor of Practice. Applications from such persons shall be summarily rejected.

salary_details.details: In terms of Ordinance–189, the amount or allowance payable to a Professor of Practice cannot be met from the salary grant received from the State Government. Where required to travel for the work of the University, mileage allowance is payable at rates ranging from ₹ 2.50 per km to ₹ 11.00 per km depending on the conveyance used, or at rates fixed by the State Government for taxis/auto rickshaws.

selection_process: The selection shall be carried out in accordance with the Procedure for Selection of Professor of Practice prescribed in Ordinance–189 and the University Circular dated 15/04/2023.
The Selection Committee for the University shall consist of the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor or their representative
the Head of the Department concerned
the Dean of the respective Faculty
two subject experts nominated by the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor
and one eminent external member (non-academic) nominated by the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor. The minimum quorum shall be four members
of whom the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor or the representative of the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor must be present.
how_to_apply: Visit the official VNSGU website at www.vnsgu.ac.in to access the detailed advertisement and guidelines.
Open the online Google Form link available on the University website.
Fill out the required information in the online application form.
Upload self-attested testimonials, certificates, and supporting documents in PDF format.
Submit the online application form before 30/10/2026 for the first batch, or between the 1st and 20th of subsequent months.
important_instructions: Applications shall be submitted online only through the Google Form. Persons who are in the teaching profession, whether serving or retired, are excluded and applications from them shall be summarily rejected. The initial tenure of engagement shall be for one year, extendable up to three years in all. The position is on a fixed-term basis and confers no right or claim whatsoever to regular appointment. The Professor of Practice engaged shall not be eligible for any service benefits, E.P.F., gratuity, or perks other than the fixed honorarium. Originals shall be produced for verification when called for. Candidates may apply for more than one Department or subject area by indicating the order of preference in the form, with a separate submission for each Department.

Persons who are in the teaching profession — whether serving or retired — are excluded and shall not be engaged as Professor of Practice. Applications from such persons shall be summarily rejected.

rows.qualification_required: Distinguished experts who have made remarkable contributions in their professions in fields such as engineering, science, technology, entrepreneurship, commerce, social sciences, media, literature, fine arts, civil services, armed forces, the legal profession, community development, panchayati raj, rural development, watershed development, water harvesting, organic farming, small green-energy systems, municipal planning, community participation, gender budgeting and planning, inclusive development of tribals and public administration, among others. Such experts must have proven expertise in their specific profession or role with at least fifteen (15) years of service or experience, preferably at a senior level. A formal academic qualification is not considered essential for this position where the candidate has exemplary professional practice in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: JSSC Para Teacher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Class 6–8 posts (all three subject streams), candidates also need Graduation with 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education, or Graduation with B.Ed (subject to the 2011 cut-off rules mentioned in the notification), or 4-year B.A/B.Sc.Ed or BA.Ed/BSc.Ed. faq.answer: There are 7299 total vacancies combining both notifications - 6101 regular vacancies under Advt No. 04/2026 and 1198 backlog vacancies under Advt No. 05/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the difference between Advt No. 04/2026 and Advt No. 05/2026?
faq.answer: Advt No. 04/2026 covers 6101 regular vacancies open to all eligible candidates. Advt No. 05/2026 covers 1198 backlog vacancies reserved for candidates already serving as Para Teachers under the Jharkhand Shiksha Pariyojna Parishad, Ranchi, with a minimum of two continuous years of service. Candidates eligible for both can apply using one form and pay only one fee, and a common exam will be held for both.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for JSSC Para Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online registration and application form filling window closes on 29 September 2026 (midnight) for both notifications.

faq.answer: ₹100 for general/other candidates and ₹50 for SC/ST candidates of Jharkhand state. Only one fee is payable even if applying for both the regular and backlog vacancy notifications together.

faq.question: Q5. Is JTET mandatory for JSSC Para Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have passed JTET for the relevant class level (1–5 or 6–8). Candidates who cleared CTET or a neighbouring state's TET can also apply but must clear JTET within 3 years of appointment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for JSSC Para Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Level-4 pay scale of ₹25,500–₹81,100 for Class 1–5 posts, and Level-5 pay scale of ₹29,200–₹92,300 for Class 6–8 posts, applicable to both regular and backlog vacancies.

faq.question: Q7. Is there negative marking in the JSSC Para Teacher exam?
faq.answer: No, the notification specifies there is no deduction of marks for wrong answers.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for the JSSC Para Teacher backlog vacancy (Advt No. 05/2026)?
faq.answer: Only candidates currently serving as Para Teacher (Sahayak Adhyapak) under the Jharkhand Shiksha Pariyojna Parishad, Ranchi, with a minimum of two continuous years of service as on the date of advertisement publication, are eligible for the backlog vacancy posts.

faq.answer: Selection for both regular and backlog vacancies is based on a single-stage Main Examination conducted in OMR/CBT mode, followed by document verification of shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Assistant Professor post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a full-time contract basis for one year, likely to continue, and is renewable based on performance.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets a relaxation in marks or qualifications?
faq.answer: Relaxations in qualifications are applicable as per UGC norms and Kerala Government rules.

faq.question: Q3. How are candidates shortlisted and selected for the position?
faq.answer: Selection is made by a Selection Committee in three stages: scrutiny and shortlisting based on academic record, research score, and teaching experience; a teaching demonstration or seminar on a topic from the B.Ed. curriculum; and an interview assessing subject knowledge, teaching ability, research aptitude, understanding of ODL and NEP 2020, and communication skills.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable qualifications for these posts?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include a Ph.D. in Education or pedagogy (for NET/SET qualified candidates), research papers in UGC-CARE listed scopus or peer-reviewed journals, books, or chapters in edited volumes, proficiency in e-development and LMS, experience in supervising school internship, training in inclusive education, ability to teach and develop course material in Malayalam and English, and participation in Faculty Development Programmes or seminars.

faq.question: Q5. Which documents need to be sent with the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send certificates and mark lists from SSLC onwards, NET/SET/SLET or Ph.D. certificate, experience certificates, proof of date of birth, community/disability certificate if applicable, copies of the first page of research publications, fee receipt, and an NOC if in service.

faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Shillong (IIM Shillong) for various faculty positions in Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in IIM Shillong Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor Grade-I, and Assistant Professor Grade-II across various academic departments and fields.

content_sections.heading: OAVS Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: OAVS has notified 815 regular vacancies across 17 Principal and teaching post categories. The category-wise vacancy table includes UR, SEBC, SC and ST reservations along with women reservation. The notification also provides 15 vacancies for Ex-Servicemen and 6 vacancies under Sports Person reservation. PwD reservation includes 9 posts for Blindness and Low Vision, 9 for Hard of Hearing with suitable aids, 7 for Locomotor Disability and 7 for the specified combination of disability categories.

content_sections.heading: OAVS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India, be of sound mind and must not have more than one spouse living. Candidates should have passed MIL Odia up to Middle English standard. Candidates who have not passed Odia up to M.E. standard may apply, but they must pass the prescribed Odia examination conducted by BSE Odisha within three years of joining. Candidates must have: Master's Degree from a recognized University with at least 45% aggregate marks. B.Ed. prescribed by NCTE from an NCTE-recognized institution affiliated to a recognized University. Required administrative/teaching experience as specified below. The prescribed experience can be fulfilled through any one of the notified routes: Holding an analogous post or Principal post in Central/State Government or an Autonomous Organization in the prescribed equivalent pay level. Vice-Principal/Assistant Education Officer with combined service of 3 years as PGT and 2 years as Vice-Principal. PGT/Lecturer with at least 7 years of regular service in the prescribed grade. 10 years combined regular service as TGT and PGT, including at least 3 years as PGT. For PGT English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics, candidates should have either a 2-year Integrated Post Graduate Course or Master's Degree in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks, or 45% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD candidates, along with B.Ed. Candidates need at least 50% aggregate marks, or 45% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD candidates, in any one of the following: M.Sc. Computer Science / IT MCA M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science / IT Proficiency in teaching through Odia and English medium is required. The notification states that for subsequent promotion, the incumbent has to acquire B.Ed. or equivalent degree. Candidates must have either a 4-year Integrated Degree course in the concerned subject with at least 50% aggregate marks, or 45% for SC/ST/SEBC/PwD, or a Bachelor's Degree in the concerned subjects with the prescribed marks along with B.Ed./3-year integrated B.A. B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognized institution. All TGT candidates must also have passed OSSTET/OTET Paper-II conducted by BSE Odisha or CTET Paper-II conducted by CBSE, as applicable. Candidates should have a Bachelor's Degree in Fine Arts/Visual Arts from a recognized University with the prescribed aggregate marks and proficiency to teach in both Odia and English medium. Candidates should possess a Degree/Post Graduate Degree in Physical Education such as B.P.Ed./M.P.Ed. from a recognized University/Institution and meet the prescribed percentage requirement. Proficiency in Odia and English medium is required. Candidates should have the prescribed marks and any one of the following qualifications: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or IT MCA M.Sc. IT M.Sc. Computer Science DOEACC/NIELIT 'B' Level in Computer Science BCA B.Sc. Computer Science Competence to teach through English and Odia medium is required. Supporting creation of reports, flyers, brochures, Social Media posts and any other relevant communication materials to help maintain School of Sustainability’s active and positive public presence.

qualification.details: post: Essential Qualification | assistant teacher, primary, urban: Graduate degree from a University established by law in India (or an equivalent Government-recognised degree), plus a Government-recognised training qualification - including Basic Teacher Certificate (B.T.C.), Biennial B.T.C. (Urdu), Special B.T.C., a Biennial Diploma in Special Education recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India, or a 4-year B.El.Ed. degree, or a Biennial Diploma in Elementary Education per NCTE Regulations 2002 - AND must have qualified the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) conducted by the State Government or Government of India. (Note: the B.T.C. course is currently run under the name D.El.Ed.) | assistant teacher, sambaddh primary (aided schools): (1) Graduate degree from a University/deemed university/institution established by law or recognised by the Government in India, AND (2) B.T.C. or D.L.Ed. from an NCTE-recognised course, AND (3) must have successfully qualified the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for Classes 1 to 5, conducted by the UP Government or Government of India.

selection_process: Selection for both posts is based on a Merit List prepared from a written examination of 360 marks
comprising 120 objective-type (MCQ) questions. Exam duration: 2 hours. Each question has 4 options

with only one correct answer to be marked on the OMR sheet using a black ball-point pen. Marking scheme: 3 marks awarded for each correct answer; 1 mark deducted for each wrong or multiple answer (negative marking). The question paper will be bilingual - in both Hindi and English. If the exam is held in multiple shifts

a score Normalization process will be applied (as per Commission notice No. Shiksha Seva Aayog/2018/2025-26 dated 26.02.2026) to enable fair comparison across shifts; only normalized scores will be used for selection. Tie-breaker rule: In case of equal merit
preference is given first to the candidate with a higher Graduation percentage
then to a higher Training Qualification percentage
and finally to the older candidate by age. Detailed exam syllabus is available for download on the official website
www.upessc.up.gov.in. No Travelling Allowance (TA) is payable for appearing in the written exam or for document verification.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website, www.upessc.up.gov.in.
Complete One Time Registration (OTR) - mandatory before filling the application; OTR done on any other/older portal will not be valid.
Use the online payment gateway to pay the applicable examination fee via Credit/Debit Card or Net Banking.

Fill in the application form carefully and completely, in English only, indicating your preference between the two school-type options (Urban / Sambaddh Primary) - this preference cannot be changed after the deadline.
Upload a scanned signature on a white background (JPG/JPEG, 10 KB–200 KB, 140x110 pixel resolution) and a scanned passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30 KB–300 KB, 300–600 pixel resolution).
Upload all required certificates/documents in PDF format, each between 50 KB and 500 KB in size.
Review all entered details carefully - after final submission, changes to category, sub-category, date of birth, or gender will not be permitted.
Use the correction window (until 31.10.2026) only for correcting genuine errors; fees paid against an erroneous application are non-refundable and non-adjustable.
Submit the application and retain 3 printed copies for future reference - 2 of these copies, along with the required documents, must be submitted at the time of Document Verification.

qualification.details: For most of the 26 subjects, the essential qualification is a postgraduate degree in the relevant subject from a university/deemed university established by law in India, together with a B.Ed (Shiksha Snatak) degree from an NCTE-recognised programme. Public Services (Reservation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes) Act, 1994, and the U.P. Public Services (Reservation for Economically Weaker Sections) Act, 2020. selection_process: Particulars Details
Total Questions 120 (30 General Knowledge + 90 subject-related)
Total Marks 360
Duration 2 hours
Question Type Multiple Choice (4 options each), OMR-based
Marking Scheme +3 marks for each correct answer; −1 mark for each wrong or multiple-marked answer (negative marking)
Selection to Pravakta posts in aided schools (boys'/girls') is made out of a total of 400 marks
comprising a 360-mark written examination (based on 120 objective-type questions) and a 40-mark interview
on the basis of a merit list prepared from the combined score.
The written examination syllabus is available on the Commission's website (upessc.up.gov.in) and can be viewed/downloaded before applying.
Candidates shortlisted on the basis of written examination marks will be called for an interview of 40 marks. Interview date
time
and venue will be communicated at least 10 days in advance via SMS
email
newspaper
and the Commission's website; the interview call letter must be downloaded from the website. Attendance at the interview is compulsory for shortlisted candidates
and no daily allowance or travel allowance is paid for attending the interview.
The final merit list is prepared based on the combined written examination and interview marks (400 total). In case of a tie:
The candidate with higher written examination marks is ranked higher. If the tie persists
the candidate with higher interview marks is ranked higher. If the tie still persists
the candidate with a higher percentage in postgraduate qualification is ranked higher. If the tie still persists
the candidate with a higher percentage in the training qualification (B.Ed/equivalent) is ranked higher. If the tie still persists
the older candidate is ranked higher.
Cut-off marks and candidates' scores will be displayed on the website after the selection process is complete. Post-selection
allotment of schools to selected candidates will be carried out by the Director
Secondary Education
Uttar Pradesh
Prayagraj
based on merit and candidates' preferences.
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, through the OTR (One Time Registration) Based Online Application System at upessc.up.gov.in. Applications sent through any other mode will not be accepted. The broad process is:

One Time Registration (OTR): All candidates must complete OTR before they can proceed to fill the application. User manuals (Hindi and English) and tutorial videos are available on the Commission's website.

Fill the application: Registration and the application form must be filled in the English language. Enter all details carefully, since category, sub-category, date of birth, and gender cannot be changed after final submission.

Upload photo and signature: Signature must be scanned on a white background and uploaded in JPG/JPEG format, sized 10 KB–200 KB, with a resolution of 140×110 pixels. Passport-size photo must be uploaded in JPG/JPEG format, sized 30 KB–300 KB, with a resolution between 300 and 600 pixels.

content_sections.heading: UPESSC Pravakta Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to Pravakta posts in aided schools (boys'/girls') is made out of a total of 400 marks , comprising a 360-mark written examination (based on 120 objective-type questions) and a 40-mark interview , on the basis of a merit list prepared from the combined score. The written examination syllabus is available on the Commission's website (upessc.up.gov.in) and can be viewed/downloaded before applying. Candidates shortlisted on the basis of written examination marks will be called for an interview of 40 marks. Interview date, time, and venue will be communicated at least 10 days in advance via SMS, email, newspaper, and the Commission's website; the interview call letter must be downloaded from the website. Attendance at the interview is compulsory for shortlisted candidates, and no daily allowance or travel allowance is paid for attending the interview. The final merit list is prepared based on the combined written examination and interview marks (400 total). In case of a tie: The candidate with higher written examination marks is ranked higher. If the tie persists, the candidate with higher interview marks is ranked higher. If the tie still persists, the candidate with a higher percentage in postgraduate qualification is ranked higher. If the tie still persists, the candidate with a higher percentage in the training qualification (B.Ed/equivalent) is ranked higher. If the tie still persists, the older candidate is ranked higher. Cut-off marks and candidates' scores will be displayed on the website after the selection process is complete. Post-selection, allotment of schools to selected candidates will be carried out by the Director, Secondary Education, Uttar Pradesh, Prayagraj, based on merit and candidates' preferences.

At least eight years of teaching, research or industry experience. At least two years of experience must be after obtaining the Ph.D.

NET, SLET or SET qualification, or an eligible Ph.D. exemption under the applicable rules. Candidates must possess BE, BTech or BS and ME, MTech or MS, or an Integrated MTech in the relevant branch, with first class or equivalent in at least one of the degrees. Fill out the application form carefully with all required personal and educational details and attach a self-attested passport-size photograph. Enclose self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar card, high school marksheet, higher secondary marksheet, graduation degree, post-graduation degree, computer qualification certificates, and any other relevant qualification documents. Write "को-ऑपरेटिव इंटरन की नियुक्ति हेतु आवेदन" in bold letters on the top of the envelope. Send the completed application by Registered or Speed Post to the Managing Director, Chhattisgarh Rajya Sahakari Bank Maryadit, Raipur, Headquarters "Sahakar Bhavan", Plot No.-74, Sector-24, Atal Nagar, Nawa Raipur (C.G.) 492002 to reach on or before 26 October 2026 by 5:30 PM.

content_sections.text: A total of 8 vacancies have been notified under this Special Recruitment Drive for backlog posts, as shown below. content_sections.heading: Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility (age, educational qualification, etc.) is computed as on 31-08-2026, as detailed below for each post. Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA). The Post Graduation course should be a minimum 2-year full-time duration with a specialization in Finance and minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA. For CA, passing the professional examination is sufficient, and membership of ICAI is mandatory. Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in a scheduled commercial bank, an all-India financial institution, or another organization of repute, in internal audit / credit audit, including handling preparation and submission of reports by internal/concurrent auditors, audit compliance, analysis and timely submission of audit observations to the audit committee, review of internal/concurrent audit scope and systems/procedures/controls, and experience dealing with RBI on audit/inspection matters (in Scale I or equivalent). Qualification: Minimum 50% aggregate marks / equivalent CGPA in Graduation (minimum 3-year full-time course), AND Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) with specialization in Finance / International Business / Foreign Trade, or Chartered Accountant (CA), on the same terms as above. Experience (as on 31-08-2026): Minimum 1 year of post-qualification (Post Graduation or CA) work experience in a reputed commercial bank / financial institution / state level term lending institution, with skills in project finance, credit appraisal, term lending, analysis of cross-border risks, and financing of overseas joint ventures. Candidates should possess excellent communication skills and be proficient in computers and information technology. Candidates from universities awarding CGPA/GPA instead of numerical marks must furnish a conversion letter from the head of the institute / controller of examination if the equivalent percentage is not mentioned on the marksheet. The university/institute must be recognised/approved by the Government / AICTE / UGC. Candidates who completed graduation or post-graduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance / e-learning are not eligible.

content_sections.text: The institute has advertised a total of 2 vacancies for the post of Counselling Psychologist on a contractual basis under Post Code 01.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the following educational qualifications, experience, and age criteria to be eligible for the NIT Calicut Counselling Psychologist position. Master’s degree in Psychology – M.A / M.Sc. in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Counselling Psychology, or Applied Psychology; OR Master of Social Work (MSW) with specialisation in Psychiatry / Mental Health. RCI recognised professional qualification and valid RCI/CRR registration, such as: Master of Philosophy (M.Phil.) in Clinical Psychology Professional Diploma in Clinical Psychology (P.D. Cl. Psy.) content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated pay ranging from ₹40,000/- to ₹60,000/- per month, commensurate with their experience and qualification. The appointment is on a full-time contractual basis for an initial period of one year, which is extendable based on performance and institute requirements.

content_sections.heading: NIT Calicut Counselling Psychologist Job Description
content_sections.text: The engaged Counselling Psychologists will perform the following roles and responsibilities: Counselling students. Coordinate with online wellness partner. Coordinate wellness events on campus and work with Students Guidance Cell volunteers. Submit a weekly report to the Dean (Students Welfare) Office on student caseload and well-being. Maintain professional boundaries with students and uphold confidentiality in consultations and diagnoses. Ensure information gathered during consultations is not disclosed, made public, or utilized in any way except for offering assistance to students. Conduct scheduled rotational visits across various departments, hostels, and academic facilities on campus to deliver specialized sessions.

content_sections.text: Candidates applying for HPSC FSO Recruitment 2026 must meet the following essential qualifications as on the closing date, 19.10.2026: A Bachelor's, Master's, or Doctorate degree from a recognized university or institution in one of the following groups of disciplines: Food Technology group: Food Engineering; Food Engineering and Technology; Food Processing and Preservation; Food Processing Technology; Food Technology and Management; Food Biotechnology; Food Plant Operations Management; Food Process Engineering and Management; Food Processing; Food Safety and Quality Management; Process and Food Engineering Or Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, or Oil Technology Agricultural Science group: Agriculture; Agriculture Engineering; Biotechnology; Dairy Technology; Fisheries; Food Technology; Food Nutrition and Dietetic; Horticulture Or Veterinary Sciences, Bio-Chemistry, Microbiology, Chemistry, or Medicine from a recognized university Or Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery, Bachelor of Dental Surgery, Bachelor of Homeopathic Medicine and Surgery, Bachelor of Unani Medicine and Surgery, Bachelor of Siddha Medicine and Surgery, Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery, or Bachelor of Sowa Rigpa Medicine and Surgery; or any other equivalent qualification notified by the Food Authority with the prior approval of the Central Government Successful completion of training as specified by the Food Authority in a recognized institute or institution approved for the purpose. This training is given after appointment, and candidates who complete it successfully will be notified as Food Safety Officer. Hindi or Sanskrit as one of the subjects in Matriculation, or Hindi as one of the subjects in Higher Education. content_sections.heading: HPSC Food Safety Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Generally, the Commission follows a three-stage recruitment process: Screening Test, followed by a Subject Knowledge Test, and Interview . However, the Commission may also decide to hold the Subject Knowledge Test and Interview directly, without a Screening Test. If the number of applications is large, the Commission may adopt any one or more of the following methods for shortlisting candidates for the next stage: Percentage of marks in the minimum prescribed educational qualification Percentage of marks in different educational qualifications, with weightage decided by the Commission Desirable qualifications, where more than one is prescribed Higher educational qualifications than the minimum/essential qualification prescribed Higher experience in the relevant field than the minimum prescribed Counting of experience before or after acquiring the minimum/essential qualification A Screening Test and/or Subject Knowledge Test No claim for re-checking or manual checking of OMR sheets, or re-checking/re-evaluation of Subject Knowledge Test answer sheets, will be entertained. The decision of the Commission regarding the pattern of examination is final and binding on candidates.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested candidates must send the hard copy of their filled-in applications in the prescribed format through Speed Post to the following address: The Deputy Registrar (Establishment), Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Surat, Ichchhanath, Dumas Road, Keval Chowk, Surat, Gujarat-395007 The name of the post applied for should be superscribed on the envelope for sending the hard copy of the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology/Clinical Psychology (Completed) with a minimum of one year of experience in providing counselling to students at educational institutes, hospitals, or mental health clinics. Desirable Qualifications: Experience in counselling adolescents aged 18 to 30 years, preferably in a residential institution, counselling centre, or psychiatric clinic. Ability to administer and interpret psychometric tests. Membership of professional societies is desirable. Age Limit: Up to 35 years. Candidates with higher desirable experience will be preferred. The closing date for submission of applications is considered as the cut-off date for age.

content_sections.heading: SVNIT Counselling Psychologist Job Description
content_sections.text: Individual Counselling & Psychological Support: Provide confidential, professional, one-to-one counselling services to students experiencing psychological, emotional, academic, social, behavioural, interpersonal, or personal concerns. Support students in managing stress, anxiety, depression, examination pressure, homesickness, adjustment difficulties, relationship concerns, grief, trauma, low self-esteem, loneliness, and other psychosocial challenges. Conduct psychological screening and assessments, develop individualized support plans, and provide follow-up and continuity of support. Crisis Intervention & Emergency Psychological Response: Provide timely psychological first-line support and crisis intervention in cases of acute emotional distress, suicidal ideation, self-harm risk, substance-use concerns, violence, harassment, trauma, or severe behavioural concerns. Undertake risk identification, safety planning, and intervention. Coordinate with Institute authorities, medical personnel, hostel administration, wardens, and emergency services while maintaining confidentiality. Mental Health Promotion, Awareness & Preventive Program: Design and conduct a structured calendar of mental health awareness, preventive, and wellness programs. Organize workshops, awareness campaigns, and interactive sessions. Conduct sensitization programs for students, faculty, staff, and other stakeholders to improve awareness and early identification of mental health concerns.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format. Duly attested copies of all certificates and mark-sheets. Appropriate conversion formula to percentage or CGPA/GPA calculator (in case of CGPA/GPA). All supporting documents, which must be self-attested.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting followed by a personal interview. Shortlisting: The Institute will decide shortlisting parameters, and adequate numbers of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Fulfilling minimum qualifications and experience does not vest any right in a candidate for being called for an interview. Interview: Final selection is based on the performance of the candidate during a personal interview held at SVNIT Surat. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the interview.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: MD/DNB (Anaesthesiology) Or Equivalent PG Degree.

qualification.details: All U.G., P.G., or Super Specialty degrees must be recognized by the National Medical Commission. It is mandatory for all selected and appointed Senior Residents at ACTREC to be registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,33,623/- p.m to Rs. 1,45,530/- p.m (Subject to Experience)

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at the provided link.
Fill out the online application form completely in all respects.
Upload necessary documentary evidence in support of date of birth, qualifications, experience, caste, disability certificate, and NOC if applicable.
Pay the online application fee of Rs. 100/- using a Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
Submit the online application form on or before 28.10.2026 by 05.30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).
important_instructions: Age and experience will be reckoned as on 28.10.2026. The upper age limit is 40 years, with relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates. Senior Residents must pay a Security / Caution Deposit of Rs. 1,33,623/- at the time of joining or have it deducted in five equal installments from their salary, which is refunded without interest after completion of the SRship. Residents may resign after completing five months of service by giving one month's notice (total 6 months service) to be eligible for a deposit refund; leaving without the required notice forfeits the last month's salary. Appointed candidates may be placed by rotation at ACTREC Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, Tata Memorial Hospital Mumbai, or any non-Mumbai centres including Sangrur, Mullanpur (Punjab), Varanasi, Visakhapatnam, Muzaffarpur, and Guwahati. Candidates working under Government or Autonomous bodies must upload an NOC and produce the original NOC to appear for the MCQ or interview. Shortlisted candidates will be given the option to attend the interview in person or request a link for an online interview. Result-awaited candidates must declare their degree passing on the day of the MCQ or VIVA to be allowed to appear.

selection_process: Particular Details
Total marks 100
Question type Objective, multiple choice
Number of questions 50
Marks per correct answer 2
Negative marking No marks will be deducted for wrong answers
Subjects General knowledge, arithmetic, Marathi language, geographical and historical information of Ratnagiri district, etc.
Exam date 15 November 2026, at the centre and time printed on the admit card

Selection is based on a written examination. The notification does not mention an interview or physical test. Selected candidates must still submit certificates and complete document verification before appointment.
The exam pattern follows the Revenue and Forest Department Government Resolution dated 17/05/2023
as cited in the notification. Any candidate who commits or attempts any improper or illegal act during the exam will be disqualified immediately.
After the exam

the answer key will be displayed on the notice boards of the Tahsil Office Ratnagiri and the Sub-Divisional Officer Office Ratnagiri. The notification states that this answer key is final and no objections will be accepted. The written exam result
along with the list of seat numbers

will be displayed on the same notice boards. The merit order depends on marks obtained out of 100 in the written exam. A category-wise selection list and a waiting list will be prepared based on the marks obtained. In case of a tie in qualifying marks or merit
action will be taken as per the prevailing Government resolutions and rules. If a selected candidate does not join within 15 days of the appointment order

the next candidate on the waiting list will be appointed. No complaint on this will be entertained. The appointment order will be given to eligible candidates on the final selection list only after verification of the original documents.
Within 1 month of selection
finally selected candidates must submit a "character and conduct" certificate from the competent authority. Within 1 month of selection
they must also submit a medical certificate of physical fitness from the District Surgeon
Ratnagiri. After appointment

the Mahsul Sevak must take the prescribed oath of loyalty to the Constitution of India. Candidates must live in the saja to which they are appointed and submit an undertaking to that effect. Otherwise the appointment will be cancelled. At the time of joining
the candidate must submit a personal compensation bond as per Rule 51 of the Bombay Financial Rules
1959. The Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) is a full-time servant
and the appointment is on a temporary basis.
how_to_apply: The notification describes an offline process. Follow these steps.
Collect the prescribed application form from the Tahsildar Ratnagiri office. The form costs Rs. 50/- in cash, and a receipt is given.
Fill in the form completely and clearly, mentioning the reservation category (if applying from a reserved category).
Paste a self-attested recent colour photograph in the space provided, and attach two more colour photographs.
Attach the small family certificate and self-attested or attested copies of all required documents.
Put the application and documents in a sealed envelope and write your full name on the envelope.

Submit the application in person at the Tahsildar Ratnagiri office, with the Rs. 500/- examination fee in cash, between 02 October 2026 and 17 October 2026 during office hours, excluding government holidays.
Collect the admit card between 08 November 2026 and 10 November 2026 from the Tahsil Office Ratnagiri after showing an identity proof.

There is no online application for this recruitment. Only applications received in person at the Tahsildar Ratnagiri office will be considered. Applications sent by email or post, or submitted by any other method, will not be considered. Application forms photocopied or printed from another source will be rejected at scrutiny. Applications received after the last date will not be accepted.
According to the notification, the following applications will not be considered:
Applications not in the prescribed format.
Applications where the prescribed fee has not been paid.
Applications from candidates who do not meet the educational, residence or category conditions.
Incomplete or incorrectly filled applications.
Applications without all required documents attached with attestation.
Applications without a photograph or without self-attestation.
Applications received after the deadline or not received through the prescribed method.
Applications with a recommendation from any political party, organization or person attached.
important_instructions: Reservation applies as per the category-wise posts listed above. The notification sets these conditions for candidates applying from reserved categories.

A candidate claiming a reserved post must attach attested copies of the caste/category certificate issued by the competent authority and, where applicable, the non-creamy layer certificate. Backward-class candidates must produce the original caste certificate and original caste validity certificate at the time of verification. If a selected backward-class candidate cannot produce the caste validity certificate, a temporary appointment may be given after the candidate submits a bond or affidavit promising to submit it within six months. The notification cites the General Administration Department Government Resolution dated 12/12/2011 for this. If the certificate is not submitted within the prescribed period of at most six months after appointment, the service will be terminated. Backward-class candidates other than Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes must attach an attested copy of a valid non-creamy layer certificate showing that they are not in the creamy layer. EWS candidates must attach an attested copy of a valid EWS certificate, issued as prescribed by the General Administration Department Government Resolutions dated 12/02/2019 and 31/05/2021. SEBC candidates must attach attested copies of the caste certificate and the non-creamy layer certificate, as prescribed by the General Administration Department Government Resolution dated 29 January 2025 (or the equivalent resolution in force at the time). Creamy layer candidates from other backward classes will not get the reservation of that class. The reserved category must be clearly mentioned in the application. Otherwise the application will be rejected. The application will be considered only under the category for which the candidate has applied, and no complaint on this point will be entertained later. Women candidates must submit the application in their maiden name (name by birth), in the prescribed format.

EWS candidates must attach an attested copy of a valid EWS certificate, issued as prescribed by the General Administration Department Government Resolutions dated 12/02/2019 and 31/05/2021. SEBC candidates must attach attested copies of the caste certificate and the non-creamy layer certificate, as prescribed by the General Administration Department Government Resolution dated 29 January 2025 (or the equivalent resolution in force at the time). Creamy layer candidates from other backward classes will not get the reservation of that class. The reserved category must be clearly mentioned in the application. Otherwise the application will be rejected. The application will be considered only under the category for which the candidate has applied, and no complaint on this point will be entertained later. Women candidates must submit the application in their maiden name (name by birth), in the prescribed format.

content_sections.text: The notification does not state a fixed salary amount. It says that the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) will receive the honorarium (मानधन) payable under the rates revised by the government from time to time, along with allowances (सवलती) granted by the government from time to time. The post is unclassified and the appointment is on a temporary basis. The notification states that the appointee will not receive regular pay or any retirement-related service benefits. Other service conditions will be as prescribed by the government from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Ratnagiri Tahsil Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a written examination. The notification does not mention an interview or physical test. Selected candidates must still submit certificates and complete document verification before appointment. The exam pattern follows the Revenue and Forest Department Government Resolution dated 17/05/2023, as cited in the notification. Any candidate who commits or attempts any improper or illegal act during the exam will be disqualified immediately. After the exam, the answer key will be displayed on the notice boards of the Tahsil Office Ratnagiri and the Sub-Divisional Officer Office Ratnagiri. The notification states that this answer key is final and no objections will be accepted. The written exam result, along with the list of seat numbers, will be displayed on the same notice boards. The merit order depends on marks obtained out of 100 in the written exam. A category-wise selection list and a waiting list will be prepared based on the marks obtained. In case of a tie in qualifying marks or merit, action will be taken as per the prevailing Government resolutions and rules. If a selected candidate does not join within 15 days of the appointment order, the next candidate on the waiting list will be appointed. No complaint on this will be entertained. The appointment order will be given to eligible candidates on the final selection list only after verification of the original documents. Within 1 month of selection, finally selected candidates must submit a "character and conduct" certificate from the competent authority. Within 1 month of selection, they must also submit a medical certificate of physical fitness from the District Surgeon, Ratnagiri. After appointment, the Mahsul Sevak must take the prescribed oath of loyalty to the Constitution of India. Candidates must live in the saja to which they are appointed and submit an undertaking to that effect. Otherwise the appointment will be cancelled. At the time of joining, the candidate must submit a personal compensation bond as per Rule 51 of the Bombay Financial Rules, 1959. The Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) is a full-time servant, and the appointment is on a temporary basis.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required to Apply
content_sections.text: Attach self-attested or attested copies of all documents with the application. Original documents must be produced at verification, otherwise the candidate will be disqualified. Class 4 pass marksheet, or a certificate showing the highest educational qualification obtained. School leaving certificate, bonafide certificate or secondary school examination certificate stating the date of birth, or a birth certificate. Residence certificate from the Tahsildar showing that the candidate is a resident of a village in Ratnagiri District. Maharashtra domicile certificate (Age, Nationality and Domicile Certificate). Self-attested copy of any one identity proof: Aadhaar card, voter ID or PAN card. Caste certificate and caste validity certificate (if applicable) for reserved posts; a valid non-creamy layer certificate for other backward classes; a valid EWS certificate for EWS candidates (if applicable). Small family certificate in the prescribed format. A sample is provided with the application form. Unmarried candidates must clearly write "unmarried" on it. Without this certificate the application is liable to be rejected. One recent colour photograph, self-attested and firmly pasted at the prescribed place on the application, plus two additional colour photographs. Attested copy of the relevant Government Gazette if the candidate's name has changed after passing Class 4.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Ratnagiri Tahsil Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification describes an offline process. Follow these steps. Collect the prescribed application form from the Tahsildar Ratnagiri office. The form costs Rs. 50/- in cash, and a receipt is given. Fill in the form completely and clearly, mentioning the reservation category (if applying from a reserved category). Paste a self-attested recent colour photograph in the space provided, and attach two more colour photographs. Attach the small family certificate and self-attested or attested copies of all required documents. Put the application and documents in a sealed envelope and write your full name on the envelope. Submit the application in person at the Tahsildar Ratnagiri office, with the Rs. 500/- examination fee in cash, between 02 October 2026 and 17 October 2026 during office hours, excluding government holidays. Collect the admit card between 08 November 2026 and 10 November 2026 from the Tahsil Office Ratnagiri after showing an identity proof. There is no online application for this recruitment. Only applications received in person at the Tahsildar Ratnagiri office will be considered. Applications sent by email or post, or submitted by any other method, will not be considered. Application forms photocopied or printed from another source will be rejected at scrutiny. Applications received after the last date will not be accepted. According to the notification, the following applications will not be considered: Applications not in the prescribed format. Applications where the prescribed fee has not been paid. Applications from candidates who do not meet the educational, residence or category conditions. Incomplete or incorrectly filled applications. Applications without all required documents attached with attestation. Applications without a photograph or without self-attestation. Applications received after the deadline or not received through the prescribed method. Applications with a recommendation from any political party, organization or person attached.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Patna Project Clinician Job Description
content_sections.text: Responsible for the continuous monitoring and real-time review of fetal monitoring tracings transmitted from peripheral health centers through the Central Monitoring System. Ensure prompt identification of abnormal patterns or technical issues in the tracings and initiate necessary communication with Project Assistants or local clinical teams for follow-up actions. Will be given shift-wise duty, including night shifts, to ensure uninterrupted supervision of incoming data round the clock. Serve as a key of contact for all clinical coordination and troubleshooting, maintaining consistent communication with the Project Assistants deployed at peripheral sites. Document all observed clinical concerns, follow-up actions, and system-related issues in a timely and organized manner. Support the central team in generating daily summaries, alerts, or incident reports as needed for effective project oversight. Collaborate with the PI / Co-Pi for referral decisions, intervention planning, or escalation of clinical events based on the monitored data. Additional tasks or duties as assigned by the Principal Investigator or Competent Authority within the scope of the study.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu)
Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Phase II ("ESDM and IT/ITES")
Digital India Corporation, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India
Rs. 1,08,393 per month (Fellowship) + Contingency Grant of Rs. 1,00,000/year + Travel support up to Rs. 2,10,000/year
Upper age limit is 40 years on the last date of application submission

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the following eligibility conditions specified in the notification: Nationality: Must be an Indian citizen. Educational Qualification: Must have obtained a PhD degree from a recognized University in any research area relevant to Electrical Engineering within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of application. Candidates must have secured a first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels with a good academic record throughout. Publications in reputed journals and conferences will be given weightage. Employment Status: Applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered. Scientists or researchers with temporary positions in academia or research institutions may apply, but must relinquish their current roles if selected. Institution Restriction: Applicants must not have completed their PhD at the same institution (host institution) where the PDF fellowship is to be awarded. Academic Record: Must have a proven academic record including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Postdoctoral Fellow receives a fellowship of Rs. 1,08,393 per month . In addition, a contingency grant of Rs. 1,00,000 per year is provided. Travel support of up to Rs. 2,10,000 per year is limited to visa fees, one-time travel support for overseas faculty/applicants returning to India to take up the assignment, and participation in activities, events, or workshops of the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme upon invitation from the PhD Cell, DIC. The position is full-time, non-transferable, and valid for 1 year.

content_sections.heading: Nature of Job
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be responsible for handling a project, carrying out research work, evaluating and mentoring PhD candidates, participating in collaborative research under the scheme, and participating in workshops and events.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jammu Postdoctoral Fellow (PDF)
content_sections.text: Visit the online application portal at https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home . Navigate through the [contract/project staff/JRF/SRF/PDF] tab on the portal. Fill out the application form with the requested details. Upload scanned copies of educational qualification certificates, experience documents, and other supporting documents. Submit a one-page statement of purpose at the time of application submission. Complete and submit the application latest by 18 October 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and the needs of the project. Merely possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure a call for an interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified of the interview date and time by email. The interview will be conducted in online mode. Selected candidates who are already employed must produce a relieving certificate from their employers.

content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: PhD in Civil Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, Hydrology, or a closely related field. Desirable Qualification: Hands-on experience with hydrological and hydrodynamic models for flood and drought-related applications. Develop data-driven hydrological forecasting models, process satellite and sensor observations, and link regional climate projections to water management systems. Analyze geospatial, hydrometeorological, remote-sensing, and infrastructure datasets for Indian regions. Publish in high-quality journals, contribute to project deliverables, and collaborate with students and research partners. Build AI-driven digital twin platforms by integrating machine learning emulators with supercomputing infrastructure.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Bhopal Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare the completed application in PDF format along with the latest CV, list of publications, and future research plan. Ensure the subject line of the email is exactly "Application for the Post of Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow (Bio)". Send the application by email to [email protected] . content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Institute Post-Doctoral Fellow Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No interim enquiries, correspondence, or communication of any sort will be entertained. Mere fulfillment of eligibility criteria does not entitle any candidate to be called for interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. Candidates who have submitted their thesis must submit the provisional or degree certificate within 6 months from the date of appointment. Besides research work, the selected IPDF is expected to assist in teaching course(s) as required by the Department. No accommodation will be provided to the IPDFs by the Institute. It is mandatory for IPDFs to have a medical insurance policy of a minimum of Rs. 1 lakh valid throughout the fellowship period; no medical reimbursement is admissible.

how_to_apply: SCI Junior Court Assistant Apply Online process is entirely online, through the link provided on the Supreme Court of India's website.
Visit the official website: www.sci.gov.in and access the online application link provided for the recruitment.

Fill in the online Application Form with accurate personal, educational, and category details. Note that Name, Father's name, Mother's name, and Date of Birth must be entered exactly as per the High School Certificate/Xth Board Examination certificate.

Upload scanned copies of your recent photograph, signature, and requisite documents (Class Xth, Class XIIth, and Graduation Certificates, caste/community certificate for reserved category candidates, and disability certificate, if applicable).
Furnish the required Undertaking confirming that you have read and understood the terms and conditions of the advertisement and will abide by them.
Make payment of the applicable application fee online, through the payment gateway provided by UCO Bank.
Preview the Application Form after successful completion, and take a printout of the filled-up form for your records (this printout need not be sent to the Registry).
Submit the application on or before 28th October 2026, till 11:55 p.m.

important_instructions: Admission at all stages of the Examination — Objective Type Test, Typing Speed Test, Written Test (Descriptive), and Interview — will be purely provisional; eligibility documents will be checked/verified at the time of document verification. No request for change of category filled in the online Application Form will be entertained. Candidates must have a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, kept active throughout the recruitment process, as information will be sent via SMS and e-mail. basic_details.organization_name: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL)
basic_details.selection_process_brief: Screening on Inter CA/Inter CMA aggregate marks and virtual personal interview

application_fee.details: There is no fee for applying for the NPCIL CA/CMA Intern internship. Candidates of all categories can apply online without paying any application fee.

age_limit.details: The age limit is calculated as on 26/10/2026. The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 56 years, as printed in the notification. Age relaxation details are not specified in the notification.

qualification.details: The internship is offered to candidates who have passed Inter CA or Inter CMA and are to be trained in the field of Finance and Accounts. The notification states that eligibility for practical training at NPCIL Units and HQ will be as per the terms and conditions provided by the respective institutions. The notification also states that these prescribed qualifications are the minimum and that possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. | Candidates must enter the exact percentage of marks in the qualification section of the form. Marks must not be rounded off, so 49.99% should not be entered as 50%.

salary_details.additional amount: Rs 5,000 per month if accommodation is not available at the Unit/HQ
salary_details.extension: Up to a further period not exceeding 12 months, case to case, subject to institute requirements and performance of the student
salary_details.details: Selected interns receive a monthly stipend rather than a salary, because the notification treats them as trainees. The stipend is Rs 20,000 per month. An additional Rs 5,000 per month is paid where accommodation is not available at the NPCIL Unit or HQ. | Accommodation: A suitable accommodation (single room or bare minimum accommodation) is provided at Units on payment of the normal license fee. If accommodation is not available at Units and HQ, Rs 5,000 per month is given in lieu of accommodation. Transport and medical: Free site transportation subject to availability, and free OPD and first aid facility only. Leave: 1 day of paid leave per month, which is 12 days for one year. For extensions, leave is pro-rata for the extended period. Stipend is deducted proportionately for absence other than admissible leave. Working hours: 8 hours a day in general shift including a 1 hour lunch break, 5 days a week. Injury compensation: NPCIL is liable to pay compensation for personal injury caused by accident arising out of and during training, as per the Employees' Compensation Act, 1923. Status: Interns are treated as trainees and labour-related laws applicable to employees do not apply to them. NPCIL is not obliged to offer employment after the training period.

selection_process: The selection is based on Inter CA/Inter CMA marks followed by a virtual personal interview. Screening is done on the aggregate of marks
so only screened-in candidates are informed by e-mail about the further selection process.
Screening: Candidates are shortlisted for the personal interview in the ratio of 1:5
based on the aggregate marks obtained in the Inter CA/Inter CMA examination. Personal Interview: Selection of interns is by personal interview

which candidates can attend in virtual mode at the respective Unit/Region. Certificate Verification and Medical Examination: Candidates are engaged after qualifying the standard medical examination and after satisfactory verification of certificates. Police and Character Verification: Interns are engaged based on the police verification certificate issued by District Police authorities
and a character/conduct certificate must be submitted from the concerned institution.
Candidates with higher marks in the Inter CA/Inter CMA examination are placed higher in the merit list. If both interview marks and Inter CA/Inter CMA marks are equal
the candidate senior in age is ranked higher. If interview marks
Inter CA/Inter CMA marks and age are all the same
the merit list is prepared in alphabetical order of the name (first name
middle name and surname).
Candidates who wish to apply for more than one location must mention their preference. They are shortlisted on CA/CMA marks only and are interviewed at one of the sites of their choice.
how_to_apply: NPCIL accepts applications only through its online registration system. Hard copy, handwritten or typed applications delivered in person or by any other means will not be entertained, and candidates should not send any documents or applications to NPCIL.

The online application form is available at www.npcilcareers.co.in from 06/10/2026 (10:00 hrs) to 26/10/2026 (17:00 hrs). The online process has four steps: registration, activation, filling details with photo and signature upload, and printing the application form.
Visit the official website www.npcilcareers.co.in.

Click on Apply, then Online Registration, at the top or left corner of the page. Enter basic details such as name, date of birth, category, email and mobile number. An activation link is sent to the email.
Click the activation link received by email to activate the account.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: NPCIL has notified a total of 51 intern vacancies across its Headquarters and Units. The notification states that Government of India orders on reservation will be followed, and that the vacancy count may change depending on the extension or completion of existing interns. The notes printed with the vacancy table are given below. ST* and OBC* include backlog vacancies. This year it is reserved for (a) LV, (b) D, HH, (c) OA, OL, OAL, BL, BA, CP, LC, Dw, AAV, SD/SI without any associated neurological/limb dysfunction, SD/SI with associated limb dysfunction of OA/OL/OAL/BL/BA, (d) ASD (M, MoD), SLD, MI, (e) MD. PwBD #: LV - Low Vision. PwBD **: D - Deaf, HH - Hard of Hearing. The number of interns may change depending on the extension or completion of existing interns undergoing training. In such cases, candidate selection may be kept on hold or cancelled, or an offer may be issued after the previous batch completes its training, subject to the maximum number of vacancies at the particular site. The full forms of the site abbreviations (TAPS, RAPS, NAPS, KAPS, MAPS, KGS, GHAVP, KKNPP) are not given in the notification.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern eligibility covers nationality, qualification and age. Candidates should read the criteria carefully and confirm they meet every condition before applying, because candidature can be cancelled at any stage if a candidate is found ineligible. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. The candidate must have passed the Inter CA or Inter CMA examination. The candidate must be within the prescribed age limit as on 26/10/2026. Applicants without final marks will not be considered and need not apply.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Qualification
content_sections.text: The internship is offered to candidates who have passed Inter CA or Inter CMA and are to be trained in the field of Finance and Accounts. The notification states that eligibility for practical training at NPCIL Units and HQ will be as per the terms and conditions provided by the respective institutions. The notification also states that these prescribed qualifications are the minimum and that possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates must enter the exact percentage of marks in the qualification section of the form. Marks must not be rounded off, so 49.99% should not be entered as 50%.

rows.qualification: Passed Inter CA or Inter CMA, subject to the terms and conditions of the respective institutions

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit is calculated as on 26/10/2026. The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 56 years, as printed in the notification. Age relaxation details are not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no fee for applying for the NPCIL CA/CMA Intern internship. Candidates of all categories can apply online without paying any application fee.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Stipend (Salary)
content_sections.text: Selected interns receive a monthly stipend rather than a salary, because the notification treats them as trainees. The stipend is Rs 20,000 per month. An additional Rs 5,000 per month is paid where accommodation is not available at the NPCIL Unit or HQ. Accommodation: A suitable accommodation (single room or bare minimum accommodation) is provided at Units on payment of the normal license fee. If accommodation is not available at Units and HQ, Rs 5,000 per month is given in lieu of accommodation. Transport and medical: Free site transportation subject to availability, and free OPD and first aid facility only. Leave: 1 day of paid leave per month, which is 12 days for one year. For extensions, leave is pro-rata for the extended period. Stipend is deducted proportionately for absence other than admissible leave. Working hours: 8 hours a day in general shift including a 1 hour lunch break, 5 days a week. Injury compensation: NPCIL is liable to pay compensation for personal injury caused by accident arising out of and during training, as per the Employees' Compensation Act, 1923. Status: Interns are treated as trainees and labour-related laws applicable to employees do not apply to them. NPCIL is not obliged to offer employment after the training period.

content_sections.heading: NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is based on Inter CA/Inter CMA marks followed by a virtual personal interview. Screening is done on the aggregate of marks, so only screened-in candidates are informed by e-mail about the further selection process. Screening: Candidates are shortlisted for the personal interview in the ratio of 1:5, based on the aggregate marks obtained in the Inter CA/Inter CMA examination. Personal Interview: Selection of interns is by personal interview, which candidates can attend in virtual mode at the respective Unit/Region. Certificate Verification and Medical Examination: Candidates are engaged after qualifying the standard medical examination and after satisfactory verification of certificates. Police and Character Verification: Interns are engaged based on the police verification certificate issued by District Police authorities, and a character/conduct certificate must be submitted from the concerned institution. Candidates with higher marks in the Inter CA/Inter CMA examination are placed higher in the merit list. If both interview marks and Inter CA/Inter CMA marks are equal, the candidate senior in age is ranked higher. If interview marks, Inter CA/Inter CMA marks and age are all the same, the merit list is prepared in alphabetical order of the name (first name, middle name and surname). Candidates who wish to apply for more than one location must mention their preference. They are shortlisted on CA/CMA marks only and are interviewed at one of the sites of their choice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NPCIL CA/CMA Intern Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: NPCIL accepts applications only through its online registration system. Hard copy, handwritten or typed applications delivered in person or by any other means will not be entertained, and candidates should not send any documents or applications to NPCIL. The online application form is available at www.npcilcareers.co.in from 06/10/2026 (10:00 hrs) to 26/10/2026 (17:00 hrs). The online process has four steps: registration, activation, filling details with photo and signature upload, and printing the application form. Visit the official website www.npcilcareers.co.in . Click on Apply, then Online Registration, at the top or left corner of the page. Enter basic details such as name, date of birth, category, email and mobile number. An activation link is sent to the email. Click the activation link received by email to activate the account. Log in with the Login ID and password. Fill in the stages in order: Educational Qualification, Personal Details, Upload Photo and Signature, and Submit Application. Use the Save and Proceed to Next Step option at each stage. Check the draft of all entered details at the Submit Application stage. Details can be modified until submission, but no changes are allowed after the application is submitted. Submit the application to receive the application number, which is also sent by email. View and print the online application form. Candidates should note their Login ID and password, as these are needed to check the application status through the Applicant's Login link. The uploaded photograph is printed on the call letter, and only the applicant whose photograph is printed on the call letter is allowed to appear for the online interview, certificate verification and medical examination. An application without a valid photograph and signature will not be accepted. The category (SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD) filled in the form cannot be changed later. If a candidate submits multiple applications, only the latest application is considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Interview, Certificate Verification and Medical Examination
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates should keep their Aadhaar Card and online application form ready when reporting for the online interview, and must carry a clearly printed e-Call Letter. Original documents and self-attested copies, along with a duly signed hard copy of the online application, are required at certificate verification and medical examination. Candidates who do not produce the required documents will not be allowed to appear for the medical examination. SC/ST/OBC (Non Creamy Layer): Caste/category certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India. OBC (NCL) certificates must be issued on or after 01/04/2026, and OBC applicants called for the interview must give an undertaking at the time of reporting that they belong to the OBC (Non Creamy Layer) category. EWS: Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format from a competent authority, valid for the year 2026-27. PwBD: Disability certificate issued by an authority prescribed in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017. Certificates in other languages: A self-certified translated copy in English or Hindi if a certificate is issued in any other language. Police verification certificate issued by District Police authorities and a character/conduct certificate from the concerned institution. The prescribed format for the EWS certificate can be downloaded from www.npcilcareers.co.in, and the standard formats enclosed with the notification are for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD and the OBC undertaking.

content_sections.heading: Other Important Conditions
content_sections.text: NPCIL reserves the right to fill all intern vacancies, alter the number of vacancies, or cancel, suspend, postpone or alter the whole recruitment process, and to change the recruitment criteria at any stage without prior notice. Issue of an e-Call Letter for the virtual interview gives no right or claim to the internship. Final selection is based on merit and subject to all eligibility conditions and Government of India guidelines on reservation and concessions. No request for change of the virtual interview date or time will be entertained. A candidate who provides wrong information, submits false documents, suppresses relevant information, uses unfair means, is found guilty of impersonation or uploads a non-human or irrelevant photograph is liable to be disqualified, prosecuted and debarred, and the application or appointment is cancelled. Records of candidates who are not selected are not preserved beyond 6 months from the date of publication of the select list. In case of any ambiguity arising from versions other than English, the English version prevails. Legal jurisdiction for any dispute is Mumbai. NPCIL strives to have a workforce which reflects gender balance and women applicants are encouraged to apply.
